// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/LogoBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Logotipo (Imagem ou Tipografia da Marca com link).
 */
class LogoBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;

    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;
    private PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
        $this->urlResolver = $urlResolver ?? new BaseUrlResolver();
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'logo';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Logotipo / Marca';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🛡️';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'identity';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $baseUrl = $this->urlResolver->getBaseUrl();
        $rawLink = (string)($data['link'] ?? $data['url'] ?? $baseUrl . '/');
        $link = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($rawLink, $baseUrl . '/');
        $height = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['height'] ?? '40px'));
        $rawImageUrl = (string)($data['image_url'] ?? $baseUrl . '/assets/img/logo.png');
        $imageUrl = $rawImageUrl !== '' ? $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($rawImageUrl, '') : '';
        $brandText = (string)($data['brand_text'] ?? $data['text'] ?? 'Domain<span class="text-primary">System</span>');
        $showImage = (bool)($data['show_image'] ?? true);
        $showText = (bool)($data['show_text'] ?? true);
        $align = (string)($data['align'] ?? 'left');
        $justifyLogo = match ($align) {
            'center' => 'center',
            'right'  => 'flex-end',
            default  => 'flex-start',
        };

        $safeLink = htmlspecialchars($link, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $imgHtml = '';
        if ($showImage && $imageUrl !== '') {
            $safeImg = htmlspecialchars($imageUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $imgHtml = "<img src=\"{$safeImg}\" class=\"ds-logo-img\" alt=\"Logo\" style=\"height: {$height}; width: auto; max-width: 100%; object-fit: contain;\" onerror=\"this.style.display='none'\">";
        }

        $textHtml = '';
        if ($showText && $brandText !== '') {
            $sanitized = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeInlineHtml($brandText);
            $textHtml = "<div class=\"ds-logo-text\" style=\"font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.5px; color: #fff;\">{$sanitized}</div>";
        }

        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-logo-wrapper" style="display: flex; justify-content: {$justifyLogo}; width: 100%;">
    <a href="{$safeLink}" class="ds-block-logo" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none;">
        {$imgHtml}
        {$textHtml}
    </a>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'logo',
            'fields' => [
                'image_url'  => ['type' => 'media', 'label' => 'URL da Imagem do Logo', 'default' => 'assets/img/logo.png'],
                'brand_text' => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto da Marca', 'default' => 'Domain<span class="text-primary">System</span>'],
                'height'     => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Altura do Logo', 'units' => ['px', 'rem'], 'default' => '40px'],
                'show_image' => ['type' => 'boolean', 'label' => 'Exibir Imagem', 'default' => true],
                'show_text'  => ['type' => 'boolean', 'label' => 'Exibir Texto da Marca', 'default' => true],
                'link'       => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Link de Destino', 'default' => '/'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Navegação e Menu Dinâmico com Suporte aos 4 Estilos de Toggle Mobile.
 */
class NavMenuBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;

    private ?MenuProviderInterface $menuProvider;
    /** @var (\Closure(): ?MenuProviderInterface)|null */
    private ?\Closure $menuProviderResolver;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;
    private PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;

    /**
     * @param MenuProviderInterface|null $menuProvider
     * @param (\Closure(): ?MenuProviderInterface)|null $menuProviderResolver
     * @param ElementStyleRendererInterface|null $styleRenderer
     * @param HtmlSanitizerInterface|null $htmlSanitizer
     * @param PublicUrlResolverInterface|null $urlResolver
     */
    public function __construct(
        ?MenuProviderInterface $menuProvider = null,
        ?\Closure $menuProviderResolver = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null
    ) {
        $this->menuProvider = $menuProvider;
        $this->menuProviderResolver = $menuProviderResolver;
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
        $this->urlResolver = $urlResolver ?? new BaseUrlResolver();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'nav_menu';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Menu de Navegação';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🧭';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'navigation';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $baseUrl = $this->urlResolver->getBaseUrl();
        $location = (string)($data['menu_location'] ?? 'header');
        $rawToggleStyle = (string)($data['toggle_style'] ?? MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC);
        $toggleStyle = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '', $rawToggleStyle) ?: MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC;
        $align = (string)($data['align'] ?? 'center');
        $justifyNav = match ($align) {
            'left'  => 'flex-start',
            'right' => 'flex-end',
            default => 'center',
        };

        $toggleAlign = (string)($data['toggle_align'] ?? $data['align'] ?? 'right');
        $linkColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['link_color'] ?? 'var(--color-text-main, #c5c6c7)'));
        $activeColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['active_color'] ?? 'var(--color-primary, #38bdf8)'));
        $fontFamily = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['font_family']) ? (string)$data['font_family'] : 'var(--font-primary, inherit)'
        );
        $fontSize = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['font_size']) ? (string)$data['font_size'] : '0.95rem'
        );
        $hoverAnim = (string)($data['hover_animation'] ?? 'underline');
        $justifyToggle = match ($toggleAlign) {
            'left'   => 'flex-start',
            'center' => 'center',
            'right'  => 'flex-end',
            default  => 'flex-end',
        };

        $drawerSide = ($toggleAlign === 'left') ? 'left: 0; transform: translateX(-105%);' : 'right: 0; transform: translateX(105%);';

        $items = $this->resolveMenuItems($data, $location);
        if (empty($items)) {
            $items = [
                ['title' => 'Início', 'url' => $baseUrl . '/'],
                ['title' => 'Cursos', 'url' => $baseUrl . '/cursos'],
                ['title' => 'Sobre', 'url' => $baseUrl . '/sobre'],
                ['title' => 'Painel', 'url' => $baseUrl . '/admin'],
            ];
        }

        $navId = 'ds_nav_' . substr(md5(uniqid((string)mt_rand(), true)), 0, 8);
        $currentUri = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH);

        // Renderiza itens desktop
        $animClass = match ($hoverAnim) {
            'pill_glow', 'pill' => ' ds-nav-anim-pill',
            'grow'              => ' ds-nav-anim-grow',
            'bracket'           => ' ds-nav-anim-bracket',
            'none'              => '',
            default             => ' ds-nav-anim-underline',
        };

        $desktopLinks = [];
        $mobileLinks = [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $title = htmlspecialchars((string)($item['title'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $safeUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl((string)($item['url'] ?? '#'), '#');
            $url = htmlspecialchars($safeUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $isActive = ($currentUri === $url || ($url !== $baseUrl . '/' && $url !== '#' && str_starts_with((string)$currentUri, (string)$url)));

            $itemColor = $isActive ? $activeColor : $linkColor;
            $activeClass = $isActive ? ' active' : '';
            $activeStyle = "color: {$itemColor};" . ($isActive ? ' font-weight: 700;' : '');

            $desktopLinks[] = "<li style=\"margin: 0;\"><a href=\"{$url}\" class=\"ds-nav-link{$activeClass}{$animClass}\" style=\"{$activeStyle} text-decoration: none; font-family: {$fontFamily}; font-size: {$fontSize}; transition: all 0.25s ease;\">{$title}</a></li>";
            $mobileLinks[] = "<li style=\"margin: 0;\"><a href=\"{$url}\" class=\"ds-mobile-nav-link{$activeClass}\" style=\"{$activeStyle} display: block; padding: 10px 14px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 1rem; font-family: {$fontFamily};\">{$title}</a></li>";
        }

        $desktopUl = implode("\n", $desktopLinks);
        $mobileUl = implode("\n", $mobileLinks);

        // Ícone / Markup do Botão Hamburguer conforme o Contrato
        $toggleContent = match ($toggleStyle) {
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_PILL    => '<span style="font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:1px; margin-right:4px;">MENU</span> &#9776;',
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_MINIMAL => '<span style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; width:20px;"><span style="height:2px; background:currentColor; border-radius:2px;"></span><span style="height:2px; background:currentColor; border-radius:2px;"></span></span>',
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_DOTS    => '&#8942;',
            default                                   => '&#9776;',
        };

        return <<<HTML
<div id="{$navId}" class="ds-block-nav-wrapper" style="display:flex; justify-content:{$justifyNav}; width:100%;">
    <style>
        #{$navId} .ds-desktop-menu {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: {$justifyNav};
            gap: 24px;
            list-style: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            width: 100%;
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-link {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 4px 6px;
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-link:hover, #{$navId} .ds-nav-link.active {
            color: {$activeColor} !important;
        }
        /* HOVER ANIMATIONS */
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-underline::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            bottom: -2px;
            left: 50%;
            background: {$activeColor};
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-underline:hover::after, #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-underline.active::after {
            width: 100%;
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-pill {
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 6px 14px;
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-pill:hover, #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-pill.active {
            background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-grow:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-bracket::before {
            content: '[';
            opacity: 0;
            margin-right: 4px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            color: {$activeColor};
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-bracket::after {
            content: ']';
            opacity: 0;
            margin-left: 4px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            color: {$activeColor};
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-bracket:hover::before, #{$navId} .ds-nav-anim-bracket:hover::after {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-wrapper {
            display: none;
            width: 100%;
            justify-content: {$justifyToggle};
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-btn {
            display: none;
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2);
            color: var(--primary, #45f3ff);
            padding: 6px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-mobile-drawer {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            {$drawerSide}
            bottom: 0;
            width: 80vw;
            max-width: 320px;
            background: rgba(11, 14, 18, 0.98);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            z-index: 1150;
            padding: 24px;
            box-shadow: -10px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 16px;
            transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-mobile-drawer.is-open {
            transform: translateX(0);
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-mobile-backdrop {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.65);
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            z-index: 1140;
        }
        #{$navId} .ds-mobile-backdrop.is-open {
            display: block;
        }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$navId} .ds-desktop-menu { display: none !important; }
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-wrapper { display: flex !important; }
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-btn { display: inline-flex !important; }
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$navId} .ds-mobile-drawer { display: flex !important; }
        }
        .ds-mobile-mode #{$navId} .ds-desktop-menu,
        .ds-is-mobile #{$navId} .ds-desktop-menu,
        .ds-device-375 #{$navId} .ds-desktop-menu,
        .ds-device-768 #{$navId} .ds-desktop-menu {
            display: none !important;
        }
        .ds-mobile-mode #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-wrapper,
        .ds-is-mobile #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-wrapper,
        .ds-device-375 #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-wrapper,
        .ds-device-768 #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-wrapper {
            display: flex !important;
        }
        .ds-mobile-mode #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-btn,
        .ds-is-mobile #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-btn,
        .ds-device-375 #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-btn,
        .ds-device-768 #{$navId} .ds-mobile-toggle-btn {
            display: inline-flex !important;
        }
        .ds-mobile-mode #{$navId} .ds-mobile-drawer,
        .ds-is-mobile #{$navId} .ds-mobile-drawer,
        .ds-device-375 #{$navId} .ds-mobile-drawer,
        .ds-device-768 #{$navId} .ds-mobile-drawer {
            display: flex !important;
        }
    </style>

    <!-- Menu Desktop -->
    <nav class="ds-desktop-nav" aria-label="Menu Principal">
        <ul class="ds-desktop-menu">
            {$desktopUl}
        </ul>
    </nav>

    <!-- Botão Toggle Mobile com Alinhamento Configurável -->
    <div class="ds-mobile-toggle-wrapper">
        <button type="button" class="ds-mobile-toggle-btn ds-toggle-{$toggleStyle}" onclick="window.toggleDsNavDrawer('{$navId}', true)" aria-label="Abrir Menu">
            {$toggleContent}
        </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Backdrop & Gaveta Mobile -->
    <div class="ds-mobile-backdrop" id="{$navId}_backdrop" onclick="window.toggleDsNavDrawer('{$navId}', false)"></div>
    <aside class="ds-mobile-drawer" id="{$navId}_drawer">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding-bottom:12px;">
            <span style="font-weight:800; font-size:0.85rem; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--primary, #45f3ff);">Navegação</span>
            <button type="button" onclick="window.toggleDsNavDrawer('{$navId}', false)" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border:none; color:#fff; width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer;">✕</button>
        </div>
        <ul style="list-style:none; padding:0; margin:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;">
            {$mobileUl}
        </ul>
    </aside>

    <script>
        if (!window.toggleDsNavDrawer) {
            window.toggleDsNavDrawer = function(navId, open) {
                const drawer = document.getElementById(navId + '_drawer');
                const backdrop = document.getElementById(navId + '_backdrop');
                if (!drawer || !backdrop) return;
                if (open) {
                    drawer.classList.add('is-open');
                    backdrop.classList.add('is-open');
                } else {
                    drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
                    backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
                }
            };
            window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.ds-mobile-drawer.is-open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('is-open'));
                    document.querySelectorAll('.ds-mobile-backdrop.is-open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('is-open'));
                }
            });
        }
    </script>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    private function resolveMenuItems(array $data, string $location): array
    {
        $provider = $this->menuProvider;
        if ($provider === null && $this->menuProviderResolver !== null) {
            try {
                $provider = ($this->menuProviderResolver)();
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $provider = null;
            }
        }

        if ($provider === null) {
            return [];
        }

        try {
            $menuId = !empty($data['menu_id']) ? (int)$data['menu_id'] : null;
            return $provider->getMenuItems($location, $menuId);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        return [];
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'nav_menu',
            'fields' => [
                'menu_location' => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Local do Menu', 'options' => ['header', 'footer', 'custom'], 'default' => 'header'],
                'menu_id'       => ['type' => 'number', 'label' => 'ID Específico do Menu (Opcional)', 'default' => 0],
                'toggle_style'  => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Estilo do Botão Hamburguer', 'options' => ['classic', 'pill', 'minimal', 'dots'], 'default' => 'classic'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/ParagraphBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Parágrafo / Texto Corrido.
 */
class ParagraphBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;

    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'paragraph';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Parágrafo (Texto)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '📄';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'typography';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $text = (string)($data['text'] ?? '');
        $size = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['size'] ?? $data['font_size'] ?? ''));
        $color = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['color'] ?? ''));
        $align = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['align'] ?? 'left'));
        $lineHeight = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['line_height'] ?? '1.7'));
        $fontFamily = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_family'] ?? ''));

        $resolvedFont = ($fontFamily !== '' && $fontFamily !== 'primary')
            ? ($fontFamily === 'secondary' ? 'var(--font-secondary, monospace)' : $fontFamily)
            : 'var(--font-primary, sans-serif)';

        $styles = [
            "text-align: {$align}",
            "line-height: {$lineHeight}",
            "margin: 0",
            "font-family: {$resolvedFont}",
        ];

        if ($size !== '') {
            $styles[] = "font-size: {$size}";
        }
        if ($color !== '') {
            $styles[] = "color: {$color}";
        } else {
            $styles[] = "color: var(--color-text-muted, #8b8c8d)";
        }

        $styleAttr = implode('; ', $styles) . ';';
        // Sanitização segura de HTML inline contra XSS (atributos on*, javascript:, etc.)
        $sanitized = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeInlineHtml($text);

        return "<p class=\"ds-block-paragraph\" style=\"{$styleAttr}\">{$sanitized}</p>";
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'paragraph',
            'fields' => [
                'text'        => ['type' => 'textarea', 'label' => 'Conteúdo do Texto', 'default' => 'Texto do parágrafo.'],
                'size'        => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Tamanho da Fonte', 'units' => ['rem', 'px', 'em'], 'default' => '1.05rem'],
                'color'       => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor', 'default' => 'var(--color-text-muted)'],
                'align'       => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right', 'justify'], 'default' => 'left'],
                'line_height' => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Altura de Linha', 'default' => '1.7'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/PostCardsGridBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PostProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Providers\MockPostProvider;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits\StylableElementTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Grade de Artigos do Blog (PostCardsGridBlock) com Contratos SOLID e SEO Semântico.
 * 
 * Renderiza cards responsivos em CSS Grid (1 a 4 colunas), integração nativa com Design Tokens,
 * marcação Schema.org/BlogPosting para SEO de alta performance e lazy-loading de imagens.
 */
class PostCardsGridBlock implements BlockInterface, StylableElementInterface
{
    use StylableElementTrait;

    private PostProviderInterface $postProvider;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;

    public function __construct(
        ?PostProviderInterface $postProvider = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null
    ) {
        $this->postProvider = $postProvider ?? new MockPostProvider();
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'post_cards_grid';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Grid de Artigos (Blog Cards)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '📰';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'content';
    }

    public function getAllowedPartTypes(): array
    {
        return [ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION];
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'columns' => [
                'type' => 'select',
                'label' => 'Colunas no Desktop',
                'options' => [
                    ['value' => '1', 'label' => '1 Coluna (Lista Cheia)'],
                    ['value' => '2', 'label' => '2 Colunas (50% / 50%)'],
                    ['value' => '3', 'label' => '3 Colunas (Padrão Blog)'],
                    ['value' => '4', 'label' => '4 Colunas (Grid Compacto)'],
                ],
                'default' => '3',
            ],
            'limit' => [
                'type' => 'number',
                'label' => 'Limite de Artigos',
                'default' => 6,
                'min' => 1,
                'max' => 24,
            ],
            'card_style' => [
                'type' => 'select',
                'label' => 'Estilo dos Cards',
                'options' => [
                    ['value' => 'cyber_glass', 'label' => 'Cyber Glass (Glassmorphism & Glow)'],
                    ['value' => 'minimal', 'label' => 'Minimalista (Clean & Tipográfico)'],
                    ['value' => 'bordered', 'label' => 'Bordas Definidas (Contraste Token)'],
                    ['value' => 'flat', 'label' => 'Flat Surface (Preenchimento Sólido)'],
                ],
                'default' => 'cyber_glass',
            ],
            'hover_effect' => [
                'type' => 'select',
                'label' => 'Efeito Hover',
                'options' => [
                    ['value' => 'lift', 'label' => 'Elevação 3D (Lift suave)'],
                    ['value' => 'glow', 'label' => 'Brilho Neon (Glow Primário)'],
                    ['value' => 'border_accent', 'label' => 'Realce de Borda (Color Accent)'],
                    ['value' => 'none', 'label' => 'Sem Animação'],
                ],
                'default' => 'lift',
            ],
            'gap' => [
                'type' => 'text',
                'label' => 'Espaçamento (Gap)',
                'default' => '24px',
            ],
            'show_image' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Imagem Destacada',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'show_date' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Data de Publicação',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'show_author' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Autor',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'show_excerpt' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Resumo (Excerto)',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'show_read_more' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Link "Ler Artigo"',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'read_more_text' => [
                'type' => 'text',
                'label' => 'Texto do Botão / Link',
                'default' => 'Ler Artigo →',
            ],
        ];
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;

        $rawCols = (int)($data['columns'] ?? 3);
        $columns = in_array($rawCols, [1, 2, 3, 4], true) ? $rawCols : 3;

        $limit = max(1, (int)($data['limit'] ?? 6));
        $rawCardStyle = (string)($data['card_style'] ?? 'cyber_glass');
        $cardStyle = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '', $rawCardStyle) ?: 'cyber_glass';
        $rawHoverEffect = (string)($data['hover_effect'] ?? 'lift');
        $hoverEffect = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '', $rawHoverEffect) ?: 'lift';
        $gap = !empty($data['gap']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['gap']) : '24px';

        $showImage = (bool)($data['show_image'] ?? true);
        $showDate = (bool)($data['show_date'] ?? true);
        $showAuthor = (bool)($data['show_author'] ?? true);
        $showExcerpt = (bool)($data['show_excerpt'] ?? true);
        $showReadMore = (bool)($data['show_read_more'] ?? true);
        $readMoreText = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['read_more_text'] ?? 'Ler Artigo →'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        // Se o usuário passou posts manuais estáticos no schema, usa-os; caso contrário consulta o provedor
        if (isset($data['manual_posts']) && is_array($data['manual_posts']) && !empty($data['manual_posts'])) {
            $posts = array_slice($data['manual_posts'], 0, $limit);
        } else {
            $posts = $this->postProvider->getPosts(['limit' => $limit]);
        }

        if (empty($posts)) {
            return '<div class="ds-post-cards-empty" style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted, #8b8c8d); font-family: var(--font-primary, sans-serif);">'
                 . '<p>Nenhum artigo encontrado para exibição no momento.</p>'
                 . '</div>';
        }

        $cardsHtml = [];
        foreach ($posts as $post) {
            $title = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['title'] ?? 'Sem Título'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $excerpt = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['excerpt'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $safePostUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl((string)($post['url'] ?? '#'), '#');
            $url = htmlspecialchars($safePostUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $author = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['author'] ?? 'Redação'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $publishedAt = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['published_at'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $category = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['category'] ?? 'Artigo'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $rawFeaturedImage = !empty($post['featured_image']) ? $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl((string)$post['featured_image'], '') : '';
            $featuredImage = $rawFeaturedImage !== '' ? htmlspecialchars($rawFeaturedImage, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';
            $readingTime = !empty($post['reading_time']) ? htmlspecialchars((string)$post['reading_time'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';

            $imageHtml = '';
            if ($showImage) {
                if ($featuredImage !== '') {
                    $imageHtml = "<div class=\"ds-card-thumb\">\n"
                               . "    <a href=\"{$url}\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n"
                               . "        <img src=\"{$featuredImage}\" alt=\"{$title}\" loading=\"lazy\" itemprop=\"image\" class=\"ds-card-img\">\n"
                               . "    </a>\n"
                               . "    <span class=\"ds-card-badge\">{$category}</span>\n"
                               . "</div>\n";
                } else {
                    $imageHtml = "<div class=\"ds-card-thumb ds-card-thumb-placeholder\">\n"
                               . "    <span class=\"ds-card-badge\">{$category}</span>\n"
                               . "</div>\n";
                }
            }

            $metaParts = [];
            if ($showDate && $publishedAt !== '') {
                $metaParts[] = "<time itemprop=\"datePublished\" datetime=\"{$publishedAt}\">{$publishedAt}</time>";
            }
            if ($showAuthor && $author !== '') {
                $metaParts[] = "<span itemprop=\"author\" itemscope itemtype=\"https://schema.org/Person\"><span itemprop=\"name\">{$author}</span></span>";
            }
            if ($readingTime !== '') {
                $metaParts[] = "<span class=\"ds-card-reading-time\">{$readingTime}</span>";
            }
            $metaHtml = !empty($metaParts) ? "<div class=\"ds-card-meta\">\n    " . implode(" • \n    ", $metaParts) . "\n</div>\n" : '';

            $excerptHtml = ($showExcerpt && $excerpt !== '') ? "<p class=\"ds-card-excerpt\" itemprop=\"description\">{$excerpt}</p>\n" : '';
            $readMoreHtml = $showReadMore ? "<div class=\"ds-card-footer\">\n    <a href=\"{$url}\" class=\"ds-card-readmore\" itemprop=\"url\">{$readMoreText}</a>\n</div>\n" : '';

            $cardsHtml[] = <<<HTML
<article class="ds-post-card ds-style-{$cardStyle} ds-hover-{$hoverEffect}" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/BlogPosting">
    {$imageHtml}
    <div class="ds-card-content">
        {$metaHtml}
        <h3 class="ds-card-title" itemprop="headline">
            <a href="{$url}" itemprop="mainEntityOfPage">{$title}</a>
        </h3>
        {$excerptHtml}
        {$readMoreHtml}
    </div>
</article>
HTML;
        }

        $allCards = implode("\n", $cardsHtml);

        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-post-cards-grid ds-cols-{$columns}" style="--ds-grid-cols: {$columns}; --ds-grid-gap: {$gap};">
{$allCards}
</div>
<style>
.ds-post-cards-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--ds-grid-cols, 3), minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: var(--ds-grid-gap, 24px);
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
@media (max-width: 992px) {
    .ds-post-cards-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(min(var(--ds-grid-cols, 3), 2), minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
    }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .ds-post-cards-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    }
}
.ds-post-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease;
    font-family: var(--font-primary, 'Inter', sans-serif);
}
.ds-style-cyber_glass {
    background: var(--surface, rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.7));
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15));
}
.ds-style-minimal {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08));
    border-radius: 0;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
}
.ds-style-bordered {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18));
}
.ds-style-flat {
    background: var(--surface, #1f2833);
    border: none;
}
.ds-hover-lift:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.ds-hover-glow:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 25px var(--color-primary, #38bdf8);
    border-color: var(--color-primary, #38bdf8);
}
.ds-hover-border_accent:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-primary, #38bdf8);
}
.ds-card-thumb {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0f172a;
}
.ds-card-img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
    transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}
.ds-post-card:hover .ds-card-img {
    transform: scale(1.05);
}
.ds-card-thumb-placeholder {
    height: 80px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15), rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.8));
}
.ds-card-badge {
    position: absolute;
    top: 12px;
    left: 12px;
    background: var(--color-primary, #38bdf8);

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/ShortcodeBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;

/**
 * Bloco de Shortcode do Sistema (Execução Dinâmica com 1-Clique).
 */
class ShortcodeBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;
    private ?ShortcodeManager $shortcodeManager;
    /** @var (\Closure(): ?ShortcodeManager)|null */
    private ?\Closure $shortcodeResolver;

    /**
     * @param ShortcodeManager|null $shortcodeManager
     * @param (\Closure(): ?ShortcodeManager)|null $shortcodeResolver
     */
    public function __construct(?ShortcodeManager $shortcodeManager = null, ?\Closure $shortcodeResolver = null)
    {
        $this->shortcodeManager = $shortcodeManager;
        $this->shortcodeResolver = $shortcodeResolver;
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'shortcode';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Shortcode Dinâmico';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '⚡';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'system';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $code = trim((string)($data['code'] ?? $data['tag'] ?? ''));
        if ($code === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $sm = $this->shortcodeManager;
        if ($sm === null && $this->shortcodeResolver !== null) {
            try {
                $sm = ($this->shortcodeResolver)();
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $sm = null;
            }
        }

        if ($sm !== null) {
            return $sm->parse($code);
        }

        return $code;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'shortcode',
            'fields' => [
                'code' => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Código do Shortcode (ex: [hub_de_cursos])', 'default' => '[hub_de_cursos]'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/SocialIconsBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Icons\SvgIconRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Icons\DefaultSvgIconsFactory;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits\StylableElementTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values\ColorValue;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Redes Sociais com Vetores SVG Nativos Puros (SOLID - SRP / OCP).
 * 
 * Suporta formatos vetoriais puros (sem dependência de fontes externas como FontAwesome),
 * cores oficiais das marcas ou cores conectadas aos Design Tokens, 4 formatos de silhueta
 * (circle, rounded, square, minimal) e micro-interações de hover.
 */
class SocialIconsBlock implements BlockInterface, StylableElementInterface
{
    use StylableElementTrait;
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;

    private SvgIconRegistryInterface $iconRegistry;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;

    public function __construct(
        ?SvgIconRegistryInterface $iconRegistry = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null
    ) {
        $this->iconRegistry = $iconRegistry ?? DefaultSvgIconsFactory::create();
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'social_icons';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Redes Sociais (SVG Vetorial)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🌐';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'contact';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;

        $networksRaw = $data['networks'] ?? [
            ['network' => 'instagram', 'url' => 'https://instagram.com'],
            ['network' => 'whatsapp',  'url' => 'https://wa.me/5511999999999'],
            ['network' => 'youtube',   'url' => 'https://youtube.com'],
        ];

        // Normalização defensiva: aceita array associativo clássico ['github' => 'url'] ou lista de objetos
        $itemsList = [];
        if (is_array($networksRaw)) {
            foreach ($networksRaw as $key => $val) {
                if (is_array($val)) {
                    $net = (string)($val['network'] ?? '');
                    $url = (string)($val['url'] ?? '');
                } else {
                    $net = (string)$key;
                    $url = (string)$val;
                }
                $net = strtolower(trim($net));
                $url = trim($url);
                if ($net !== '' && $url !== '') {
                    $itemsList[] = ['network' => $net, 'url' => $url];
                }
            }
        }

        if (empty($itemsList)) {
            return '';
        }

        $shape = (string)($data['shape'] ?? 'circle');
        $colorMode = (string)($data['color_mode'] ?? 'official'); // 'official' | 'custom'
        $hoverAnim = (string)($data['hover_animation'] ?? 'lift');
        $align = (string)($data['align'] ?? 'center');
        $gap = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['gap'] ?? '12px'));
        $iconSize = (int)preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string)($data['icon_size'] ?? '20')) ?: 20;
        $buttonSize = (int)preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string)($data['button_size'] ?? '40')) ?: 40;

        // Resolução de cores personalizadas via Design Tokens
        $customIconColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            ColorValue::fromString((string)($data['icon_color'] ?? '#ffffff'))->toCss()
        );
        $customBgColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            ColorValue::fromString((string)($data['bg_color'] ?? 'var(--color-surface, #1f2833)'))->toCss()
        );

        $borderRadius = match ($shape) {
            'circle'  => '50%',
            'rounded' => '10px',
            'square'  => '0px',
            default   => '0px',
        };

        $animClass = match ($hoverAnim) {
            'grow'   => 'ds-btn-grow',
            'lift'   => 'ds-btn-lift',
            'glow'   => 'ds-btn-glow',
            'bounce' => 'ds-btn-bounce',
            default  => '',
        };

        $justify = match ($align) {
            'left'   => 'flex-start',
            'right'  => 'flex-end',
            default  => 'center',
        };

        $renderedIcons = [];
        foreach ($itemsList as $item) {
            $net = $item['network'];
            $safeItemUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($item['url'], '#');
            $url = htmlspecialchars($safeItemUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $label = $this->iconRegistry->getLabel($net) ?? ucfirst($net);
            $officialBrandColor = $this->iconRegistry->getBrandColor($net) ?? '#38bdf8';

            if ($colorMode === 'official') {
                if ($shape === 'minimal') {
                    $itemFill = $officialBrandColor;
                    $itemBg = 'transparent';
                } else {
                    $itemFill = '#ffffff';
                    $itemBg = $officialBrandColor;
                }
            } else {
                $itemFill = $customIconColor;
                $itemBg = ($shape === 'minimal') ? 'transparent' : $customBgColor;
            }

            $svgHtml = $this->iconRegistry->getSvg($net, [
                'width'  => (string)$iconSize,
                'height' => (string)$iconSize,
                'fill'   => $itemFill,
            ]);

            if ($svgHtml === null) {
                // Fallback seguro caso seja uma rede desconhecida
                $svgHtml = $this->iconRegistry->getSvg('website', [
                    'width'  => (string)$iconSize,
                    'height' => (string)$iconSize,
                    'fill'   => $itemFill,
                ]);
            }

            $btnStyle = "display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: {$buttonSize}px; height: {$buttonSize}px; border-radius: {$borderRadius}; background: {$itemBg}; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);";

            $renderedIcons[] = "<a href=\"{$url}\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" aria-label=\"{$label}\" class=\"ds-social-btn {$animClass}\" style=\"{$btnStyle}\">{$svgHtml}</a>";
        }

        $iconsOutput = implode("\n", $renderedIcons);

        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-social-wrapper" style="display: flex; gap: {$gap}; justify-content: {$justify}; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; width: 100%;">
    {$iconsOutput}
</div>
HTML;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'social_icons',
            'fields' => [
                'networks' => [
                    'type'    => 'repeater',
                    'label'   => 'Redes Sociais',
                    'default' => [
                        ['network' => 'instagram', 'url' => 'https://instagram.com'],
                        ['network' => 'whatsapp',  'url' => 'https://wa.me/5511999999999'],
                        ['network' => 'youtube',   'url' => 'https://youtube.com'],
                    ],
                ],
                'shape' => [
                    'type'    => 'select',
                    'label'   => 'Formato da Silhueta',
                    'options' => [
                        'circle'  => 'Círculo (50%)',
                        'rounded' => 'Cantos Arredondados (Rounded)',
                        'square'  => 'Quadrado (Square)',
                        'minimal' => 'Minimalista (Sem Fundo)',
                    ],
                    'default' => 'circle',
                ],
                'color_mode' => [
                    'type'    => 'select',
                    'label'   => 'Esquema de Cores',
                    'options' => [
                        'official' => 'Cores Oficiais das Marcas',
                        'custom'   => 'Cores Personalizadas (Design Tokens)',
                    ],
                    'default' => 'official',
                ],
                'icon_color' => [
                    'type'    => 'color',
                    'label'   => 'Cor do Ícone (Modo Custom)',
                    'default' => '#ffffff',
                ],
                'bg_color' => [
                    'type'    => 'color',
                    'label'   => 'Cor de Fundo (Modo Custom)',
                    'default' => 'var(--color-surface)',
                ],
                'hover_animation' => [
                    'type'    => 'select',
                    'label'   => 'Animação no Hover',
                    'options' => [
                        'lift'   => 'Elevar com Sombra (Lift)',
                        'grow'   => 'Aumentar Escala (Grow)',
                        'glow'   => 'Brilho Fluorescente (Glow)',
                        'bounce' => 'Salto Suave (Bounce)',
                        'none'   => 'Nenhuma Animação',
                    ],
                    'default' => 'lift',
                ],
                'icon_size' => [
                    'type'    => 'dimension',
                    'label'   => 'Tamanho do Ícone',
                    'default' => '20px',
                ],
                'button_size' => [
                    'type'    => 'dimension',
                    'label'   => 'Tamanho do Botão',
                    'default' => '40px',
                ],
                'gap' => [
                    'type'    => 'dimension',
                    'label'   => 'Espaçamento Entre Ícones',
                    'default' => '12px',
                ],
                'align' => [
                    'type'    => 'select',
                    'label'   => 'Alinhamento',
                    'options' => ['left' => 'Esquerda', 'center' => 'Centro', 'right' => 'Direita'],
                    'default' => 'center',
                ],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/VideoBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Vídeo Responsivo (YouTube, Vimeo, MP4 com modo cinema).
 */
class VideoBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;

    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;

    public function __construct(
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null
    ) {
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'video';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Vídeo';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🎥';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'media';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $rawUrl = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? ''));
        if ($rawUrl === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $url = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($rawUrl, '');
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $aspectRatio = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['aspect_ratio'] ?? '16/9'));
        $borderRadius = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['border_radius'] ?? '10px'));

        $embedUrl = $this->resolveEmbedUrl($url);

        if ($embedUrl !== null) {
            return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-video" style="width: 100%; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: {$borderRadius}; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: {$aspectRatio}; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
    <iframe src="{$embedUrl}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none;" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>
HTML;
        }

        // Caso seja MP4 direto
        $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-video" style="width: 100%; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: {$borderRadius}; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: {$aspectRatio}; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
    <video src="{$safeUrl}" controls style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;"></video>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    private function resolveEmbedUrl(string $url): ?string
    {
        // YouTube
        if (preg_match('#(?:youtube\.com/(?:watch\?v=|embed/)|youtu\.be/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)#', $url, $m)) {
            return 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' . $m[1];
        }
        // Vimeo
        if (preg_match('#vimeo\.com/(?:video/)?([0-9]+)#', $url, $m)) {
            return 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' . $m[1];
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'video',
            'fields' => [
                'url'           => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'URL do Vídeo (YouTube, Vimeo ou MP4)', 'default' => ''],
                'aspect_ratio'  => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Proporção', 'options' => ['16/9', '4/3', '1/1'], 'default' => '16/9'],
                'border_radius' => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Arredondamento', 'units' => ['px', 'rem'], 'default' => '10px'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Contracts/Icons/SvgIconRegistryInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Icons;

/**
 * Contrato para o Catálogo e Registro de Ícones Vetoriais SVG (SOLID - OCP / Ring 0).
 * 
 * Permite renderizar vetores SVG puros inline com personalização de cores,
 * atributos e estilos, sem dependência de bibliotecas externas de fontes (FontAwesome, etc.).
 */
interface SvgIconRegistryInterface
{
    /**
     * Registra uma nova definição vetorial no catálogo.
     *
     * @param string $name Identificador do ícone (ex: 'whatsapp', 'instagram')
     * @param string $viewBox Dimensões do viewBox (ex: '0 0 24 24')
     * @param string $pathData Conteúdo interno do SVG (<path d="..."/>)
     * @param string|null $brandColor Cor hexadecimal oficial da marca (ex: '#25D366')
     * @param string|null $label Rótulo legível (ex: 'WhatsApp')
     */
    public function register(
        string $name,
        string $viewBox,
        string $pathData,
        ?string $brandColor = null,
        ?string $label = null
    ): void;

    /**
     * Renderiza o markup completo da tag <svg> para o ícone solicitado.
     *
     * @param string $name Nome do ícone registrado
     * @param array<string, string> $attributes Atributos HTML extras (width, height, fill, class, style)
     * @return string|null Retorna a tag <svg> compilada ou null se o ícone não existir
     */
    public function getSvg(string $name, array $attributes = []): ?string;

    /**
     * Retorna a cor oficial da marca associada ao ícone (se houver).
     */
    public function getBrandColor(string $name): ?string;

    /**
     * Retorna o rótulo legível do ícone.
     */
    public function getLabel(string $name): ?string;

    /**
     * Verifica se o ícone está registrado.
     */
    public function has(string $name): bool;

    /**
     * Retorna todos os dados brutos registrados.
     * @return array<string, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function all(): array;

    /**
     * Retorna lista associativa simplificada [ 'name' => 'Label' ] para seletores de UI.
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function getAvailableIcons(): array;
}

/**

    public function buildTree(ThemePartInterface $part): array;

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Contracts/MenuProviderInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato Ring 0 para Provedor de Itens de Menu (DIP - Desacoplamento de SystemApps).
 */
interface MenuProviderInterface
{
    /**
     * Retorna a lista de menus cadastrados no sistema.
     *
     * @return array<int, array{id: int, name: string, location?: string}>

    public const BREAKPOINT_LAPTOP  = 'laptop';  // 1024px

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Contracts/ThemePartAssociationInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de Associação e Vínculo: Tema <-> Header / Footer / Seções de Template Ativos.
 */
interface ThemePartAssociationInterface
{
    /**
     * Retorna o ID da parte atribuída a um tema específico.
     * Retorna null se não houver parte customizada (acionando fallback nativo do tema).
     */
    public function getAssignedPartId(string $themeFolder, string $partType): ?string;

    /**
     * Associa uma parte (header, footer ou template:slug) a um tema específico.
     * Passar $partId = null remove o vínculo customizado (restaura fallback nativo).
     */
    public function assignPart(string $themeFolder, string $partType, ?string $partId): bool;

    /**
     * Define a parte padrão global do sistema para um determinado tipo.
     */
    public function setGlobalDefault(string $partType, ?string $partId): bool;

    /**
     * Retorna o ID da parte padrão global.
     */
    public function getGlobalDefault(string $partType): ?string;

    /**
     * Retorna o mapa completo de todas as atribuições registradas ('themes' e 'globals').
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function getAllAssignments(): array;

    /**
     * Retorna as atribuições exclusivas de um tema específico ([partType => partId]).
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function getThemeAssignments(string $themeFolder): array;

    /**
     * Retorna o slug do template (ex: 'home', 'sobre') ao qual uma seção está atribuída em um tema, ou null.
     */
    public function getAssignedTemplateForSection(string $themeFolder, string $sectionId): ?string;

    /**
     * Atribui exclusivamente uma seção a um template do tema (removendo vínculos anteriores da mesma seção).
     * Passar $templateSlug = null ou 'none' desvincula a seção de qualquer template no tema.
     */
    public function assignTemplateToSection(string $themeFolder, string $sectionId, ?string $templateSlug): bool;

    /**
     * Remove todas as referências e vínculos de uma parte excluída em todos os temas e padrões globais.
     */
    public function removePartReferences(string $partId): bool;
}

    public function renderSection(string $sectionId, array $context = []): string;

    /**
     * Renderiza a seção customizada atribuída diretamente a um template (ex: home, sobre, blog).
     * Retorna string vazia caso não haja seção atribuída ao template.
     */
    public function renderTemplateSection(string $themeFolder, string $templateName, array $context = []): string;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Grid/LayoutGridRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Grid;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayoutGridInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Layout\LayoutPresetRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;

/**
 * Motor de Renderização de Grade e Divisórias (CSS Grid / Flexbox) (SOLID - OCP / DIP).
 * 
 * Totalmente extensível via LayoutPresetRegistryInterface: novos layouts podem ser adicionados
 * por plugins ou código de temas sem alterar o motor interno (Open-Closed Principle).
 */
class LayoutGridRenderer implements LayoutGridInterface
{
    private LayoutPresetRegistryInterface $presetRegistry;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        ?LayoutPresetRegistryInterface $presetRegistry = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->presetRegistry = $presetRegistry ?? DefaultLayoutPresetsFactory::create();
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
    }

    public function getPresetRegistry(): LayoutPresetRegistryInterface
    {
        return $this->presetRegistry;
    }

    public function getPresets(): array
    {
        return $this->presetRegistry->allAsArray();
    }

    public function renderSection(string $preset, array $columnsHtml, array $settings = []): string
    {
        $presetObj = $this->presetRegistry->get($preset) ?? $this->presetRegistry->get('1_col');
        $presetConfig = $presetObj !== null ? $presetObj->toArray() : [
            'columns'  => 1,
            'template' => '1fr',
            'tablet'   => '1fr',
            'mobile'   => '1fr',
        ];

        $sectionId = 'ds_sec_' . substr(md5(uniqid((string)mt_rand(), true)), 0, 8);

        $isBoxed = (bool)($settings['boxed'] ?? true);
        $maxWidth = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['max_width'] ?? '1280px'));
        if ($maxWidth === '') {
            $maxWidth = '1280px';
        }

        $rawGap = (string)($settings['gap'] ?? '24px');
        $mappedGap = match ($rawGap) {
            'none'   => '0px',
            'small'  => '12px',
            'medium' => '24px',
            'large'  => '40px',
            default  => $rawGap !== '' ? $rawGap : '24px',
        };
        $gap = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue($mappedGap);
        if ($gap === '') {
            $gap = '24px';
        }

        $alignItems = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['align_items'] ?? 'center'));
        if ($alignItems === '') {
            $alignItems = 'center';
        }

        $justifyContent = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['justify_content'] ?? 'space-between'));
        if ($justifyContent === '') {
            $justifyContent = 'space-between';
        }

        $padding = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['padding'] ?? '20px 16px'));
        if ($padding === '') {
            $padding = '20px 16px';
        }

        $margin = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['margin'] ?? '0px'));
        if ($margin === '') {
            $margin = '0px';
        }

        $background = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['background'] ?? 'transparent'));
        if ($background === '') {
            $background = 'transparent';
        }

        $customClass = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s]/', '', (string)($settings['custom_class'] ?? '')) ?? '';
        $combinedClasses = trim("ds-section-wrapper {$customClass}");

        // Estilos Visuais Avançados da Seção (Bordas, Sombras, Opacidade)
        $borderVal = !empty($settings['border']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['border']) : '';
        $borderRadiusVal = !empty($settings['border_radius']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['border_radius']) : '';
        $boxShadowVal = !empty($settings['box_shadow']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['box_shadow']) : '';
        $opacityVal = (isset($settings['opacity']) && (string)$settings['opacity'] !== '' && (string)$settings['opacity'] !== '1')
            ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['opacity'])
            : '';

        $border = $borderVal !== '' ? "border: {$borderVal};" : '';
        $borderRadius = $borderRadiusVal !== '' ? "border-radius: {$borderRadiusVal};" : '';
        $boxShadow = $boxShadowVal !== '' ? "box-shadow: {$boxShadowVal};" : '';
        $opacity = $opacityVal !== '' ? "opacity: {$opacityVal};" : '';

        $extraStyles = array_filter([$border, $borderRadius, $boxShadow, $opacity]);
        $extraStylesStr = !empty($extraStyles) ? ' ' . implode(' ', $extraStyles) : '';

        $baseDesktopTemplate = $presetConfig['template'];
        $baseTabletTemplate = $presetConfig['tablet'];
        $baseMobileTemplate = $presetConfig['mobile'];

        $numCols = (int)$presetConfig['columns'];
        $colHiddenMap = is_array($settings['_col_hidden'] ?? null) ? $settings['_col_hidden'] : [];

        $gridTemplate = $this->resolveResponsiveGridTemplate($baseDesktopTemplate, $numCols, $colHiddenMap, 'desktop');
        $laptopTemplate = $this->resolveResponsiveGridTemplate($baseDesktopTemplate, $numCols, $colHiddenMap, 'laptop');
        $tabletTemplate = $this->resolveResponsiveGridTemplate($baseTabletTemplate, $numCols, $colHiddenMap, 'tablet');
        $mobileTemplate = $this->resolveResponsiveGridTemplate($baseMobileTemplate, $numCols, $colHiddenMap, 'mobile');

        $colsOutput = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $numCols; $i++) {
            $colContent = $columnsHtml[$i] ?? '';
            $colVisClasses = [];
            if (!empty($colHiddenMap[$i]['desktop'])) {
                $colVisClasses[] = 'ds-hide-desktop';
            }
            if (!empty($colHiddenMap[$i]['laptop'])) {
                $colVisClasses[] = 'ds-hide-laptop';
            }
            if (!empty($colHiddenMap[$i]['tablet'])) {
                $colVisClasses[] = 'ds-hide-tablet';
            }
            if (!empty($colHiddenMap[$i]['mobile'])) {
                $colVisClasses[] = 'ds-hide-mobile';
            }
            $colClassStr = trim("ds-grid-col ds-grid-col-{$i} " . implode(' ', $colVisClasses));
            $colsOutput[] = "<div class=\"{$colClassStr}\">{$colContent}</div>";
        }
        $innerHtml = implode("\n", $colsOutput);

        $containerStyle = $isBoxed
            ? "max-width: {$maxWidth}; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; width: 100%;"
            : "width: 100%;";

        return <<<HTML
<div id="{$sectionId}" class="{$combinedClasses}" style="background: {$background}; width: 100%; margin: {$margin};{$extraStylesStr}">
    <style>
        #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: {$gridTemplate};
            gap: {$gap};
            align-items: {$alignItems};
            justify-content: {$justifyContent};
            box-sizing: border-box;
            padding: {$padding};
            {$containerStyle}
        }
        #{$sectionId} .ds-grid-col {
            min-width: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        @media (min-width: 769px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
                grid-template-columns: {$laptopTemplate} !important;
            }
        }
        @media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 768px) {
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
                grid-template-columns: {$tabletTemplate} !important;
                gap: 16px !important;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
                grid-template-columns: {$mobileTemplate} !important;
                gap: 12px !important;
                padding-left: 12px !important;
                padding-right: 12px !important;
            }
        }
        .ds-laptop-mode #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-is-laptop #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-device-1024 #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
            grid-template-columns: {$laptopTemplate} !important;
        }
        .ds-tablet-mode #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-is-tablet #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-device-768 #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
            grid-template-columns: {$tabletTemplate} !important;
            gap: 16px !important;
        }
        .ds-mobile-mode #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-is-mobile #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-device-375 #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
            grid-template-columns: {$mobileTemplate} !important;
            gap: 12px !important;
            padding-left: 12px !important;
            padding-right: 12px !important;
        }
    </style>
    <div class="ds-section-grid">
        {$innerHtml}
    </div>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    /**
     * Reajusta dinamicamente as colunas do CSS Grid quando todos os elementos de uma ou mais colunas
     * estão ocultos na resolução alvo, redistribuindo 100% da largura entre as colunas visíveis restantes.
     *
     * @param array<int, array<string, bool>> $colHiddenMap
     */
    private function resolveResponsiveGridTemplate(
        string $baseTemplate,
        int $numCols,
        array $colHiddenMap,
        string $resolution
    ): string {
        if ($numCols <= 1 || empty($colHiddenMap)) {
            return $baseTemplate;
        }

        $visibleIndices = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $numCols; $i++) {
            if (empty($colHiddenMap[$i][$resolution])) {
                $visibleIndices[] = $i;
            }
        }

        $visibleCount = count($visibleIndices);
        if ($visibleCount === $numCols || $visibleCount === 0) {
            return $baseTemplate;
        }

        if ($visibleCount === 1) {
            return '1fr';
        }

        $tracks = $this->parseGridTracks($baseTemplate);
        if (count($tracks) === $numCols) {
            $remainingTracks = [];
            foreach ($visibleIndices as $idx) {
                $remainingTracks[] = $tracks[$idx];
            }
            return implode(' ', $remainingTracks);
        }

        return $baseTemplate;
    }

    /**
     * Divide um template CSS Grid em suas tracks individuais (suportando repeat() e funções como minmax()).
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function parseGridTracks(string $template): array
    {
        $trimmed = trim($template);
        if (preg_match('/^repeat\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(.+)\)$/i', $trimmed, $m)) {
            $count = max(1, (int)$m[1]);
            return array_fill(0, $count, trim($m[2]));
        }

        $tracks = [];
        $current = '';
        $depth = 0;
        $len = strlen($trimmed);

        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $ch = $trimmed[$i];
            if ($ch === '(') {
                $depth++;
                $current .= $ch;
            } elseif ($ch === ')') {
                $depth = max(0, $depth - 1);
                $current .= $ch;
            } elseif (ctype_space($ch) && $depth === 0) {
                if ($current !== '') {
                    $tracks[] = $current;
                    $current = '';
                }
            } else {
                $current .= $ch;
            }
        }

        if ($current !== '') {
            $tracks[] = $current;
        }

        return $tracks;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Grid;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Layout\LayoutPresetInterface;

/**
 * Value Object Imutável para Definição de Preset de Layout (SOLID - SRP).
 */
class LayoutPreset implements LayoutPresetInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $id,
        private readonly string $name,
        private readonly int $columns,
        private readonly string $desktopTemplate,
        private readonly string $tabletTemplate,
        private readonly string $mobileTemplate,
        private readonly string $category = 'grid',
        private readonly string $icon = '📐'
    ) {}

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return $this->id;
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return $this->name;
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return $this->category;
    }

    public function getColumns(): int
    {
        return $this->columns;
    }

    public function getDesktopTemplate(): string
    {
        return $this->desktopTemplate;
    }

    public function getTabletTemplate(): string
    {
        return $this->tabletTemplate;
    }

    public function getMobileTemplate(): string
    {
        return $this->mobileTemplate;
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return $this->icon;
    }

    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'id'       => $this->id,
            'name'     => $this->name,
            'columns'  => $this->columns,
            'template' => $this->desktopTemplate,
            'tablet'   => $this->tabletTemplate,
            'mobile'   => $this->mobileTemplate,
            'category' => $this->category,
            'icon'     => $this->icon,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Grid/LayoutPresetRegistry.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Grid;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Layout\LayoutPresetInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Layout\LayoutPresetRegistryInterface;

/**
 * Registro dinâmico de Presets de Grade e Layout (SOLID - OCP).
 */
class LayoutPresetRegistry implements LayoutPresetRegistryInterface
{
    /** @var array<string, LayoutPresetInterface> */
    private array $presets = [];

    public function register(LayoutPresetInterface $preset): void
    {
        $this->presets[$preset->getId()] = $preset;
    }

    public function get(string $id): ?LayoutPresetInterface
    {
        return $this->presets[$id] ?? null;
    }

    public function has(string $id): bool
    {
        return isset($this->presets[$id]);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->presets;
    }

    public function allAsArray(): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach ($this->presets as $id => $preset) {
            $result[$id] = $preset->toArray();
        }
        return $result;
    }

    public function allByCategory(): array
    {
        $grouped = [];
        foreach ($this->presets as $preset) {
            $cat = $preset->getCategory();
            if (!isset($grouped[$cat])) {
                $grouped[$cat] = [];
            }
            $grouped[$cat][] = $preset;
        }
        return $grouped;
    }
}

            '<path d="M6.62 10.79c1.44 2.83 3.76 5.14 6.59 6.59l2.2-2.2c.27-.27.67-.36 1.02-.24 1.12.37 2.33.57 3.57.57.55 0 1 .45 1 1V20c0 .55-.45 1-1 1-9.39 0-17-7.61-17-17 0-.55.45-1 1-1h3.5c.55 0 1 .45 1 1 0 1.25.2 2.45.57 3.57.11.35.03.74-.25 1.02l-2.2 2.2z"/>',
            '#34A853',
            'Telefone'
        );

        $registry->register(
            'website',
            '0 0 24 24',
            '<path d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.48 10 10 10 10-4.48 10-10S17.52 2 12 2zm-1 17.93c-3.95-.49-7-3.85-7-7.93 0-.62.08-1.21.21-1.79L9 15v1c0 1.1.9 2 2 2v1.93zm6.9-2.54c-.26-.81-1-1.39-1.9-1.39h-1v-3c0-.55-.45-1-1-1H8v-2h2c.55 0 1-.45 1-1V7h2c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2v-.41c2.93 1.19 5 4.06 5 7.41 0 2.08-.8 3.97-2.1 5.39z"/>',
            '#4285F4',

        return $registry;
