/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Controllers/CourseAdminController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseService;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use Throwable;

class CourseAdminController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private CourseService $service;
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private ThemePageResolverInterface|ThemeManagerInterface|null $pageResolver;
    private ?PublicStorageInterface $storage;
    private ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $repository,
        CourseService $service,
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo = null,
        ThemePageResolverInterface|ThemeManagerInterface|null $pageResolver = null,
        ?PublicStorageInterface $storage = null,
        ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder = null
    ) {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->service = $service;
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->pageResolver = $pageResolver;
        $this->storage = $storage;
        $this->scaffolder = $scaffolder;
    }

    public function index(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $courses = $this->repository->findAll();
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $flashType = $flash['type'] ?? null;
        $flashMsg = $flash['msg'] ?? null;

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/courses/index', [
            'courses'   => $courses,
            'csrfToken' => $csrfToken,
            'baseUrl'   => $baseUrl,
            'flashType' => $flashType,
            'flashMsg'  => $flashMsg,
            'storage'   => $this->storage,
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function edit(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById((int)$id);
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $flashType = $flash['type'] ?? null;
        $flashMsg = $flash['msg'] ?? null;

        $initialStructure = [];
        $availablePages = [];

        if ($this->structureRepo !== null) {
            $modules = $this->structureRepo->getModules((int)$course['id']);
            $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);
            $availablePages = $this->resolvePublicThemePages();

            $lessonsByMod = [];
            $standaloneLessons = [];
            foreach ($allLessons as $l) {
                $mId = $l['module_id'] !== null ? (int)$l['module_id'] : null;
                if ($mId !== null && $mId > 0) {
                    $lessonsByMod[$mId][] = $l;
                } else {
                    $standaloneLessons[] = $l;
                }
            }

            foreach ($modules as $m) {
                $mId = (int)$m['id'];
                $initialStructure[] = [
                    'id'          => $mId,
                    'title'       => (string)$m['title'],
                    'folder_slug' => (string)($m['folder_slug'] ?? ''),
                    'position'    => (int)$m['position'],
                    'lessons'     => array_map(static function (array $les): array {
                        return [
                            'id'             => (int)$les['id'],
                            'title'          => (string)$les['title'],
                            'slug'           => (string)$les['slug'],
                            'source_type'    => (string)$les['source_type'],
                            'source'         => (string)($les['source'] ?? ''),
                            'content'        => (string)($les['content'] ?? ''),
                            'mobile_profile' => (string)($les['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer'),
                            'status'         => (string)($les['status'] ?? 'published'),
                        ];
                    }, $lessonsByMod[$mId] ?? []),
                ];
            }

            if (!empty($standaloneLessons)) {
                $initialStructure[] = [
                    'title'       => 'Módulo Geral',
                    'folder_slug' => '',
                    'position'    => 999,
                    'lessons'     => array_map(static function (array $les): array {
                        return [
                            'id'             => (int)$les['id'],
                            'title'          => (string)$les['title'],
                            'slug'           => (string)$les['slug'],
                            'source_type'    => (string)$les['source_type'],
                            'source'         => (string)($les['source'] ?? ''),
                            'content'        => (string)($les['content'] ?? ''),
                            'mobile_profile' => (string)($les['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer'),
                            'status'         => (string)($les['status'] ?? 'published'),
                        ];
                    }, $standaloneLessons),
                ];
            }
        }

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/courses/edit', [
            'course'           => $course,
            'csrfToken'        => $csrfToken,
            'baseUrl'          => $baseUrl,
            'flashType'        => $flashType,
            'flashMsg'         => $flashMsg,
            'storage'          => $this->storage,
            'hasStructureRepo' => $this->structureRepo !== null,
            'initialStructure' => $initialStructure,
            'availablePages'   => $availablePages,
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    /**
     * Cria uma pasta física dentro de pages/ do tema ativo e adiciona o módulo correspondente ao curso.
     */
    public function createThemeFolder(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)$id;

        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $course = $this->repository->findById($courseId);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $folderName = trim((string)($request->input('folder_name') ?? ''));
        if ($folderName === '') {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "O nome da pasta/módulo é obrigatório.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        try {
            $folderSlug = null;
            $relDir = '';
            if ($this->scaffolder !== null) {
                $folderInfo = $this->scaffolder->createFolder($folderName);
                $relDir = (string)($folderInfo['relative_path'] ?? '');
                $folderSlug = (string)($folderInfo['slug'] ?? $this->scaffolder->slugify($folderName));
            }

            if ($this->structureRepo !== null) {
                $existingModules = $this->structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
                $nextPos = count($existingModules) + 1;
                if (method_exists($this->structureRepo, 'createModule')) {
                    $this->structureRepo->createModule($courseId, $folderName, $nextPos, $folderSlug);
                }
            }

            $msg = $relDir !== ''
                ? "Pasta '{$relDir}' e módulo '{$folderName}' criados com sucesso!"
                : "Módulo '{$folderName}' criado com sucesso!";
            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao criar pasta/módulo: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
    }

    public function updateStructure(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)$id;

        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $course = $this->repository->findById($courseId);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        if ($this->structureRepo === null) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Repositório de estrutura não disponível.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $rawJson = $request->input('structure_json');
        if (!empty($rawJson)) {
            $structure = json_decode((string)$rawJson, true);
            if (!is_array($structure)) {
                $this->session->setFlash('error', "Formato da estrutura inválido.");
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
            }
        } else {
            $structure = $request->input('structure', []);
            if (!is_array($structure)) {
                $structure = [];
            }
        }

        $autoFabricate = (string)($request->input('auto_fabricate_php') ?? '') === '1';

        try {
            $fabricatedFilesCount = 0;

            if ($this->scaffolder !== null) {
                foreach ($structure as &$modData) {
                    $folderSlug = isset($modData['folder_slug']) && trim((string)$modData['folder_slug']) !== ''
                        ? trim((string)$modData['folder_slug'])
                        : null;

                    if ($folderSlug !== null && $autoFabricate) {
                        $this->scaffolder->createFolder($folderSlug);
                    }

                    if (!isset($modData['lessons']) || !is_array($modData['lessons'])) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    foreach ($modData['lessons'] as &$lesson) {
                        $title = trim((string)($lesson['title'] ?? ''));
                        if ($title === '') {
                            continue;
                        }

                        $srcType = (string)($lesson['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
                        $source = trim((string)($lesson['source'] ?? ''));
                        $shouldFabricate = !empty($lesson['auto_fabricate'])
                            || ($autoFabricate && ($source === '' || $srcType === 'content'));

                        if ($shouldFabricate) {
                            $rawContent = (string)($lesson['content'] ?? '');

                            $fabricated = $this->scaffolder->fabricateLessonFile(
                                $title,
                                $folderSlug,
                                $rawContent !== '' ? $rawContent : null,
                                (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer')
                            );

                            if (empty($lesson['slug']) || preg_match('/^aula-\d+$/', (string)$lesson['slug'])) {
                                $lesson['slug'] = $fabricated['slug'];
                            }
                            if ($source === '') {
                                $lesson['source'] = $fabricated['relative_path'];
                            }
                            $fabricatedFilesCount++;
                        }
                    }
                    unset($lesson);
                }
                unset($modData);
            }

            $this->structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($courseId, $structure);
            $extraMsg = $fabricatedFilesCount > 0 ? " ({$fabricatedFilesCount} arquivo(s) .php fabricado(s) em pages/)" : '';
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Estrutura do curso atualizada com sucesso!{$extraMsg}");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao atualizar estrutura: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $file = $this->extractUploadedThumbnail($request);
            $data = [
                'title'       => $request->input('title'),
                'description' => $request->input('description'),
                'status'      => $request->input('status'),
                'link'        => $request->input('link'),
            ];

            $this->service->createCourse($data, $file);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso cadastrado com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao cadastrar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    public function update(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $file = $this->extractUploadedThumbnail($request);
            $data = [
                'title'       => $request->input('title'),
                'description' => $request->input('description'),
                'status'      => $request->input('status'),
                'link'        => $request->input('link'),
            ];

            $this->service->updateCourse((int)$id, $data, $file);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso atualizado com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao atualizar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $id);
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    public function delete(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $this->service->deleteCourse((int)$id);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso excluído com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao excluir curso: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    private function extractUploadedThumbnail(Request $request): ?array
    {
        $file = $request->file('thumbnail');
        if ($file && (empty($file['tmp_name']) || ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE)) {
            return null;
        }
        if ($file && ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            if ($file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE || $file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo de imagem enviado excedeu o tamanho máximo permitido pelo servidor.");
            }
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Erro no envio do arquivo de imagem (Código: " . ($file['error'] ?? 'desconhecido') . ").");
        }
        return $file;
    }

    private function verifyCsrfToken(Request $request): bool
    {
        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();

        if ($token === '' || $expected === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return hash_equals($expected, $token);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function resolvePublicThemePages(): array
    {
        if ($this->pageResolver instanceof ThemePageResolverInterface) {
            return $this->pageResolver->resolvePublicThemePages();
        }

        if ($this->pageResolver instanceof ThemeManagerInterface) {
            $pages = $this->pageResolver->getAvailablePages();
            $pages = array_values(array_unique($pages));
            natsort($pages);
            return array_values($pages);
        }

        return [];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return '';
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Controllers/CourseFrontController.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseCatalogRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonBlockRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\seo\Contracts\SeoManagerInterface;
use Throwable;

class CourseFrontController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private CourseNavigationInterface $navService;
    private CourseCatalogRendererInterface $catalogRenderer;
    private ?SeoManagerInterface $seo;
    private ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;
    private LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer;
    private ?ThemePageResolverInterface $pageResolver;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        CourseNavigationInterface $navService,
        CourseCatalogRendererInterface $catalogRenderer,
        ?SeoManagerInterface $seo = null,
        ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer = new LessonBlockRenderer(),
        ?ThemePageResolverInterface $pageResolver = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->navService = $navService;
        $this->catalogRenderer = $catalogRenderer;
        $this->seo = $seo;
        $this->themeManager = $themeManager;
        $this->blockRenderer = $blockRenderer;
        $this->pageResolver = $pageResolver;
    }

    /**
     * Catálogo geral de cursos: GET /cursos
     */
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        if ($this->seo !== null) {
            $this->seo->setTitle('Cursos & Tutoriais | Academy')
                ->setDescription('Explore os cursos e tutoriais disponíveis na plataforma Academy.');
        }

        $catalogHtml = $this->catalogRenderer->render();

        $themePath = $this->resolveActiveThemePath();
        $academyTemplateCandidate = $themePath !== '' ? ($themePath . '/templates/academy.php') : '';

        if ($this->themeManager !== null && $academyTemplateCandidate !== '' && file_exists($academyTemplateCandidate)) {
            try {
                $html = $this->themeManager->render('templates/academy', [
                    'page' => [
                        'title'   => 'Cursos & Tutoriais',
                        'content' => $catalogHtml,
                    ],
                ]);
                return new Response($html);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Fallback para renderização direta
            }
        }

        $html = $this->renderView('front/catalog', [
            'catalogHtml' => $catalogHtml,
        ]);

        return new Response($html);
    }

    /**
     * Página de apresentação do curso ou acesso direto a uma aula/página fabricada: GET /cursos/{courseSlug}
     */
    public function showCourse(string $courseSlug): Response
    {
        $course = $this->courseRepo->findBySlug($courseSlug);

        // Suporte a link direto /cursos/{lessonSlug} (ex: /cursos/estrutura-de-dados -> pages/estrutura-de-dados.php)
        if (!$course) {
            if (method_exists($this->structureRepo, 'findPublishedLessonGloballyBySlug')) {
                $directLesson = $this->structureRepo->findPublishedLessonGloballyBySlug($courseSlug);
                if ($directLesson) {
                    $parentCourse = $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$directLesson['course_id']);
                    if ($parentCourse && ($parentCourse['status'] ?? '') === 'published') {
                        return $this->showLesson((string)$parentCourse['slug'], (string)$directLesson['slug']);
                    }
                }
            }

            $candidateThemeFile = 'pages/' . ltrim($courseSlug, '/\\') . '.php';
            if ($this->themeFileExists($candidateThemeFile)) {
                $renderedFile = $this->renderThemeFile($candidateThemeFile, [
                    'course'   => ['title' => 'Academy', 'slug' => 'cursos'],
                    'lesson'   => ['title' => ucwords(str_replace('-', ' ', $courseSlug)), 'slug' => $courseSlug],
                    'adjacent' => ['prev' => null, 'next' => null],
                    'navHtml'  => '',
                ]);
                return new Response($renderedFile);
            }

            return new Response("<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1><p>Não encontramos o curso solicitado: [" . htmlspecialchars($courseSlug, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "]</p>", 404);
        }

        if (($course['status'] ?? '') === 'draft') {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1><p>Não encontramos o curso solicitado: [" . htmlspecialchars($courseSlug, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "]</p>", 404);
        }

        $title = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $desc = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['description'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        if ($this->seo !== null) {
            $this->seo->setTitle($title . ' | Academy')
                ->setDescription(mb_substr(strip_tags((string)($course['description'] ?? '')), 0, 150) . '...');
        }

        $navHtml = $this->navService->renderCourseNav($courseSlug);
        $tree = $this->navService->getCourseTree($courseSlug);

        $firstLessonUrl = null;
        if (($course['status'] ?? '') === 'published') {
            foreach ($tree as $mod) {
                if (!empty($mod['lessons'])) {
                    $firstLessonUrl = $mod['lessons'][0]['url'] ?? null;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        $ctaButton = '';
        if ($firstLessonUrl) {
            $ctaButton = "<a href='{$firstLessonUrl}' class='btn btn-primary' style='display:inline-block; margin-top:20px; text-decoration:none;'>🚀 Começar Agora &rarr;</a>";
        }

        $html = $this->renderView('front/course', [
            'title'     => $title,
            'desc'      => $desc,
            'ctaButton' => $ctaButton,
            'navHtml'   => $navHtml,
        ]);

        return new Response($html);
    }

    /**
     * Exibição de aula específica com sidebar navegável e 3 Perfis Mobile: GET /cursos/{courseSlug}/{lessonSlug}
     */
    public function showLesson(string $courseSlug, string $lessonSlug): Response
    {
        $course = $this->courseRepo->findBySlug($courseSlug);
        if (!$course) {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1>", 404);
        }
        if (($course['status'] ?? '') !== 'published') {
            $statusLabel = ($course['status'] ?? '') === 'soon' ? 'Em Breve' : 'Rascunho';
            return new Response(
                "<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1>" .
                "<p>O curso <strong>" . htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</strong> está com o status <strong>{$statusLabel}</strong>. Altere o status do curso para <strong>Publicado</strong> no painel Academy para liberar o acesso às aulas.</p>",
                404
            );
        }

        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getPublishedLessonBySlug((int)$course['id'], $lessonSlug);
        if (!$lesson || ($lesson['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Aula não encontrada</h1><p>A aula solicitada não existe ou está em rascunho neste curso.</p>", 404);
        }

        $lessonTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$lesson['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $courseTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        if ($this->seo !== null) {
            $plainDesc = $this->blockRenderer->extractPlainText((string)($lesson['content'] ?? ''));
            if ($plainDesc === '') {
                $plainDesc = strip_tags((string)($course['description'] ?? ''));
            }
            $this->seo->setTitle($lessonTitle . ' - ' . $courseTitle . ' | Academy')
                ->setDescription(mb_substr($plainDesc, 0, 150) . '...');
        }

        $navHtml = $this->navService->renderCourseNav($courseSlug, $lessonSlug);
        $adjacent = $this->navService->getAdjacentLessons($courseSlug, $lessonSlug);

        $bodyContent = '';
        $themeFile = $lesson['source'] ?? $lesson['theme_file'] ?? null;
        if (!empty($themeFile) && ($lesson['source_type'] ?? '') !== 'content') {
            $bodyContent = $this->renderThemeFile((string)$themeFile, [
                'course'   => $course,
                'lesson'   => $lesson,
                'adjacent' => $adjacent,
                'navHtml'  => $navHtml,
            ]);
        } elseif (!empty($lesson['content'])) {
            $bodyContent = $this->blockRenderer->render((string)$lesson['content']);
        } elseif (!empty($themeFile)) {
            $bodyContent = $this->renderThemeFile((string)$themeFile, [
                'course'   => $course,
                'lesson'   => $lesson,
                'adjacent' => $adjacent,
                'navHtml'  => $navHtml,
            ]);
        } else {
            $bodyContent = "<div class='ds-academy-empty-lesson' style='padding:40px; text-align:center; color:var(--text-muted);'><p>O conteúdo desta aula está sendo preparado.</p></div>";
        }

        $paginationHtml = $this->renderPagination($adjacent);
        $courseUrl = (defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '') . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug);
        $mobileProfile = (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer');

        $html = $this->renderView('front/lesson', [
            'courseUrl'      => $courseUrl,
            'courseTitle'    => $courseTitle,
            'lessonTitle'    => $lessonTitle,
            'bodyContent'    => $bodyContent,
            'navHtml'        => $navHtml,
            'paginationHtml' => $paginationHtml,
            'adjacent'       => $adjacent,
            'mobileProfile'  => $mobileProfile,
        ]);

        return new Response($html);
    }

    private function renderPagination(array $adjacent): string
    {
        $prev = $adjacent['prev'] ?? null;
        $next = $adjacent['next'] ?? null;

        if (!$prev && !$next) {
            return '';
        }

        $prevHtml = '';
        if ($prev) {
            $prevTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$prev['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $prevUrl = htmlspecialchars((string)$prev['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $prevHtml = "<a href='{$prevUrl}' class='btn btn-outline' style='text-decoration:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;'>
                &larr; Anterior: {$prevTitle}
            </a>";
        }

        $nextHtml = '';
        if ($next) {
            $nextTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$next['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $nextUrl = htmlspecialchars((string)$next['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $nextHtml = "<a href='{$nextUrl}' class='btn btn-primary' style='text-decoration:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;'>
                Próxima Aula: {$nextTitle} &rarr;
            </a>";
        }

        return "
        <nav class='ds-academy-pagination' aria-label='Navegação entre Aulas' style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:16px; margin-top:50px; padding-top:30px; border-top:1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15);'>
            <div>{$prevHtml}</div>
            <div>{$nextHtml}</div>
        </nav>";
    }

    private function themeFileExists(string $themeFile): bool
    {
        $themePath = $this->resolveActiveThemePath();
        if ($themePath === '') {
            return false;
        }
        $target = $themePath . '/' . ltrim($themeFile, '/\\');
        $realTarget = realpath($target);
        $realTheme = realpath($themePath);
        if ($realTarget === false || $realTheme === false) {
            return false;
        }
        $prefix = rtrim($realTheme, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
        return str_starts_with($realTarget, $prefix) && is_file($realTarget);
    }

    private function renderThemeFile(string $themeFile, array $context): string
    {
        $themePath = $this->resolveActiveThemePath();
        if ($themePath === '') {
            return "<div class='alert alert-warning' style='padding:20px; color:#ffb703; background:rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.1); border-radius:8px;'>Arquivo do tema não encontrado ou inacessível: " . htmlspecialchars($themeFile, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</div>";
        }

        $target = $themePath . '/' . ltrim($themeFile, '/\\');
        $realTarget = realpath($target);
        $realTheme = realpath($themePath);
        $realThemePrefix = $realTheme !== false ? rtrim($realTheme, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR : '';

        if ($realTarget === false || $realTheme === false || !str_starts_with($realTarget, $realThemePrefix) || !is_file($realTarget)) {
            return "<div class='alert alert-warning' style='padding:20px; color:#ffb703; background:rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.1); border-radius:8px;'>Arquivo do tema não encontrado ou inacessível: " . htmlspecialchars($themeFile, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</div>";
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($context, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $realTarget;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }

    private function resolveActiveThemePath(): string
    {
        if ($this->pageResolver !== null) {
            return $this->pageResolver->resolveActiveThemePath();
        }

        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $activePath = $this->themeManager->getActiveThemePath();
            if (!empty($activePath) && is_dir($activePath)) {
                return $activePath;
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return '';
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Controllers/LessonAdminController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use Throwable;

class LessonAdminController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->scaffolder = $scaffolder;
    }

    public function editor(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $lessonId = (int)$id;
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        if (!$lesson) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Aula não encontrada.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $course = $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$lesson['course_id']);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso vinculado à aula não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $moduleTitle = 'Módulo Geral';
        $moduleFolderSlug = null;
        $allModules = $this->structureRepo->getModules((int)$course['id']);
        $allCourseLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);
        if (!empty($lesson['module_id'])) {
            foreach ($allModules as $m) {
                if ((int)$m['id'] === (int)$lesson['module_id']) {
                    $moduleTitle = (string)$m['title'];
                    $moduleFolderSlug = !empty($m['folder_slug']) ? (string)$m['folder_slug'] : null;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        $prevLessonTitle = null;
        $nextLessonTitle = null;
        $flatLessons = array_values($allCourseLessons);
        foreach ($flatLessons as $idx => $fl) {
            if ((int)$fl['id'] === $lessonId) {
                if ($idx > 0) {
                    $prevLessonTitle = (string)$flatLessons[$idx - 1]['title'];
                }
                if ($idx < count($flatLessons) - 1) {
                    $nextLessonTitle = (string)$flatLessons[$idx + 1]['title'];
                }
                break;
            }
        }

        $rawContent = (string)($lesson['content'] ?? '');
        $initialBlocks = [];

        if ($rawContent !== '') {
            $decoded = json_decode($rawContent, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $initialBlocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : []);
            } else {
                $initialBlocks = [
                    [
                        'id'   => 'b_init_1',
                        'type' => 'paragraph',
                        'data' => ['text' => $rawContent],
                    ],
                ];
            }
        } elseif (!empty($lesson['source']) && $this->scaffolder !== null && method_exists($this->scaffolder, 'extractBlocksFromFile')) {
            $extractedJson = $this->scaffolder->extractBlocksFromFile((string)$lesson['source']);
            if (is_string($extractedJson) && $extractedJson !== '') {
                $decoded = json_decode($extractedJson, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    $initialBlocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : []);
                }
            }
        }

        if (empty($initialBlocks)) {
            $initialBlocks = [
                [
                    'id'   => 'b_init_h',
                    'type' => 'header',
                    'data' => ['level' => 2, 'text' => (string)$lesson['title']],
                ],
                [
                    'id'   => 'b_init_p',
                    'type' => 'paragraph',
                    'data' => ['text' => 'Digite aqui o conteúdo da aula ou adicione novos blocos abaixo...'],
                ],
            ];
        }

        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $siteLessonUrl = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode((string)$course['slug']) . '/' . urlencode((string)$lesson['slug']);

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/lessons/editor', [
            'lessonId'         => $lessonId,
            'lesson'           => $lesson,
            'course'           => $course,
            'moduleTitle'      => $moduleTitle,
            'moduleFolderSlug' => $moduleFolderSlug,
            'flatLessons'      => $flatLessons,
            'prevLessonTitle'  => $prevLessonTitle,
            'nextLessonTitle'  => $nextLessonTitle,
            'initialBlocks'    => $initialBlocks,
            'csrfToken'        => $csrfToken,
            'baseUrl'          => $baseUrl,
            'siteLessonUrl'    => $siteLessonUrl,
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function updateContent(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $lessonId = (int)$id;
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $rawBody = (string)file_get_contents('php://input');
        $jsonData = json_decode($rawBody, true);

        $token = '';
        $title = null;
        $status = null;
        $mobileProfile = null;
        $fabricatePhp = false;
        $blocks = null;

        if (is_array($jsonData)) {
            $token = (string)($jsonData['csrf_token'] ?? '');
            $title = isset($jsonData['title']) ? (string)$jsonData['title'] : null;
            $status = isset($jsonData['status']) ? (string)$jsonData['status'] : null;
            $mobileProfile = isset($jsonData['mobile_profile']) ? (string)$jsonData['mobile_profile'] : null;
            $fabricatePhp = !empty($jsonData['fabricate_php']);
            $blocks = $jsonData['blocks'] ?? null;
        } else {
            $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
            $title = $request->input('title');
            $status = $request->input('status');
            $mobileProfile = $request->input('mobile_profile');
            $fabricatePhp = !empty($request->input('fabricate_php'));
            $rawBlocks = $request->input('blocks_json');
            if ($rawBlocks) {
                $blocks = is_array($rawBlocks) ? $rawBlocks : json_decode((string)$rawBlocks, true);
            } elseif (is_array($request->input('blocks'))) {
                $blocks = $request->input('blocks');
            }
        }

        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token CSRF inválido']), 403, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/lessons/' . $lessonId . '/editor');
        }

        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        if (!$lesson) {
            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Aula não encontrada']), 404, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Aula não encontrada.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $contentToSave = is_array($blocks)
            ? (string)json_encode(['time' => time(), 'blocks' => $blocks], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)
            : '';

        $effectiveTitle = ($title !== null && trim($title) !== '') ? trim($title) : (string)$lesson['title'];
        $effectiveProfile = ($mobileProfile !== null && in_array($mobileProfile, ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'], true))
            ? $mobileProfile
            : (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer');

        $updateData = [
            'source_type'    => 'content',
            'content'        => $contentToSave,
            'mobile_profile' => $effectiveProfile,
        ];

        if ($title !== null && trim($title) !== '') {
            $updateData['title'] = $effectiveTitle;
        }
        if ($status !== null && in_array($status, ['published', 'draft'], true)) {
            $updateData['status'] = $status;
        }

        try {
            $fabricatedPath = null;
            if ($fabricatePhp && $this->scaffolder !== null) {
                $folderSlug = null;
                if (!empty($lesson['module_id'])) {
                    foreach ($this->structureRepo->getModules((int)$lesson['course_id']) as $m) {
                        if ((int)$m['id'] === (int)$lesson['module_id'] && !empty($m['folder_slug'])) {
                            $folderSlug = (string)$m['folder_slug'];
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                $fabricated = $this->scaffolder->fabricateLessonFile(
                    $effectiveTitle,
                    $folderSlug,
                    $contentToSave !== '' ? $contentToSave : null,
                    $effectiveProfile
                );
                $updateData['slug'] = $fabricated['slug'];
                $updateData['source'] = $fabricated['relative_path'];
                $fabricatedPath = $fabricated['relative_path'];
            }

            $this->structureRepo->updateLesson($lessonId, $updateData);

            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode([
                    'success'         => true,
                    'message'         => $fabricatedPath ? "Aula salva e arquivo '{$fabricatedPath}' fabricado!" : 'Aula salva com sucesso!',
                    'fabricated_path' => $fabricatedPath,
                ]), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Conteúdo da aula atualizado com sucesso!");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/lessons/' . $lessonId . '/editor');
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Erro ao salvar: ' . $e->getMessage(),
                ]), 500, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao salvar aula: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/lessons/' . $lessonId . '/editor');
        }
    }

    private function isAjax(Request $request): bool
    {
        $accept = (string)($request->server['HTTP_ACCEPT'] ?? '');
        $xrw = (string)($request->server['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH'] ?? '');
        $ct = (string)($request->server['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '');

        return str_contains($accept, 'application/json')
            || str_contains($xrw, 'XMLHttpRequest')
            || str_contains($ct, 'application/json');
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return '';
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseCatalogRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseImageStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonBlockRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseFrontController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\LessonAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseStructureRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseCatalogRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseNavigationService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LocalCourseImageStorage;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\ThemeLessonFileScaffolder;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\ThemePageResolver;
use Throwable;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->requireLink('core.storage');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('shortcodes.register');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // 1. Injeção de Dependências no Container via Contratos (DIP)
        $runtime->singleton(CourseRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoCourseRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoCourseStructureRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseImageStorageInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new LocalCourseImageStorage($runtime->getLink('core.storage'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseService::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new CourseService(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseImageStorageInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseNavigationInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
            return new CourseNavigationService(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class),
                $baseUrl
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseCatalogRendererInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new CourseCatalogRenderer(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->getLink('core.storage')
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseCatalogRenderer::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return $runtime->make(CourseCatalogRendererInterface::class);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(LessonBlockRendererInterface::class, function () {
            return new LessonBlockRenderer();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(LessonBlockRenderer::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return $runtime->make(LessonBlockRendererInterface::class);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePageResolverInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            $themeManager = null;
            try {
                if ($runtime->has(ThemeManagerInterface::class)) {
                    $themeManager = $runtime->make(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $themeManager = null;
            }
            return new ThemePageResolver($themeManager);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(LessonFileScaffolderInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new ThemeLessonFileScaffolder(
                $runtime->make(ThemePageResolverInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(LessonBlockRendererInterface::class)
            );
        });

        // 2. Menu Administrativo
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function ($menus, $role = 'guest') {
            if ($role === 'admin') {
                $menus[] = [
                    'title' => 'Academy (Cursos)',
                    'url'   => '/admin/academy',
                    'icon'  => '🎓',
                ];
            }
            return $menus;
        });

        // 3. Rotas Administrativas e Públicas
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function (Router $router) {
            // Administrativas - Cursos & Fábrica de Pastas/Arquivos
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy', [CourseAdminController::class, 'index'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy/edit/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'edit'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/store', [CourseAdminController::class, 'store'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/update/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'update'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/structure/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'updateStructure'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/scaffold/folder/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'createThemeFolder'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/delete/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'delete'], 'academy', ['admin']);

            // Administrativas - Editor em Blocos de Aulas
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy/lessons/{id}/editor', [LessonAdminController::class, 'editor'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/lessons/{id}/update-content', [LessonAdminController::class, 'updateContent'], 'academy', ['admin']);

            // Públicas
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cursos', [CourseFrontController::class, 'index'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cursos/{courseSlug}', [CourseFrontController::class, 'showCourse'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cursos/{courseSlug}/{lessonSlug}', [CourseFrontController::class, 'showLesson'], 'academy');
        });

        // 4. Shortcode: [hub_de_cursos]
        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function (\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $manager) use ($runtime) {
            $manager->add('hub_de_cursos', function ($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                try {
                    /** @var CourseCatalogRendererInterface $renderer */
                    $renderer = $runtime->make(CourseCatalogRendererInterface::class);
                    return $renderer->render(is_array($attrs) ? $attrs : []);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    return "<div style='text-align:center; padding:30px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:8px; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94);'>Hub de Cursos em configuração.</div>";
                }
            });
        });
    }

    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db');
        new PdoCourseRepository($db);
        $structureRepo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($db);
        $structureRepo->ensureTables();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

class PdoCourseRepository implements CourseRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTableExists();
        }
    }

    public function findAll(): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT * FROM academy_courses ORDER BY id DESC");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE slug = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findPublished(array $filters = []): array
    {
        $status = $filters['status'] ?? null;
        $limit = isset($filters['limit']) ? (int)$filters['limit'] : 12;
        if ($limit <= 0) {
            $limit = 12;
        }

        if (!empty($status)) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {$limit}");
            $stmt->execute([$status]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE status IN ('published', 'soon') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {$limit}");
            $stmt->execute();
        }

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_courses (title, slug, thumbnail, description, status, link)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            $data['title'],
            $data['slug'],
            $data['thumbnail'] ?? null,
            $data['description'] ?? null,
            $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
            $data['link'] ?? null,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function update(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE academy_courses
            SET title = ?, slug = ?, thumbnail = ?, description = ?, status = ?, link = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([
            $data['title'],
            $data['slug'],
            $data['thumbnail'] ?? null,
            $data['description'] ?? null,
            $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
            $data['link'] ?? null,
            $id
        ]);
    }

    public function delete(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_courses WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function ensureTableExists(): void
    {
        $migrationFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/migrations/2026_10_15_000001_create_academy_courses.php';
        if (is_file($migrationFile)) {
            $migration = require $migrationFile;
            if (is_array($migration) && isset($migration['up']) && is_callable($migration['up'])) {
                ($migration['up'])($this->pdo);
            }
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

class PdoCourseStructureRepository implements CourseStructureRepositoryInterface
{
    private const VALID_STATUSES = ['draft', 'published'];
    private const VALID_SOURCE_TYPES = ['theme_file', 'content'];
    private const VALID_MOBILE_PROFILES = ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'];

    private static array $accentMap = [
        'á'=>'a','à'=>'a','ã'=>'a','â'=>'a','ä'=>'a',
        'é'=>'e','è'=>'e','ê'=>'e','ë'=>'e',
        'í'=>'i','ì'=>'i','î'=>'i','ï'=>'i',
        'ó'=>'o','ò'=>'o','õ'=>'o','ô'=>'o','ö'=>'o',
        'ú'=>'u','ù'=>'u','û'=>'u','ü'=>'u',
        'ç'=>'c','ñ'=>'n',
        'Á'=>'a','À'=>'a','Ã'=>'a','Â'=>'a','Ä'=>'a',
        'É'=>'e','È'=>'e','Ê'=>'e','Ë'=>'e',
        'Í'=>'i','Ì'=>'i','Î'=>'i','Ï'=>'i',
        'Ó'=>'o','Ò'=>'o','Õ'=>'o','Ô'=>'o','Ö'=>'o',
        'Ú'=>'u','Ù'=>'u','Û'=>'u','Ü'=>'u',
        'Ç'=>'c','Ñ'=>'n'
    ];

    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tablesEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTables();
        }
    }

    public function getModules(int $courseId): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_modules 
            WHERE course_id = ? 
            ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function createModule(int $courseId, string $title, int $position = 0, ?string $folderSlug = null): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_modules (course_id, title, position, folder_slug) 
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $title, $position, $folderSlug]);
        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function updateModule(int $moduleId, array $data): bool
    {
        $fields = [];
        $values = [];

        if (isset($data['title'])) {
            $fields[] = 'title = ?';
            $values[] = $data['title'];
        }
        if (isset($data['position'])) {
            $fields[] = 'position = ?';
            $values[] = (int)$data['position'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('folder_slug', $data)) {
            $fields[] = 'folder_slug = ?';
            $values[] = $data['folder_slug'];
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            return false;
        }

        $values[] = $moduleId;
        $sql = "UPDATE academy_modules SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($values);
    }

    public function deleteModule(int $moduleId): bool
    {
        // Ao excluir módulo, desvincula as aulas para não perdê-las (ou exclui dependendo da regra)
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE academy_lessons SET module_id = NULL WHERE module_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$moduleId]);

        $del = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE id = ?");
        return $del->execute([$moduleId]);
    }

    public function getLessons(int $courseId, ?int $moduleId = null): array
    {
        if ($moduleId !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
                WHERE course_id = ? AND module_id = ? 
                ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$courseId, $moduleId]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
                WHERE course_id = ? 
                ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        }

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function getLessonById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND slug = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getPublishedLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND slug = ? AND status = 'published'");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findPublishedLessonGloballyBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
            WHERE slug = ? AND status = 'published' 
            ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function createLesson(array $data): int
    {
        $sourceType = (string)($data['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
        $status = (string)($data['status'] ?? 'published');
        $mobileProfile = (string)($data['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer');
        if (!in_array($mobileProfile, self::VALID_MOBILE_PROFILES, true)) {
            $mobileProfile = 'drawer';
        }

        $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);

        $rawSlug = trim((string)($data['slug'] ?? ''));
        $rawTitle = trim((string)($data['title'] ?? 'Aula'));
        $slug = $this->sanitizeSlug($rawSlug !== '' ? $rawSlug : $rawTitle, (int)($data['position'] ?? 1));

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_lessons (
                course_id, module_id, title, slug, source_type, source, content, mobile_profile, position, status
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            $data['course_id'],
            $data['module_id'] ?? null,
            $rawTitle !== '' ? $rawTitle : 'Aula',
            $slug,
            $sourceType,
            $data['source'] ?? null,
            $data['content'] ?? null,
            $mobileProfile,
            $data['position'] ?? 0,
            $status,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function updateLesson(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        if (array_key_exists('source_type', $data) || array_key_exists('status', $data)) {
            $sourceType = array_key_exists('source_type', $data) ? (string)$data['source_type'] : 'theme_file';
            $status = array_key_exists('status', $data) ? (string)$data['status'] : 'published';
            $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);
        }

        if (array_key_exists('mobile_profile', $data)) {
            $mp = (string)$data['mobile_profile'];
            $data['mobile_profile'] = in_array($mp, self::VALID_MOBILE_PROFILES, true) ? $mp : 'drawer';
        }

        if (array_key_exists('slug', $data)) {
            $data['slug'] = $this->sanitizeSlug((string)$data['slug'], (int)($data['position'] ?? 1));
        }

        $allowed = ['title', 'slug', 'module_id', 'source_type', 'source', 'content', 'mobile_profile', 'position', 'status'];
        $fields = [];
        $values = [];

        foreach ($allowed as $col) {
            if (array_key_exists($col, $data)) {
                $fields[] = "{$col} = ?";
                $values[] = $data[$col];
            }
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            return false;
        }

        $values[] = $id;
        $sql = "UPDATE academy_lessons SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($values);
    }

    public function deleteLesson(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    /**
     * Sincroniza a estrutura do curso por diff (H-04), preservando os IDs existentes de módulos
     * e aulas quando correspondem por ID (ou por slug do curso) e validando os campos (M-10).
     */
    public function replaceCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool
    {
        return $this->syncCourseStructure($courseId, $structure);
    }

    public function syncCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $existingModules = [];
            foreach ($this->getModules($courseId) as $m) {
                $existingModules[(int)$m['id']] = $m;
            }

            $existingLessonsById = [];
            $existingLessonsBySlug = [];
            foreach ($this->getLessons($courseId) as $l) {
                $lId = (int)$l['id'];
                $existingLessonsById[$lId] = $l;
                $existingLessonsBySlug[(string)$l['slug']] = $l;
            }

            $keptModuleIds = [];
            $keptLessonIds = [];
            $usedSlugs = [];

            $modulePos = 1;
            $lessonPosGlobal = 1;

            foreach ($structure as $modData) {
                $modTitle = trim((string)($modData['title'] ?? 'Módulo Geral'));
                if ($modTitle === '') {
                    $modTitle = 'Módulo Geral';
                }
                $folderSlug = isset($modData['folder_slug']) && trim((string)$modData['folder_slug']) !== ''
                    ? trim((string)$modData['folder_slug'])
                    : null;

                $candidateModId = isset($modData['id']) ? (int)$modData['id'] : 0;
                if ($candidateModId > 0 && isset($existingModules[$candidateModId]) && !in_array($candidateModId, $keptModuleIds, true)) {
                    $this->updateModule($candidateModId, [
                        'title'       => $modTitle,
                        'position'    => $modulePos++,
                        'folder_slug' => $folderSlug ?? ($existingModules[$candidateModId]['folder_slug'] ?? null),
                    ]);
                    $moduleId = $candidateModId;
                } else {
                    $moduleId = $this->createModule($courseId, $modTitle, $modulePos++, $folderSlug);
                }
                $keptModuleIds[] = $moduleId;

                $lessons = $modData['lessons'] ?? [];
                if (!is_array($lessons)) {
                    continue;
                }

                foreach ($lessons as $lesson) {
                    $pos = $lessonPosGlobal++;
                    $title = trim((string)($lesson['title'] ?? 'Aula'));
                    if ($title === '') {
                        $title = 'Aula ' . $pos;
                    }

                    $sourceType = (string)($lesson['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
                    $status = (string)($lesson['status'] ?? 'published');
                    $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);

                    $rawSlug = trim((string)($lesson['slug'] ?? ''));
                    $baseSlug = $this->sanitizeSlug($rawSlug !== '' ? $rawSlug : $title, $pos);
                    $slug = $this->deduplicateSlugInBatch($baseSlug, $usedSlugs);
                    $usedSlugs[$slug] = true;

                    $matchedLessonId = 0;
                    $candidateLessonId = isset($lesson['id']) ? (int)$lesson['id'] : 0;
                    if ($candidateLessonId > 0 && isset($existingLessonsById[$candidateLessonId]) && !in_array($candidateLessonId, $keptLessonIds, true)) {
                        $matchedLessonId = $candidateLessonId;
                    } elseif (isset($existingLessonsBySlug[$baseSlug])) {
                        $bySlugId = (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$baseSlug]['id'];
                        if (!in_array($bySlugId, $keptLessonIds, true)) {
                            $matchedLessonId = $bySlugId;
                        }
                    }

                    // Se vai atualizar ou criar com um slug que já pertence a outra aula do curso ainda no BD,
                    // limpa temporariamente o slug conflitante caso a outra aula vá ser removida/renomeada.
                    if (isset($existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]) && (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]['id'] !== $matchedLessonId) {
                        $conflictId = (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]['id'];
                        $tmpStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE academy_lessons SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?");
                        $tmpStmt->execute(['__tmp_' . $conflictId . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3)), $conflictId]);
                    }

                    $mobileProfile = (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? ($matchedLessonId > 0 ? ($existingLessonsById[$matchedLessonId]['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer') : 'drawer'));

                    $lessonPayload = [
                        'course_id'      => $courseId,
                        'module_id'      => $moduleId,
                        'title'          => $title,
                        'slug'           => $slug,
                        'source_type'    => $sourceType,
                        'source'         => $lesson['source'] ?? $lesson['theme_file'] ?? $lesson['file_path'] ?? null,
                        'content'        => $lesson['content'] ?? ($matchedLessonId > 0 ? ($existingLessonsById[$matchedLessonId]['content'] ?? null) : null),
                        'mobile_profile' => $mobileProfile,
                        'position'       => $pos,
                        'status'         => $status,
                    ];

                    if ($matchedLessonId > 0) {
                        $this->updateLesson($matchedLessonId, $lessonPayload);
                        $keptLessonIds[] = $matchedLessonId;
                    } else {
                        $newLessonId = $this->createLesson($lessonPayload);
                        $keptLessonIds[] = $newLessonId;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Remove apenas aulas que não fazem mais parte da estrutura
            if (empty($keptLessonIds)) {
                $delLessons = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ?");
                $delLessons->execute([$courseId]);
            } else {
                $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($keptLessonIds), '?'));
                $delLessons = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND id NOT IN ({$placeholders})");
                $delLessons->execute(array_merge([$courseId], $keptLessonIds));
            }

            // Remove apenas módulos que não fazem mais parte da estrutura
            if (empty($keptModuleIds)) {
                $delModules = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE course_id = ?");
                $delModules->execute([$courseId]);
            } else {
                $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($keptModuleIds), '?'));
                $delModules = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE course_id = ? AND id NOT IN ({$placeholders})");
                $delModules->execute(array_merge([$courseId], $keptModuleIds));
            }

            $this->pdo->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function ensureTables(): void
    {
        if ($this->tablesEnsured) {
            return;
        }

        $migrationFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/migrations/2026_10_15_000002_create_academy_structure.php';
        if (is_file($migrationFile)) {
            $migration = require $migrationFile;
            if (is_array($migration) && isset($migration['up']) && is_callable($migration['up'])) {
                ($migration['up'])($this->pdo);
            }
        }

        $this->tablesEnsured = true;
    }

    private function assertValidLessonEnums(string $sourceType, string $status): void
    {
        if (!in_array($sourceType, self::VALID_SOURCE_TYPES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Tipo de origem de aula inválido: {$sourceType}");
        }

        if (!in_array($status, self::VALID_STATUSES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Status de aula inválido: {$status}");
        }
    }

    private function sanitizeSlug(string $raw, int $fallbackPos = 1): string
    {
        $text = strtr($raw, self::$accentMap);
        if (function_exists('transliterator_transliterate')) {
            $trans = transliterator_transliterate('Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII; Lower()', $text);
            if ($trans !== false) {
                $text = $trans;
            }
        }

        $slug = strtolower(trim((string)preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/', '-', $text), '-'));
        return $slug !== '' ? $slug : ('aula-' . $fallbackPos);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, bool> $usedSlugs
     */
    private function deduplicateSlugInBatch(string $baseSlug, array $usedSlugs): string
    {
        $slug = $baseSlug;
        $counter = 1;
        while (isset($usedSlugs[$slug])) {
            $slug = "{$baseSlug}-{$counter}";
            $counter++;
        }
        return $slug;
    }
}
