<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseCatalogRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;

class CourseCatalogRenderer implements CourseCatalogRendererInterface
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private ?PublicStorageInterface $storage;

    public function __construct(CourseRepositoryInterface $repository, ?PublicStorageInterface $storage = null)
    {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->storage = $storage;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attrs Atributos do shortcode [hub_de_cursos limit="6" status="published"]
     */
    public function render(array $attrs = []): string
    {
        $limit = isset($attrs['limit']) ? (int)$attrs['limit'] : 12;
        if ($limit <= 0) {
            $limit = 12;
        }

        $status = $attrs['status'] ?? null;
        $filters = ['limit' => $limit];
        if (!empty($status) && in_array($status, ['published', 'soon', 'draft'], true)) {
            $filters['status'] = $status;
        }

        $courses = $this->repository->findPublished($filters);

        if (empty($courses)) {
            return "<div class='ds-academy-empty' style='text-align:center; padding:40px 20px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:12px; border:1px dashed rgba(69,243,255,0.2); color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94);'>
                <p style='margin:0; font-size:1.05rem;'>Nenhum curso disponível no momento.</p>
            </div>";
        }

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $html = "<div class='academy-grid' style='display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; margin: 30px 0;'>";

        foreach ($courses as $course) {
            $title = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['title'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $desc = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['description'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $defaultCourseUrl = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''));
            $link = !empty($course['link']) ? htmlspecialchars((string)$course['link'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : htmlspecialchars($defaultCourseUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

            if (!empty($course['thumbnail'])) {
                $rawThumb = (string)$course['thumbnail'];
                if ($this->storage !== null) {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($this->storage->getPublicUrl($rawThumb), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                } elseif (str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'http://') || str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'https://') || str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'data:')) {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($rawThumb, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                } else {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($rawThumb, '/'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                }
            } else {
                $thumbUrl = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="640" height="360" viewBox="0 0 640 360"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="%231e2327"/><text x="50%" y="50%" fill="%2345f3ff" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">🎓 Academy</text></svg>';
            }

            $badge = '';
            if (($course['status'] ?? '') === 'soon') {
                $badge = "<span style='position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px; background:#f0ad4e; color:#0b0c10; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:20px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); text-transform:uppercase;'>EM BREVE</span>";
            }

            $html .= "
            <div class=\"course-card glass-panel\" style=\"background:var(--bg-panel, #1d2327); border:1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15); border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:relative; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;\">
                <div style=\"position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; background:#0b0c10; overflow:hidden;\">
                    <img src=\"{$thumbUrl}\" alt=\"{$title}\" style=\"width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block;\" loading=\"lazy\">
                    {$badge}
                </div>
                <div style=\"padding:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; flex-grow:1;\">
                    <h3 style=\"margin:0 0 10px 0; font-size:1.2rem; color:var(--text-main, #ffffff); line-height:1.4;\">{$title}</h3>
                    <p style=\"margin:0 0 18px 0; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); font-size:0.95rem; line-height:1.5; flex-grow:1;\">{$desc}</p>
                    <a href=\"{$link}\" style=\"display:inline-block; text-align:center; padding:10px 18px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--primary, #45f3ff); color:#0b0c10; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition:opacity 0.2s;\" onmouseover=\"this.style.opacity='0.85'\" onmouseout=\"this.style.opacity='1'\">
                        Acessar Conteúdo &rarr;
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>";
        }

        $html .= "</div>";

        $html .= "
        <style>
            .course-card:hover {
                transform: translateY(-4px);
                box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 12px rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2);
            }
        </style>";

        return $html;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/CourseNavigationService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;

class CourseNavigationService implements CourseNavigationInterface
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private string $baseUrl;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        ?string $baseUrl = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->baseUrl = $baseUrl ?? (defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '');
    }

    private function resolveCourse(string|int $courseIdentifier): ?array
    {
        if (is_numeric($courseIdentifier)) {
            return $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$courseIdentifier);
        }
        return $this->courseRepo->findBySlug((string)$courseIdentifier);
    }

    public function getCourseTree(string|int $courseIdentifier): array
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return [];
        }

        $courseId = (int)$course['id'];
        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];

        $modules = $this->structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);

        // Agrupa apenas aulas publicadas por module_id
        $lessonsByModule = [];
        $standaloneLessons = [];

        foreach ($allLessons as $lesson) {
            if (($lesson['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
                continue;
            }
            $lessonSlug = (string)$lesson['slug'];
            $lesson['url'] = $this->baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug) . '/' . urlencode($lessonSlug);

            $modId = $lesson['module_id'] !== null ? (int)$lesson['module_id'] : null;
            if ($modId !== null && $modId > 0) {
                $lessonsByModule[$modId][] = $lesson;
            } else {
                $standaloneLessons[] = $lesson;
            }
        }

        $tree = [];

        foreach ($modules as $mod) {
            $mId = (int)$mod['id'];
            $tree[] = [
                'id'       => $mId,
                'title'    => (string)$mod['title'],
                'position' => (int)$mod['position'],
                'lessons'  => $lessonsByModule[$mId] ?? [],
            ];
        }

        // Se houver aulas sem módulo cadastrado, agrupa num módulo geral
        if (!empty($standaloneLessons)) {
            $tree[] = [
                'id'       => 0,
                'title'    => 'Aulas Gerais',
                'position' => 999,
                'lessons'  => $standaloneLessons,
            ];
        }

        return $tree;
    }

    public function renderCourseNav(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug = '', array $options = []): string
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return '';
        }

        $tree = $this->getCourseTree($courseIdentifier);
        if (empty($tree)) {
            return '';
        }

        $courseTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];
        $courseUrl = $this->baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug);

        $html = '<nav class="course-nav ds-academy-nav" aria-label="Navegação do Curso ' . $courseTitle . '">';
        $html .= '<div class="course-nav-header">';
        $html .= '<a href="' . $courseUrl . '" class="course-nav-home-link">🎓 ' . $courseTitle . '</a>';
        $html .= '</div>';

        $html .= '<div class="course-nav-body">';

        $globalLessonCounter = 1;

        foreach ($tree as $mod) {
            $modTitle = htmlspecialchars($mod['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $lessons = $mod['lessons'] ?? [];

            $html .= '<div class="course-nav-module">';
            $html .= '<h4 class="course-nav-module-title">' . $modTitle . '</h4>';
            $html .= '<ul class="course-nav-lessons">';

            foreach ($lessons as $lesson) {
                $lTitle = htmlspecialchars($lesson['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $lSlug = (string)$lesson['slug'];
                $lUrl = htmlspecialchars($lesson['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $isActive = ($lSlug === $currentLessonSlug);

                $activeClass = $isActive ? ' is-active current-lesson' : '';
                $ariaCurrent = $isActive ? ' aria-current="page"' : '';

                $html .= '<li class="course-nav-lesson-item' . $activeClass . '">';
                $html .= '<a href="' . $lUrl . '"' . $ariaCurrent . ' class="course-nav-lesson-link">';
                $html .= '<span class="lesson-index">' . sprintf('%02d', $globalLessonCounter++) . '</span> ';
                $html .= '<span class="lesson-title">' . $lTitle . '</span>';
                $html .= '</a>';
                $html .= '</li>';
            }

            $html .= '</ul>';
            $html .= '</div>';
        }

        $html .= '</div>';
        $html .= '</nav>';

        return $html;
    }

    public function getAdjacentLessons(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug): array
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];
        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);

        if (empty($allLessons)) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        // Filtra apenas aulas publicadas e normaliza
        $flat = [];
        foreach ($allLessons as $l) {
            if (($l['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
                continue;
            }
            $slug = (string)$l['slug'];
            $flat[] = [
                'id'    => (int)$l['id'],
                'title' => (string)$l['title'],
                'slug'  => $slug,
                'url'   => $this->baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug) . '/' . urlencode($slug),
            ];
        }

        $currentIndex = -1;
        foreach ($flat as $index => $item) {
            if ($item['slug'] === $currentLessonSlug) {
                $currentIndex = $index;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($currentIndex === -1) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        $prev = ($currentIndex > 0) ? $flat[$currentIndex - 1] : null;
        $next = ($currentIndex < count($flat) - 1) ? $flat[$currentIndex + 1] : null;

        return ['prev' => $prev, 'next' => $next];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/CourseService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseImageStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;

class CourseService
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private CourseImageStorageInterface $storage;

    private static array $accentMap = [
        'á'=>'a','à'=>'a','ã'=>'a','â'=>'a','ä'=>'a',
        'é'=>'e','è'=>'e','ê'=>'e','ë'=>'e',
        'í'=>'i','ì'=>'i','î'=>'i','ï'=>'i',
        'ó'=>'o','ò'=>'o','õ'=>'o','ô'=>'o','ö'=>'o',
        'ú'=>'u','ù'=>'u','û'=>'u','ü'=>'u',
        'ç'=>'c','ñ'=>'n',
        'Á'=>'a','À'=>'a','Ã'=>'a','Â'=>'a','Ä'=>'a',
        'É'=>'e','È'=>'e','Ê'=>'e','Ë'=>'e',
        'Í'=>'i','Ì'=>'i','Î'=>'i','Ï'=>'i',
        'Ó'=>'o','Ò'=>'o','Õ'=>'o','Ô'=>'o','Ö'=>'o',
        'Ú'=>'u','Ù'=>'u','Û'=>'u','Ü'=>'u',
        'Ç'=>'c','Ñ'=>'n'
    ];

    public function __construct(CourseRepositoryInterface $repository, CourseImageStorageInterface $storage)
    {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->storage = $storage;
    }

    public function createCourse(array $data, ?array $uploadedFile = null): int
    {
        $this->validateData($data);

        $slug = $this->generateUniqueSlug((string)$data['title']);
        $thumbnail = null;

        if (!empty($uploadedFile['tmp_name'])) {
            $thumbnail = $this->storage->storeUpload($uploadedFile);
        }

        try {
            $courseId = $this->repository->create([
                'title'       => trim((string)$data['title']),
                'slug'        => $slug,
                'description' => trim((string)($data['description'] ?? '')),
                'thumbnail'   => $thumbnail,
                'status'      => $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
                'link'        => trim((string)($data['link'] ?? '')),
            ]);
            if ($courseId <= 0 && $thumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($thumbnail);
            }
            return $courseId;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if ($thumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($thumbnail);
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function updateCourse(int $id, array $data, ?array $uploadedFile = null): bool
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById($id);
        if (!$course) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Curso #{$id} não encontrado.");
        }

        $this->validateData($data);

        $slug = $course['slug'];
        if (trim((string)$data['title']) !== (string)$course['title']) {
            $slug = $this->generateUniqueSlug((string)$data['title'], $id);
        }

        $oldThumbnail = $course['thumbnail'] ?? null;
        $newThumbnail = null;
        if (!empty($uploadedFile['tmp_name'])) {
            $newThumbnail = $this->storage->storeUpload($uploadedFile);
        }

        $effectiveThumbnail = $newThumbnail ?? $oldThumbnail;

        try {
            $updated = $this->repository->update($id, [
                'title'       => trim((string)$data['title']),
                'slug'        => $slug,
                'description' => trim((string)($data['description'] ?? '')),
                'thumbnail'   => $effectiveThumbnail,
                'status'      => $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
                'link'        => trim((string)($data['link'] ?? '')),
            ]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if ($newThumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($newThumbnail);
            }
            throw $e;
        }

        if (!$updated) {
            if ($newThumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($newThumbnail);
            }
            return false;
        }

        if ($newThumbnail !== null && !empty($oldThumbnail) && $oldThumbnail !== $newThumbnail) {
            $this->storage->deleteFile((string)$oldThumbnail);
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function deleteCourse(int $id): bool
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById($id);
        $deleted = $this->repository->delete($id);

        if ($deleted && $course && !empty($course['thumbnail'])) {
            $this->storage->deleteFile((string)$course['thumbnail']);
        }

        return $deleted;
    }

    public function generateUniqueSlug(string $title, ?int $ignoreId = null): string
    {
        $text = strtr($title, self::$accentMap);

        if (function_exists('transliterator_transliterate')) {
            $trans = transliterator_transliterate('Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII; Lower()', $text);
            if ($trans !== false) {
                $text = $trans;
            }
        }

        $slug = strtolower(trim((string)preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/', '-', $text), '-'));
        if (empty($slug)) {
            $slug = 'curso';
        }

        $base = $slug;
        $counter = 1;

        while ($existing = $this->repository->findBySlug($slug)) {
            if ($ignoreId !== null && (int)$existing['id'] === $ignoreId) {
                break;
            }
            $slug = "{$base}-{$counter}";
            $counter++;
        }

        return $slug;
    }

    private function validateData(array $data): void
    {
        if (empty(trim((string)($data['title'] ?? '')))) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O título do curso é obrigatório.");
        }

        $validStatuses = ['draft', 'soon', 'published'];
        if (!in_array($data['status'] ?? 'draft', $validStatuses, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Status inválido.");
        }

        if (!empty($data['link'])) {
            $link = (string)$data['link'];
            if (!filter_var($link, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) && !str_starts_with($link, '/') && !str_starts_with($link, '#')) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("O link informado deve ser uma URL válida ou um caminho relativo.");
            }
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/LessonBlockRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonBlockRendererInterface;

/**
 * Renderizador de Conteúdo em Blocos para Aulas do Academy (SOLID - SRP).
 *
 * Converte estruturas de blocos JSON (estilo Gutenberg / Notion / Editor.js)
 * em HTML semântico, responsivo, seguro (anti-XSS) e perfeitamente integrado
 * ao design Dark/Cyberpunk do sistema.
 */
class LessonBlockRenderer implements LessonBlockRendererInterface
{
    private const ALLOWED_INLINE_TAGS = '<strong><b><em><i><code><a><mark><kbd><br><small><u><del>';

    /**
     * Renderiza o conteúdo da aula.
     * Se for um JSON de blocos, renderiza cada bloco em HTML semântico.
     * Se for uma string comum/legada, retorna diretamente.
     */
    public function render(?string $content): string
    {
        if ($content === null || trim($content) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $trimmed = trim($content);

        // Detecta se é JSON de blocos
        if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '{') || str_starts_with($trimmed, '[')) {
            $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $blocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : null);
                if (is_array($blocks)) {
                    return $this->renderBlocks($blocks);
                }
            }
        }

        // Conteúdo legado / HTML cru
        return $content;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $blocks
     */
    public function renderBlocks(array $blocks): string
    {
        $html = [];
        $html[] = '<div class="ds-lesson-blocks" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px;">';

        foreach ($blocks as $block) {
            $type = (string)($block['type'] ?? '');
            $data = is_array($block['data'] ?? null) ? $block['data'] : [];

            switch ($type) {
                case 'header':
                case 'heading':
                    $html[] = $this->renderHeader($data);
                    break;

                case 'paragraph':
                case 'text':
                    $html[] = $this->renderParagraph($data);
                    break;

                case 'video':
                case 'embed':
                    $html[] = $this->renderVideo($data);
                    break;

                case 'code':
                    $html[] = $this->renderCode($data);
                    break;

                case 'callout':
                case 'alert':
                    $html[] = $this->renderCallout($data);
                    break;

                case 'list':
                    $html[] = $this->renderList($data);
                    break;

                case 'image':
                    $html[] = $this->renderImage($data);
                    break;

                case 'delimiter':
                case 'divider':
                    $html[] = $this->renderDelimiter($data);
                    break;

                default:
                    // Bloco desconhecido: se houver texto, renderiza parágrafo seguro
                    if (!empty($data['text'])) {
                        $html[] = $this->renderParagraph($data);
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }

        $html[] = '</div>';
        return implode("\n", $html);
    }

    public function renderHeader(array $data): string
    {
        $rawLevel = (int)($data['level'] ?? 2);
        $level = in_array($rawLevel, [1, 2, 3, 4], true) ? $rawLevel : 2;
        $text = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['text'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $fontSizes = [
            1 => '2rem',
            2 => '1.6rem',
            3 => '1.3rem',
            4 => '1.1rem',
        ];
        $fontSize = $fontSizes[$level];

        return "<h{$level} class=\"ds-block-heading ds-heading-h{$level}\" style=\"margin: 25px 0 10px 0; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: {$fontSize}; letter-spacing: -0.5px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding-bottom: 8px;\">{$text}</h{$level}>";
    }

    public function renderParagraph(array $data): string
    {
        $raw = (string)($data['text'] ?? '');
        $safeHtml = $this->sanitizeInlineHtml($raw);

        return "<p class=\"ds-block-paragraph\" style=\"margin: 0; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-main, #c5c6c7); font-size: 1.05rem;\">{$safeHtml}</p>";
    }

    public function renderVideo(array $data): string
    {
        $url = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? $data['source'] ?? ''));
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $caption = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['caption'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $captionHtml = $caption !== '' 
            ? "<figcaption style=\"margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); text-align: center;\">{$caption}</figcaption>" 
            : '';

        $embedUrl = $this->convertVideoUrlToEmbed($url);

        if ($embedUrl !== null) {
            return "
            <figure class=\"ds-block-video\" style=\"margin: 24px 0;\">
                <div style=\"position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: #000; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);\">
                    <iframe src=\"{$embedUrl}\" style=\"position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0;\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture\" allowfullscreen loading=\"lazy\"></iframe>
                </div>
                {$captionHtml}
            </figure>";
        }

        // Vídeo direto MP4/WEBM
        $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        return "
        <figure class=\"ds-block-video\" style=\"margin: 24px 0;\">
            <div style=\"border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2);\">
                <video controls style=\"width: 100%; display: block; max-height: 550px;\">
                    <source src=\"{$safeUrl}\">
                    Seu navegador não suporta a tag de vídeo.
                </video>
            </div>
            {$captionHtml}
        </figure>";
    }

    public function renderCode(array $data): string
    {
        $code = (string)($data['code'] ?? '');
        $lang = htmlspecialchars(trim((string)($data['language'] ?? 'php')), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $escapedCode = htmlspecialchars($code, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $displayLang = strtoupper($lang ?: 'CODE');

        return "
        <div class=\"ds-block-code\" style=\"margin: 24px 0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #0b0c10; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);\">
            <div style=\"display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: #14191c; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px;\">
                <span style=\"color: var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); font-weight: bold;\">{$displayLang}</span>
                <button type=\"button\" onclick=\"navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.closest('.ds-block-code').querySelector('code').innerText); var b=this; b.innerText='Copiado!'; setTimeout(function(){b.innerText='Copiar';}, 2000);\" style=\"background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #8c8f94; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;\">
                    Copiar
                </button>
            </div>
            <pre style=\"margin: 0; padding: 18px; overflow-x: auto; font-family: 'Fira Code', Consolas, Monaco, monospace; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: #e6edf3;\"><code class=\"language-{$lang}\">{$escapedCode}</code></pre>
        </div>";
    }

    public function renderCallout(array $data): string
    {
        $type = (string)($data['type'] ?? 'info');
        $raw = (string)($data['text'] ?? '');
        $safeHtml = $this->sanitizeInlineHtml($raw);

        $styles = [
            'info' => [
                'border' => 'var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff)',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '💡',
                'title'  => 'Nota Didática',
            ],
            'success' => [
                'border' => 'var(--accent-green, #00d284)',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '✅',
                'title'  => 'Boas Práticas & SOLID',
            ],
            'warning' => [
                'border' => 'var(--accent-orange, #f56e28)',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(245, 110, 40, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '⚠️',
                'title'  => 'Atenção',
            ],
            'danger' => [
                'border' => '#ff4d4f',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(255, 77, 79, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '🛑',
                'title'  => 'Cuidado / Erro Comum',
            ],
        ];

        $current = $styles[$type] ?? $styles['info'];

        return "
        <div class=\"ds-block-callout ds-callout-{$type}\" style=\"margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid {$current['border']}; background: {$current['bg']}; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start;\">
            <div style=\"font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1;\">{$current['icon']}</div>
            <div style=\"flex: 1; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--text-main, #fff);\">
                {$safeHtml}
            </div>
        </div>";
    }

    public function renderList(array $data): string
    {
        $style = (string)($data['style'] ?? 'unordered');
        $rawItems = is_array($data['items'] ?? null) ? $data['items'] : [];

        if (empty($rawItems)) {
            return '';
        }

        $tag = ($style === 'ordered') ? 'ol' : 'ul';
        $itemsHtml = [];

        foreach ($rawItems as $item) {
            $itemText = is_string($item) ? $item : (string)($item['content'] ?? '');
            $safe = $this->sanitizeInlineHtml($itemText);
            $itemsHtml[] = "<li style=\"margin-bottom: 8px;\">{$safe}</li>";
        }

        $inner = implode("\n", $itemsHtml);
        return "<{$tag} class=\"ds-block-list\" style=\"margin: 16px 0 16px 24px; padding: 0; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-main, #c5c6c7); font-size: 1.05rem;\">\n{$inner}\n</{$tag}>";
    }

    public function renderImage(array $data): string
    {
        $url = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? $data['file']['url'] ?? ''));
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $caption = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['caption'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $captionHtml = $caption !== '' 
            ? "<figcaption style=\"margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); text-align: center;\">{$caption}</figcaption>" 
            : '';

        return "
        <figure class=\"ds-block-figure\" style=\"margin: 28px 0; text-align: center;\">
            <img src=\"{$safeUrl}\" alt=\"{$caption}\" style=\"max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);\" loading=\"lazy\">
            {$captionHtml}
        </figure>";
    }

    public function renderDelimiter(array $data): string
    {
        return '<hr class="ds-block-delimiter" style="margin: 35px 0; border: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.4), transparent);">';
    }

    public function convertVideoUrlToEmbed(string $url): ?string
    {
        // YouTube: youtube.com/watch?v=ID ou youtu.be/ID ou youtube.com/embed/ID
        if (preg_match('/(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/i', $url, $matches)) {
            return 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' . $matches[1];
        }

        // Vimeo: vimeo.com/ID
        if (preg_match('/vimeo\.com\/(?:channels\/(?:\w+\/)?|groups\/(?:[^\/]*)\/videos\/|album\/(?:\d+)\/video\/|video\/|)(\d+)/i', $url, $matches)) {
            return 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' . $matches[1];
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Extrai texto puro de um conteúdo (seja JSON de blocos ou HTML legado) para uso em SEO / resumos.
     */
    public function extractPlainText(?string $content): string
    {
        if ($content === null || trim($content) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $trimmed = trim($content);
        if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '{') || str_starts_with($trimmed, '[')) {
            $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $blocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : null);
                if (is_array($blocks)) {
                    $parts = [];
                    foreach ($blocks as $block) {
                        $data = is_array($block['data'] ?? null) ? $block['data'] : [];
                        if (!empty($data['text'])) {
                            $parts[] = strip_tags((string)$data['text']);
                        } elseif (!empty($data['caption'])) {
                            $parts[] = strip_tags((string)$data['caption']);
                        }
                    }
                    return trim(implode(' ', $parts));
                }
            }
        }

        return trim(strip_tags($content));
    }

    private function sanitizeInlineHtml(string $html): string
    {
        // Remove scripts e tags perigosas preservando tags de formatação segura
        $stripped = strip_tags($html, self::ALLOWED_INLINE_TAGS);
        // Remove manipuladores de eventos maliciosos tipo onclick, onerror
        $cleaned = (string)preg_replace('/\s*on\w+\s*=\s*(["\'][^"\']*["\']|[^\s>]+)/i', '', $stripped);
        // Bloqueia protocolos perigosos (javascript:, data:, vbscript:) em atributos href
        return (string)preg_replace('/\s*href\s*=\s*(["\']?)\s*(?:javascript|vbscript|data):[^"\'>\s]*\1/i', ' href="#"', $cleaned);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/LocalCourseImageStorage.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\LocalPublicStorage;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseImageStorageInterface;

class LocalCourseImageStorage implements CourseImageStorageInterface
{
    private PublicStorageInterface $storage;
    private const MAX_BYTES = 2097152; // 2 MB
    private const ALLOWED_MIMES = [
        'image/jpeg' => 'jpg',
        'image/png'  => 'png',
        'image/webp' => 'webp',
    ];

    /**
     * @param PublicStorageInterface|string $storage Instância do PublicStorage do Core ou caminho para retrocompatibilidade
     */
    public function __construct(PublicStorageInterface|string $storage)
    {
        if (is_string($storage)) {
            $this->storage = new LocalPublicStorage($storage);
        } else {
            $this->storage = $storage;
        }
    }

    public function storeUpload(array $fileInfo): string
    {
        if (empty($fileInfo['tmp_name']) || !file_exists($fileInfo['tmp_name'])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Nenhum arquivo válido enviado.");
        }

        $size = (int)($fileInfo['size'] ?? filesize($fileInfo['tmp_name']));
        if ($size > self::MAX_BYTES) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("A imagem deve ter no máximo 2MB.");
        }

        // Validação estrita de MIME type real (finfo com fallbacks resilientes)
        $realMime = null;
        if (class_exists('\finfo')) {
            try {
                $finfo = new \finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                $realMime = $finfo->file($fileInfo['tmp_name']);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $realMime = null;
            }
        }
        if (empty($realMime) && function_exists('mime_content_type')) {
            $realMime = @mime_content_type($fileInfo['tmp_name']);
        }

        // Validação de dimensões e aspect ratio
        $imageSize = @getimagesize($fileInfo['tmp_name']);
        if (!$imageSize) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo enviado não é uma imagem válida.");
        }

        if (empty($realMime) && !empty($imageSize['mime'])) {
            $realMime = $imageSize['mime'];
        }

        if (empty($realMime) || !isset(self::ALLOWED_MIMES[$realMime])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Formato inválido. Apenas JPG, PNG ou WEBP são aceitos.");
        }

        $width = (int)$imageSize[0];
        $height = (int)$imageSize[1];
        if ($width < 640 || $height < 360) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Dimensão mínima exigida: 640x360 pixels (enviado: {$width}x{$height}).");
        }

        $aspectRatio = $width / $height;
        $expectedRatio = 16.0 / 9.0; // ~1.777
        if (abs($aspectRatio - $expectedRatio) > 0.10) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("A imagem do card deve respeitar a proporção 16:9 (horizontal).");
        }

        $extension = self::ALLOWED_MIMES[$realMime];
        $safeName = 'course_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(10)) . '.' . $extension;
        $destination = $this->storage->getUploadPath('academy/' . $safeName);

        $destDir = dirname($destination);
        if (!is_dir($destDir)) {
            @mkdir($destDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $moved = false;
        if (is_uploaded_file($fileInfo['tmp_name'])) {
            $moved = @move_uploaded_file($fileInfo['tmp_name'], $destination);
        }
        if (!$moved) {
            $moved = @copy($fileInfo['tmp_name'], $destination);
        }

        if (!$moved) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Falha ao salvar a imagem no diretório de destino ('{$destination}'). Verifique as permissões de escrita na pasta 'uploads/academy'.");
        }

        return 'uploads/academy/' . $safeName;
    }

    public function deleteFile(string $relativePath): void
    {
        $this->storage->delete($relativePath);
    }

    public function getUploadDir(): string
    {
        return $this->storage->getUploadPath('academy');
    }

    public function getStorage(): PublicStorageInterface
    {
        return $this->storage;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/ThemeLessonFileScaffolder.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonBlockRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Fábrica Automática de Pastas (Módulos) e Arquivos PHP Pré-Configurados de Aulas.
 *
 * Cria fisicamente diretórios e arquivos `.php` dentro de `pages/` do tema ativo,
 * pré-configurados com CSS e JS padrão para resoluções Desktop, Mobile e Tablet,
 * prontos para edição via Blocos.
 *
 * Exemplo:
 *   Título: "Estrutura de Dados"
 *   Arquivo gerado: `estrutura-de-dados.php`
 *   Slug relativo: `pages/estrutura-de-dados.php`
 *   URL pública: `http://localhost/domain-system/cursos/estrutura-de-dados`
 */
class ThemeLessonFileScaffolder implements LessonFileScaffolderInterface
{
    private static array $accentMap = [
        'á'=>'a','à'=>'a','ã'=>'a','â'=>'a','ä'=>'a',
        'é'=>'e','è'=>'e','ê'=>'e','ë'=>'e',
        'í'=>'i','ì'=>'i','î'=>'i','ï'=>'i',
        'ó'=>'o','ò'=>'o','õ'=>'o','ô'=>'o','ö'=>'o',
        'ú'=>'u','ù'=>'u','û'=>'u','ü'=>'u',
        'ç'=>'c','ñ'=>'n',
        'Á'=>'a','À'=>'a','Ã'=>'a','Â'=>'a','Ä'=>'a',
        'É'=>'e','È'=>'e','Ê'=>'e','Ë'=>'e',
        'Í'=>'i','Ì'=>'i','Î'=>'i','Ï'=>'i',
        'Ó'=>'o','Ò'=>'o','Õ'=>'o','Ô'=>'o','Ö'=>'o',
        'Ú'=>'u','Ù'=>'u','Û'=>'u','Ü'=>'u',
        'Ç'=>'c','Ñ'=>'n'
    ];

    private ThemePageResolverInterface $themeResolver;
    private LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer;
    private ?string $overridePagesRoot;

    public function __construct(
        ?ThemePageResolverInterface $themeResolver = null,
        ?LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer = null,
        ?string $overridePagesRoot = null
    ) {
        $this->themeResolver = $themeResolver ?? new ThemePageResolver();
        $this->blockRenderer = $blockRenderer ?? new LessonBlockRenderer();
        $this->overridePagesRoot = $overridePagesRoot;
    }

    public function slugify(string $title): string
    {
        $clean = strtr(trim($title), self::$accentMap);
        $slug = strtolower(trim((string)preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/', '-', $clean), '-'));
        return $slug !== '' ? $slug : 'aula-sem-titulo';
    }

    public function createFolder(string $folderTitle): array
    {
        $trimmed = trim($folderTitle);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O nome da pasta ou módulo não pode estar vazio.");
        }

        // Suporta subpastas seguras ex: "tutoriais/python" ou título simples "Estrutura de Dados"
        $parts = array_filter(explode('/', str_replace('\\', '/', $trimmed)), fn($p) => trim($p) !== '' && $p !== '.' && $p !== '..');
        $slugParts = array_map(fn($p) => $this->slugify($p), $parts);
        if (empty($slugParts)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Nome de pasta inválido.");
        }

        $folderSlug = implode('/', $slugParts);
        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();
        $targetDir = $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $folderSlug);

        if (!is_dir($targetDir)) {
            if (!@mkdir($targetDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($targetDir)) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Não foi possível criar a pasta física em: pages/{$folderSlug}");
            }
        }

        $realPagesRoot = realpath($pagesRoot);
        $realTargetDir = realpath($targetDir);
        if ($realPagesRoot === false || $realTargetDir === false || !str_starts_with($realTargetDir, $realPagesRoot)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Violação de segurança ao validar diretório da pasta criada.");
        }

        return [
            'slug'          => $folderSlug,
            'relative_path' => 'pages/' . $folderSlug,
            'full_path'     => $realTargetDir,
        ];
    }

    public function fabricateLessonFile(
        string $title,
        ?string $folder = null,
        ?string $blocksJson = null,
        string $mobileProfile = 'drawer'
    ): array {
        $trimmedTitle = trim($title);
        if ($trimmedTitle === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O título da aula/página é obrigatório para fabricar o arquivo PHP.");
        }

        $slug = $this->slugify($trimmedTitle);
        $fileName = $slug . '.php';
        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();

        $cleanFolder = '';
        if ($folder !== null && trim($folder) !== '') {
            $normalizedFolder = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $folder), '/');
            if (str_starts_with($normalizedFolder, 'pages/')) {
                $normalizedFolder = substr($normalizedFolder, 6);
            }
            if ($normalizedFolder !== '') {
                $folderInfo = $this->createFolder($normalizedFolder);
                $cleanFolder = $folderInfo['slug'];
            }
        }

        $relativePath = $cleanFolder !== ''
            ? 'pages/' . $cleanFolder . '/' . $fileName
            : 'pages/' . $fileName;

        $targetDir = $cleanFolder !== ''
            ? $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $cleanFolder)
            : $pagesRoot;

        $fullPath = $targetDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $fileName;

        $phpTemplate = $this->buildPreconfiguredPhpTemplate(
            $trimmedTitle,
            $slug,
            $relativePath,
            $blocksJson,
            $mobileProfile
        );

        if (@file_put_contents($fullPath, $phpTemplate, LOCK_EX) === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Falha ao gravar o arquivo pré-configurado em: {$relativePath}");
        }

        $realPagesRoot = realpath($pagesRoot);
        $realFile = realpath($fullPath);
        if ($realPagesRoot === false || $realFile === false || !str_starts_with($realFile, $realPagesRoot)) {
            @unlink($fullPath);
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Caminho de arquivo fora do diretório permitido.");
        }

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $publicUrl = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . $slug;

        return [
            'title'         => $trimmedTitle,
            'slug'          => $slug,
            'file_name'     => $fileName,
            'relative_path' => $relativePath,
            'full_path'     => $realFile,
            'public_url'    => $publicUrl,
        ];
    }

    private function resolvePagesDirectory(): string
    {
        if ($this->overridePagesRoot !== null && $this->overridePagesRoot !== '') {
            if (!is_dir($this->overridePagesRoot)) {
                @mkdir($this->overridePagesRoot, 0755, true);
            }
            return rtrim($this->overridePagesRoot, '/\\');
        }

        $themePath = $this->themeResolver->resolveActiveThemePath();
        $pagesDir = rtrim($themePath, '/\\') . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'pages';
        if (!is_dir($pagesDir)) {
            @mkdir($pagesDir, 0755, true);
        }
        return $pagesDir;
    }

    private function buildPreconfiguredPhpTemplate(
        string $title,
        string $slug,
        string $relativePath,
        ?string $blocksJson,
        string $mobileProfile
    ): string {
        $safeTitle = htmlspecialchars($title, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeProfile = in_array($mobileProfile, ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'], true) ? $mobileProfile : 'drawer';

        if ($blocksJson === null || trim($blocksJson) === '') {
            $defaultBlocks = [
                'time' => time(),
                'blocks' => [
                    [
                        'id'   => 'b_head_1',
                        'type' => 'header',
                        'data' => ['level' => 2, 'text' => $title],
                    ],
                    [
                        'id'   => 'b_par_1',
                        'type' => 'paragraph',
                        'data' => ['text' => 'Conteúdo inicial da aula <strong>' . $safeTitle . '</strong>. Edite este arquivo pelo <code>Editor em Blocos</code> do painel Academy para atualizar automaticamente Desktop e Mobile.'],
                    ],
                ],
            ];
            $blocksJson = (string)json_encode($defaultBlocks, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        }

        $renderedBlocksHtml = $this->blockRenderer->render($blocksJson);
        $encodedJsonComment = base64_encode($blocksJson);

        return <<<PHP
<?php
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * ARQUIVO GERADO PELA FÁBRICA DE AULAS DO ACADEMY (Domain-System v2.4)
 * ============================================================================
 * Título: {$safeTitle}
 * Slug: {$slug}
 * Caminho: {$relativePath}
 * Perfil Mobile: {$safeProfile}
 * DS_BLOCKS_B64: {$encodedJsonComment}
 * ============================================================================
 */
?>
<article class="ds-fabricated-lesson" data-lesson-slug="{$slug}" data-mobile-profile="{$safeProfile}">
    <style>
        /* CSS Padrão Pré-Configurado: Resoluções Desktop, Tablet e Mobile */
        .ds-fabricated-lesson {
            color: var(--text-main, #e2e8f0);
            line-height: 1.75;
            font-size: 1.04rem;
            max-width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        .ds-fabricated-lesson .ds-lesson-blocks {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
        }
        .ds-fabricated-lesson pre {
            max-width: 100%;
            overflow-x: auto;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }
        .ds-fabricated-lesson img,
        .ds-fabricated-lesson iframe,
        .ds-fabricated-lesson video {
            max-width: 100%;
        }

        /* Responsividade Tablet (<= 1024px) */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .ds-fabricated-lesson {
                font-size: 1rem;
            }
        }

        /* Responsividade Mobile (<= 768px) */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .ds-fabricated-lesson {
                font-size: 0.96rem;
                line-height: 1.65;
            }
            .ds-fabricated-lesson[data-mobile-profile="cinema"] .ds-block-video {
                position: sticky;
                top: 8px;
                z-index: 30;
                box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <div class="ds-fabricated-lesson-body">
        {$renderedBlocksHtml}
    </div>

    <script>
        /* JS Padrão Pré-Configurado (Desktop & Mobile) */
        (function() {
            const article = document.querySelector('.ds-fabricated-lesson[data-lesson-slug="{$slug}"]');
            if (!article) return;
            article.querySelectorAll('pre code').forEach(function(codeBlock) {
                codeBlock.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            });
        })();
    </script>
</article>
PHP;
    }

    public function extractBlocksFromFile(string $relativePath): ?string
    {
        $cleanRel = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relativePath), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($cleanRel, 'pages/')) {
            $cleanRel = substr($cleanRel, 6);
        }

        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();
        $fullPath = $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $cleanRel);
        if (!is_file($fullPath)) {
            return null;
        }

        $content = (string)@file_get_contents($fullPath);
        if (preg_match('/DS_BLOCKS_B64:\s*([A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+)/', $content, $matches)) {
            $decoded = base64_decode($matches[1], true);
            return $decoded !== false ? $decoded : null;
        }

        return null;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/ThemePageResolver.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SiteStateInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\EnvSiteState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use FilesystemIterator;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;

class ThemePageResolver implements ThemePageResolverInterface
{
    private ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;
    private ?SafeThemeResolver $themeResolver;
    private ?SiteStateInterface $siteState;
    private string $baseRoot;

    public function __construct(
        ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        ?SafeThemeResolver $themeResolver = null,
        ?SiteStateInterface $siteState = null,
        ?string $baseRoot = null
    ) {
        $this->themeManager = $themeManager;
        $this->baseRoot = $baseRoot ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4));
        $this->themeResolver = $themeResolver ?? new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->baseRoot . '/themes',
            $this->baseRoot . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes',
        ]);
        $this->siteState = $siteState ?? new EnvSiteState();
    }

    public function resolveActiveThemePath(): string
    {
        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $activePath = $this->themeManager->getActiveThemePath();
            if (!empty($activePath) && is_dir($activePath)) {
                return $activePath;
            }
        }

        $activeTheme = $this->siteState !== null ? $this->siteState->getActiveTheme() : '';
        if ($activeTheme !== '' && $this->themeResolver !== null && $this->themeResolver->themeExists($activeTheme)) {
            return $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($activeTheme);
        }

        $candidates = ['default'];
        if ($this->themeResolver !== null) {
            foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
                if ($this->themeResolver->themeExists($candidate)) {
                    return $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($candidate);
                }
            }
        }

        return $this->themeResolver !== null
            ? $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($activeTheme)
            : $this->baseRoot . '/themes/default';
    }

    public function resolvePublicThemePages(): array
    {
        $pages = [];

        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $pages = $this->themeManager->getAvailablePages();
        }

        if (empty($pages)) {
            $activePublicTheme = $this->siteState !== null ? $this->siteState->getActiveTheme() : '';

            if ($this->themeManager !== null && $activePublicTheme !== '') {
                $pages = $this->themeManager->getAvailablePages($activePublicTheme);
            }

            if (empty($pages) && $this->themeResolver !== null) {
                $candidateThemes = array_unique(array_filter([$activePublicTheme, 'default']));
                foreach ($candidateThemes as $themeName) {
                    if ($this->themeResolver->themeExists($themeName)) {
                        $pagesDir = $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($themeName) . '/pages';
                        if (is_dir($pagesDir)) {
                            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                                new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($pagesDir, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)
                            );
                            foreach ($iterator as $file) {
                                if ($file->isFile() && in_array(strtolower($file->getExtension()), ['php', 'html'], true)) {
                                    $rel = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($file->getPathname(), strlen($pagesDir) + 1));
                                    $pages[] = 'pages/' . ltrim($rel, '/');
                                }
                            }
                            if (!empty($pages)) {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $pages = array_values(array_unique($pages));
        natsort($pages);
        return array_values($pages);
    }

    /**
     * Alias retrocompatível para resolvePublicThemePages().
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function getAvailablePages(): array
    {
        return $this->resolvePublicThemePages();
    }
}

// Arquivo: academy/Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato estrito para a navegação de cursos e aulas no Domain-System OS.
 * 
 * Segue os princípios SOLID (DIP e ISP):
 * Permite que qualquer template ou workspace consuma e renderize a árvore
 * de navegação de um curso (módulos, aulas e links) sem acoplamento a tabelas SQL.
 */
interface CourseNavigationInterface
{
    /**
     * Retorna a árvore hierárquica completa do curso (módulos e suas respectivas aulas).
     *
     * @param string|int $courseIdentifier Slug ou ID do curso
     * @return array<int, array{
     *     id: int,
     *     title: string,
     *     position: int,
     *     lessons: array<int, array{
     *         id: int,
     *         title: string,
     *         slug: string,
     *         url: string,
     *         source_type: string,
     *         source?: ?string,
     *         position: int,
     *         status: string
     *     }>
     * }>
     */
    public function getCourseTree(string|int $courseIdentifier): array;

    /**
     * Renderiza o container semântico <nav class="course-nav"> com a árvore de módulos e aulas.
     *
     * @param string|int $courseIdentifier Slug ou ID do curso
     * @param string $currentLessonSlug Slug da aula atualmente ativa para destaque
     * @param array<string, mixed> $options Opções visuais customizadas
     * @return string HTML seguro do container <nav>
     */
    public function renderCourseNav(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug = '', array $options = []): string;

    /**
     * Retorna as aulas adjacentes (anterior e próxima) para paginação de navegação linear.
     *
     * @param string|int $courseIdentifier Slug ou ID do curso
     * @param string $currentLessonSlug Slug da aula atual
     * @return array{
     *     prev: ?array{id: int, title: string, slug: string, url: string},
     *     next: ?array{id: int, title: string, slug: string, url: string}
     * }
     */
    public function getAdjacentLessons(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug): array;
}

// Arquivo: academy/Repositories\PdoCourseRepository.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

class PdoCourseRepository implements CourseRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
        $this->ensureTableExists();
    }

    public function findAll(): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT * FROM academy_courses ORDER BY id DESC");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE slug = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findPublished(array $filters = []): array
    {
        $status = $filters['status'] ?? null;
        $limit = isset($filters['limit']) ? (int)$filters['limit'] : 12;
        if ($limit <= 0) {
            $limit = 12;
        }

        if (!empty($status)) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {$limit}");
            $stmt->execute([$status]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE status IN ('published', 'soon') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {$limit}");
            $stmt->execute();
        }

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_courses (title, slug, thumbnail, description, status, link)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            $data['title'],
            $data['slug'],
            $data['thumbnail'] ?? null,
            $data['description'] ?? null,
            $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
            $data['link'] ?? null,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function update(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE academy_courses
            SET title = ?, slug = ?, thumbnail = ?, description = ?, status = ?, link = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([
            $data['title'],
            $data['slug'],
            $data['thumbnail'] ?? null,
            $data['description'] ?? null,
            $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
            $data['link'] ?? null,
            $id
        ]);
    }

    public function delete(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_courses WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    private function ensureTableExists(): void
    {
        $driver = $this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
            $this->pdo->exec("
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_courses (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    title TEXT NOT NULL,
                    slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    thumbnail TEXT NULL,
                    description TEXT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
                    link TEXT NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            ");
        } else {
            $this->pdo->exec("
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_courses (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                    slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    thumbnail VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                    description TEXT NULL,
                    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
                    link VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            ");
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer;
use Throwable;

class LessonAdminController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;
    private LessonBlockRenderer $blockRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        ?LessonBlockRenderer $blockRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->themeManager = $themeManager;
        $this->blockRenderer = $blockRenderer ?? new LessonBlockRenderer();
    }

    public function editor(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $lessonId = (int)$id;
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        if (!$lesson) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Aula não encontrada.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $course = $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$lesson['course_id']);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso vinculado à aula não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $moduleTitle = 'Módulo Geral';
        $allModules = $this->structureRepo->getModules((int)$course['id']);
        $allCourseLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);
        if (!empty($lesson['module_id'])) {
            foreach ($allModules as $m) {
                if ((int)$m['id'] === (int)$lesson['module_id']) {
                    $moduleTitle = (string)$m['title'];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        // Identifica aulas anterior e próxima para o preview realista
        $prevLessonTitle = null;
        $nextLessonTitle = null;
        $flatLessons = array_values($allCourseLessons);
        foreach ($flatLessons as $idx => $fl) {
            if ((int)$fl['id'] === $lessonId) {
                if ($idx > 0) {
                    $prevLessonTitle = (string)$flatLessons[$idx - 1]['title'];
                }
                if ($idx < count($flatLessons) - 1) {
                    $nextLessonTitle = (string)$flatLessons[$idx + 1]['title'];
                }
                break;
            }
        }

        // Prepara blocos existentes
        $rawContent = (string)($lesson['content'] ?? '');
        $initialBlocks = [];

        if ($rawContent !== '') {
            $decoded = json_decode($rawContent, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $initialBlocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : []);
            } else {
                // Se for texto simples / legado, inicializa um bloco de parágrafo com o conteúdo
                $initialBlocks = [
                    [
                        'id'   => 'b_init_1',
                        'type' => 'paragraph',
                        'data' => ['text' => $rawContent]
                    ]
                ];
            }
        }

        // Se estiver completamente vazio, inicia com título e parágrafo
        if (empty($initialBlocks)) {
            $initialBlocks = [
                [
                    'id'   => 'b_init_h',
                    'type' => 'header',
                    'data' => ['level' => 2, 'text' => (string)$lesson['title']]
                ],
                [
                    'id'   => 'b_init_p',
                    'type' => 'paragraph',
                    'data' => ['text' => 'Digite aqui o conteúdo da aula ou adicione novos blocos abaixo...']
                ]
            ];
        }

        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $siteLessonUrl = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode((string)$course['slug']) . '/' . urlencode((string)$lesson['slug']);

        ob_start();
        ?>
        <div id="editor_root_wrapper" style="max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; padding-bottom: 80px; color: var(--text-main, #fff);">
            
            <!-- HEADER BAR FIXO -->
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom: 25px; background: var(--bg-panel, #1d2327); padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); flex-wrap:wrap; gap:15px; position:sticky; top:15px; z-index:90; box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); backdrop-filter:blur(10px);">
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:15px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                    <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy/edit/<?= $course['id'] ?>" class="btn btn-outline" style="padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid #4a545a; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font-size: 13px;">
                        &larr; Voltar ao Curso
                    </a>
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); letter-spacing: 0.8px; font-weight: 600;">
                            <?= htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title']) ?> &bull; <?= htmlspecialchars($moduleTitle) ?>
                        </div>
                        <input type="text" id="lesson_title_input" oninput="refreshLivePreview()" value="<?= htmlspecialchars((string)$lesson['title']) ?>" style="background:transparent; border:none; border-bottom:1px dashed #4a545a; color:#fff; font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:bold; outline:none; padding:2px 4px; min-width:280px;" title="Clique para editar o título da aula">
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
