                    stage.style.margin = '0 auto';
                    stage.style.background = '#12161b';
                    stage.style.border = (profile.borderWidth || '3px') + ' solid #2d3748';
                    stage.style.borderRadius = profile.borderRadius || '28px';
                    stage.style.boxShadow = '0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(69,243,255,0.2)';

                    viewport.style.padding = profile.padding;
                    viewport.style.minHeight = '480px';
                    if (statusbar) statusbar.style.display = 'flex';
                    if (siteHeader) siteHeader.style.display = 'flex';
                    if (drawerBar) drawerBar.style.display = 'flex';
                    if (footerZone) footerZone.style.display = 'flex';
                    if (homebar) homebar.style.display = 'flex';
                    if (lessonTitle) lessonTitle.style.fontSize = profile.titleSize;
                } else {
                    btnDesktop.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
                    btnDesktop.style.color = '#45f3ff';
                    btnMobile.style.background = 'transparent';
                    btnMobile.style.color = '#8c8f94';
                    if (profileSelect) profileSelect.style.display = 'none';
                    if (dimBadge) dimBadge.style.display = 'none';

                    stage.style.maxWidth = '100%';
                    stage.style.margin = '0';
                    stage.style.background = 'transparent';
                    stage.style.border = 'none';
                    stage.style.borderRadius = '0';
                    stage.style.boxShadow = 'none';

                    viewport.style.padding = '8px 4px';
                    viewport.style.minHeight = 'auto';
                    if (statusbar) statusbar.style.display = 'none';
                    if (siteHeader) siteHeader.style.display = 'none';
                    if (drawerBar) drawerBar.style.display = 'none';
                    if (footerZone) footerZone.style.display = 'none';
                    if (homebar) homebar.style.display = 'none';
                    if (lessonTitle) lessonTitle.style.fontSize = '1.85rem';
                }

                refreshLivePreview();
            };

            window.setMobileProfile = function(profileKey) {
                if (MOBILE_PROFILES[profileKey]) {
                    currentMobileProfile = profileKey;
                    setPreviewDevice('mobile');
                }
            };

            window.setEditorViewMode = function(mode) {
                currentViewMode = mode;
                var grid = document.getElementById('editor_workspace_grid');
                var colEdit = document.getElementById('editor_blocks_column');
                var colPrev = document.getElementById('editor_preview_column');
                var btnEdit = document.getElementById('btn_mode_edit');
                var btnSplit = document.getElementById('btn_mode_split');
                var btnPrev = document.getElementById('btn_mode_preview');

                [btnEdit, btnSplit, btnPrev].forEach(function(b) {
                    if (b) {
                        b.style.background = 'transparent';
                        b.style.color = '#8c8f94';
                    }
                });

                if (mode === 'edit') {
                    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
                    colEdit.style.display = 'block';
                    colPrev.style.display = 'none';
                    btnEdit.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
                    btnEdit.style.color = '#45f3ff';
                } else if (mode === 'preview') {
                    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
                    colEdit.style.display = 'none';
                    colPrev.style.display = 'block';
                    colPrev.style.maxHeight = 'none';
                    btnPrev.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
                    btnPrev.style.color = '#45f3ff';
                } else {
                    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 1fr';
                    colEdit.style.display = 'block';
                    colPrev.style.display = 'block';
                    colPrev.style.maxHeight = 'calc(100vh - 115px)';
                    btnSplit.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
                    btnSplit.style.color = '#45f3ff';
                }
                refreshLivePreview();
            };

            function resolveVideoEmbedHtml(rawUrl) {
                rawUrl = String(rawUrl || '').trim();
                if (!rawUrl) return '';

                var ytMatch = rawUrl.match(/(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);
                if (ytMatch && ytMatch[1]) {
                    var ytUrl = 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + ytMatch[1] + '?rel=0';
                    return '<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#000; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2);"><iframe src="' + ytUrl + '" style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0;" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe></div>';
                }

                var vimeoMatch = rawUrl.match(/vimeo\.com\/(?:video\/)?(\d+)/);
                if (vimeoMatch && vimeoMatch[1]) {
                    var vmUrl = 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' + vimeoMatch[1];
                    return '<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#000; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2);"><iframe src="' + vmUrl + '" style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0;" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe></div>';
                }

                if (/\.(mp4|webm|ogg)(\?.*)?$/i.test(rawUrl)) {
                    return '<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#000;"><video controls style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;"><source src="' + escapeHtml(rawUrl) + '"></video></div>';
                }

                return '';
            }

            window.refreshLivePreview = function() {
                var titleInput = document.getElementById('lesson_title_input');
                var previewTitle = document.getElementById('live_preview_lesson_title');
                if (titleInput && previewTitle) {
                    previewTitle.textContent = titleInput.value || 'Aula sem título';
                }

                var previewBody = document.getElementById('live_preview_body');
                if (!previewBody) return;

                if (!blocks || blocks.length === 0) {
                    previewBody.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#64748b; text-align:center; padding:30px 0;">Adicione blocos à esquerda para visualizar a aula aqui em tempo real.</p>';
                    return;
                }

                var isMobile = (currentDevice === 'mobile');
                var mProfile = MOBILE_PROFILES[currentMobileProfile] || MOBILE_PROFILES.standard;
                var bodyFontSize = isMobile ? mProfile.fontSize : '1.03rem';
                var hSizes = isMobile ? mProfile.hSizes : {1: '2rem', 2: '1.6rem', 3: '1.3rem', 4: '1.1rem'};

                var htmlParts = [];
                blocks.forEach(function(b) {
                    var d = b.data || {};
                    switch(b.type) {
                        case 'header':
                            var lvl = Math.min(4, Math.max(1, parseInt(d.level || 2)));
                            htmlParts.push('<h' + lvl + ' style="color:#fff; font-size:' + (hSizes[lvl] || '1.4rem') + '; font-weight:800; margin:1.4rem 0 0.7rem 0; line-height:1.3;">' + escapeHtml(d.text || '') + '</h' + lvl + '>');
                            break;

                        case 'paragraph':
                            var pText = escapeHtml(d.text || '').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
                            htmlParts.push('<p style="margin:0 0 1.1rem 0; line-height:1.75; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:' + bodyFontSize + '; word-break:break-word;">' + pText + '</p>');
                            break;

                        case 'video':
                            var vUrl = d.url || d.source || '';
                            var vCap = d.caption || '';
                            var embed = resolveVideoEmbedHtml(vUrl);
                            if (embed) {
                                htmlParts.push('<div style="margin:1.3rem 0;">' + embed + (vCap ? '<div style="margin-top:6px; font-size:0.8rem; color:#8c8f94; text-align:center;">' + escapeHtml(vCap) + '</div>' : '') + '</div>');
                            } else if (vUrl) {
                                htmlParts.push('<div style="margin:1.1rem 0; padding:12px; border:1px dashed rgba(69,243,255,0.3); border-radius:8px; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; word-break:break-all;">🔗 Vídeo: ' + escapeHtml(vUrl) + '</div>');
                            }
                            break;

                        case 'code':
                            var lang = (d.language || 'code').toUpperCase();
                            var codePad = isMobile ? '12px' : '16px';
                            var codeFont = isMobile ? '0.8rem' : '0.9rem';
                            htmlParts.push(
                                '<div style="margin:1.3rem 0; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#0d1117; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2);">' +
                                    '<div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding:6px 12px; font-size:0.72rem; font-family:monospace; color:#45f3ff; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">' + escapeHtml(lang) + '</div>' +
                                    '<pre style="margin:0; padding:' + codePad + '; overflow-x:auto; font-family:Consolas,Monaco,monospace; font-size:' + codeFont + '; line-height:1.55; color:#e6edf3;"><code>' + escapeHtml(d.code || '') + '</code></pre>' +
                                '</div>'
                            );
                            break;

                        case 'callout':
                            var ctype = d.type || 'info';
                            var styles = {
                                info: { border: '#45f3ff', bg: 'rgba(69,243,255,0.07)', icon: '💡' },
                                success: { border: '#00d284', bg: 'rgba(0,210,132,0.08)', icon: '✅' },
                                warning: { border: '#f5a623', bg: 'rgba(245,166,35,0.08)', icon: '⚠️' },
                                danger: { border: '#e06c75', bg: 'rgba(224,108,117,0.08)', icon: '🛑' }
                            };
                            var st = styles[ctype] || styles.info;
                            var calloutPad = isMobile ? '12px 14px' : '16px 20px';
                            htmlParts.push(
                                '<div style="margin:1.2rem 0; padding:' + calloutPad + '; border-left:4px solid ' + st.border + '; background:' + st.bg + '; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; font-size:' + bodyFontSize + ';">' +
                                    '<span style="font-size:1.1rem;">' + st.icon + '</span>' +
                                    '<div style="color:#fff; line-height:1.6; flex:1; word-break:break-word;">' + escapeHtml(d.text || '').replace(/\n/g, '<br>') + '</div>' +
                                '</div>'
                            );
                            break;

                        case 'list':
                            var items = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];
                            var tag = (d.style === 'ordered') ? 'ol' : 'ul';
                            var lis = items.map(function(it) {
                                var txt = typeof it === 'string' ? it : (it.content || '');
                                return '<li style="margin-bottom:6px;">' + escapeHtml(txt) + '</li>';
                            }).join('');
                            htmlParts.push('<' + tag + ' style="margin:0 0 1.2rem 1.25rem; color:#c5c6c7; line-height:1.7; font-size:' + bodyFontSize + ';">' + lis + '</' + tag + '>');
                            break;

                        case 'image':
                            var iUrl = d.url || (d.file ? d.file.url : '') || '';
                            var iCap = d.caption || '';
                            if (iUrl) {
                                htmlParts.push(
                                    '<figure style="margin:1.4rem 0; text-align:center;">' +
                                        '<img src="' + escapeHtml(iUrl) + '" alt="' + escapeHtml(iCap) + '" style="max-width:100%; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">' +
                                        (iCap ? '<figcaption style="margin-top:6px; font-size:0.8rem; color:#8c8f94;">' + escapeHtml(iCap) + '</figcaption>' : '') +
                                    '</figure>'
                                );
                            }
                            break;

                        case 'delimiter':
                            htmlParts.push('<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2); margin:1.6rem 0;">');
                            break;
                    }
                });

                previewBody.innerHTML = htmlParts.join('');
            };

            function renderCanvas() {
                var container = document.getElementById('blocks_canvas');
                container.innerHTML = '';

                if (blocks.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:30px; text-align:center; color:#8c8f94; border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:6px;">Nenhum bloco ainda. Clique nos botões abaixo para começar a estruturar sua aula.</div>';
                    refreshLivePreview();
                    return;
                }

                blocks.forEach(function(b, idx) {
                    var card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'ds-block-card';

                    // Barra superior do bloco
                    var header = document.createElement('div');
                    header.style.cssText = 'display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding-bottom:8px;';
                    
                    var badgeTitle = getBlockBadge(b.type);
                    header.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                            <span style="font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.5px;">` + badgeTitle + `</span>
                            <span style="font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">#` + (idx + 1) + `</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;">
                            <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="moveBlock(` + idx + `, -1)" title="Mover para Cima">▲</button>
                            <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="moveBlock(` + idx + `, 1)" title="Mover para Baixo">▼</button>
                            <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="duplicateBlock(` + idx + `)" title="Duplicar">📋</button>
                            <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="removeBlock(` + idx + `)" style="color:#e06c75;" title="Excluir Bloco">✕</button>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    card.appendChild(header);

                    // Conteúdo específico do bloco
                    var body = document.createElement('div');
                    body.innerHTML = renderBlockInputs(b, idx);
                    card.appendChild(body);

                    container.appendChild(card);
                });

                refreshLivePreview();
            }

            function getBlockBadge(type) {
                switch(type) {
                    case 'header': return '📌 Título';
                    case 'paragraph': return '📝 Parágrafo';
                    case 'video': return '🎬 Vídeo Embed (16:9)';
                    case 'code': return '💻 Bloco de Código';
                    case 'callout': return '💡 Dica / Alerta';
                    case 'list': return '📋 Lista';
                    case 'image': return '🖼️ Imagem';
                    case 'delimiter': return '➖ Divisor';
                    default: return 'Bloco';
                }
            }

            function escapeHtml(str) {
                return String(str || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
            }

            function renderBlockInputs(b, idx) {
                var d = b.data || {};

                switch(b.type) {
                    case 'header':
                        var lvl = d.level || 2;
                        return `
                            <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;">
                                <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'level', parseInt(this.value))" style="width:110px; padding:8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff;">
                                    <option value="1" ` + (lvl === 1 ? 'selected' : '') + `>H1 Principal</option>
                                    <option value="2" ` + (lvl === 2 ? 'selected' : '') + `>H2 Seção</option>
                                    <option value="3" ` + (lvl === 3 ? 'selected' : '') + `>H3 Subseção</option>
                                </select>
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(d.text) + `" placeholder="Digite o cabeçalho..." oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'text', this.value)" style="flex:1; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:15px; font-weight:600;">
                            </div>
                        `;

                    case 'paragraph':
                        return `
                            <textarea rows="4" placeholder="Escreva o texto da aula... Suporta formatações como <strong>, <em>, <code> e links." oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'text', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:14px; line-height:1.6; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;">` + escapeHtml(d.text) + `</textarea>
                        `;

                    case 'video':
                        var url = d.url || d.source || '';
                        var cap = d.caption || '';
                        var inlineEmbed = resolveVideoEmbedHtml(url);
                        return `
                            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;">
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(url) + `" placeholder="URL do Vídeo (YouTube: https://youtube.com/watch?v=... ou Vimeo / MP4)" oninput="updateVideoBlockUrl(` + idx + `, this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-family:monospace; box-sizing:border-box;">
                                <div id="inline_video_preview_` + idx + `">` + inlineEmbed + `</div>
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(cap) + `" placeholder="Legenda do vídeo (opcional)" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'caption', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                            </div>
                        `;

                    case 'code':
                        var lang = d.language || 'php';
                        var code = d.code || '';
                        return `
                            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
                                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
                                    <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Linguagem:</span>
                                    <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'language', this.value)" style="padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-family:monospace; font-size:12px;">
                                        <option value="php" ` + (lang === 'php' ? 'selected' : '') + `>PHP</option>
                                        <option value="python" ` + (lang === 'python' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Python</option>
                                        <option value="javascript" ` + (lang === 'javascript' ? 'selected' : '') + `>JavaScript</option>
                                        <option value="sql" ` + (lang === 'sql' ? 'selected' : '') + `>SQL</option>
                                        <option value="html" ` + (lang === 'html' ? 'selected' : '') + `>HTML</option>
                                        <option value="css" ` + (lang === 'css' ? 'selected' : '') + `>CSS</option>
                                        <option value="json" ` + (lang === 'json' ? 'selected' : '') + `>JSON</option>
                                        <option value="bash" ` + (lang === 'bash' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Bash / Shell</option>
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                                <textarea rows="6" placeholder="// Cole seu código aqui..." oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'code', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#08090b; color:#58a6ff; font-family:Consolas, Monaco, monospace; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;">` + escapeHtml(code) + `</textarea>
                            </div>
                        `;

                    case 'callout':
                        var ctype = d.type || 'info';
                        var ctext = d.text || '';
                        return `
                            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
                                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
                                    <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Tipo de Aviso:</span>
                                    <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'type', this.value)" style="padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:12px;">
                                        <option value="info" ` + (ctype === 'info' ? 'selected' : '') + `>💡 Dica / Informação (Azul)</option>
                                        <option value="success" ` + (ctype === 'success' ? 'selected' : '') + `>✅ Boas Práticas (Verde)</option>
                                        <option value="warning" ` + (ctype === 'warning' ? 'selected' : '') + `>⚠️ Atenção / Cuidado (Laranja)</option>
                                        <option value="danger" ` + (ctype === 'danger' ? 'selected' : '') + `>🛑 Erro Comum (Vermelho)</option>
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                                <textarea rows="3" placeholder="Mensagem do aviso didático..." oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'text', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:13px; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;">` + escapeHtml(ctext) + `</textarea>
                            </div>
                        `;

                    case 'list':
                        var itemsArr = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];
                        var itemsStr = itemsArr.map(function(it) {
                            return typeof it === 'string' ? it : (it.content || '');
                        }).join("\n");
                        var style = d.style || 'unordered';
                        return `
                            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
                                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
                                    <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Estilo:</span>
                                    <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'style', this.value)" style="padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:12px;">
                                        <option value="unordered" ` + (style === 'unordered' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Marcadores (Bulleted)</option>
                                        <option value="ordered" ` + (style === 'ordered' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Numerada (1, 2, 3...)</option>
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                                <textarea rows="4" placeholder="Um item por linha..." oninput="updateListItems(` + idx + `, this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:13px; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;">` + escapeHtml(itemsStr) + `</textarea>
                            </div>
                        `;

                    case 'image':
                        var imgUrl = d.url || (d.file ? d.file.url : '') || '';
                        var imgCap = d.caption || '';
                        return `
                            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(imgUrl) + `" placeholder="URL da imagem (ex: https://... ou /caminho/imagem.png)" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'url', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-family:monospace; box-sizing:border-box;">
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(imgCap) + `" placeholder="Legenda da imagem (opcional)" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'caption', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                            </div>
                        `;

                    case 'delimiter':
                        return `
                            <div style="padding:10px 0; text-align:center; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px;">
                                &mdash;&mdash;&mdash; Linha Divisória de Seção &mdash;&mdash;&mdash;
                            </div>
                        `;
                }
                return '';
            }

            window.addBlock = function(type) {
                var newBlock = {
                    id: 'b_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
                    type: type,
                    data: {}
                };

                switch(type) {
                    case 'header': newBlock.data = { level: 2, text: '' }; break;
                    case 'paragraph': newBlock.data = { text: '' }; break;
                    case 'video': newBlock.data = { url: '', caption: '' }; break;
                    case 'code': newBlock.data = { language: 'php', code: '' }; break;
                    case 'callout': newBlock.data = { type: 'info', text: '' }; break;
                    case 'list': newBlock.data = { style: 'unordered', items: [] }; break;
                    case 'image': newBlock.data = { url: '', caption: '' }; break;
                    case 'delimiter': newBlock.data = {}; break;
                }

                blocks.push(newBlock);
                renderCanvas();
            };

            window.removeBlock = function(idx) {
                if (confirm('Deseja excluir este bloco?')) {
                    blocks.splice(idx, 1);
                    renderCanvas();
                }
            };

            window.moveBlock = function(idx, dir) {
                var target = idx + dir;
                if (target >= 0 && target < blocks.length) {
                    var item = blocks.splice(idx, 1)[0];
                    blocks.splice(target, 0, item);
                    renderCanvas();
                }
            };

            window.duplicateBlock = function(idx) {
                var item = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(blocks[idx]));
                item.id = 'b_' + Date.now();
                blocks.splice(idx + 1, 0, item);
                renderCanvas();
            };

            window.updateBlockData = function(idx, key, val) {
                if (blocks[idx]) {
                    if (!blocks[idx].data) blocks[idx].data = {};
                    blocks[idx].data[key] = val;
                    refreshLivePreview();
                }
            };

            window.updateVideoBlockUrl = function(idx, val) {
                if (blocks[idx]) {
                    if (!blocks[idx].data) blocks[idx].data = {};
                    blocks[idx].data.url = val;
                    var inlineBox = document.getElementById('inline_video_preview_' + idx);
                    if (inlineBox) {
                        inlineBox.innerHTML = resolveVideoEmbedHtml(val);
                    }
                    refreshLivePreview();
                }
            };

            window.updateListItems = function(idx, text) {
                if (blocks[idx]) {
                    var lines = text.split("\n").map(function(s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(function(s) { return s.length > 0; });
                    blocks[idx].data.items = lines;
                    refreshLivePreview();
                }
            };

            window.saveLessonBlocks = function() {
                var btn = document.getElementById('btn_save_lesson');
                var btnText = document.getElementById('btn_save_text');
                var indicator = document.getElementById('save_indicator');
                var title = document.getElementById('lesson_title_input').value;
                var status = document.getElementById('lesson_status_select').value;

                btn.disabled = true;
                btnText.textContent = 'Salvando...';

                var payload = {
                    csrf_token: csrfToken,
                    title: title,
                    status: status,
                    blocks: blocks
                };

                fetch(baseUrl + '/admin/academy/lessons/' + lessonId + '/update-content', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                })
                .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
                .then(function(data) {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btnText.textContent = 'Salvar Aula';
                    if (data.success) {
                        indicator.style.display = 'inline';
                        setTimeout(function() { indicator.style.display = 'none'; }, 4000);
                        if (window.OS && window.OS.notify) {
                            window.OS.notify('Aula salva com sucesso!', 'success');
                        }
                    } else {
                        alert(data.message || 'Erro ao salvar aula.');
                    }
                })
                .catch(function(err) {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btnText.textContent = 'Salvar Aula';
                    alert('Erro na comunicação com o servidor: ' + err);
                });
            };

            // Atalho de teclado: Ctrl+S / Cmd+S para salvar
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 's') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    saveLessonBlocks();
                }
            });

            renderCanvas();
        })();
        </script>
        <?php
        $html = ob_get_clean();
        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function updateContent(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $lessonId = (int)$id;
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        // Aceita payload JSON ou Form POST
        $rawBody = (string)file_get_contents('php://input');
        $jsonData = json_decode($rawBody, true);

        $token = '';
        $title = null;
        $status = null;
        $blocks = null;

        if (is_array($jsonData)) {
            $token = (string)($jsonData['csrf_token'] ?? '');
            $title = isset($jsonData['title']) ? (string)$jsonData['title'] : null;
            $status = isset($jsonData['status']) ? (string)$jsonData['status'] : null;
            $blocks = $jsonData['blocks'] ?? null;
        } else {
            $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
            $title = $request->input('title');
            $status = $request->input('status');
            $rawBlocks = $request->input('blocks_json');
            if ($rawBlocks) {
                $blocks = is_array($rawBlocks) ? $rawBlocks : json_decode((string)$rawBlocks, true);
            } elseif (is_array($request->input('blocks'))) {
                $blocks = $request->input('blocks');
            }
        }

        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token CSRF inválido']), 403, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/lessons/' . $lessonId . '/editor');
        }

        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        if (!$lesson) {
            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Aula não encontrada']), 404, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Aula não encontrada.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $contentToSave = is_array($blocks) 
            ? json_encode(['time' => time(), 'blocks' => $blocks], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)
            : '';

        $updateData = [
            'source_type' => 'content',
            'content'     => $contentToSave,
        ];

        if ($title !== null && trim($title) !== '') {
            $updateData['title'] = trim($title);
        }
        if ($status !== null && in_array($status, ['published', 'draft'], true)) {
            $updateData['status'] = $status;
        }

        try {
            $this->structureRepo->updateLesson($lessonId, $updateData);

            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode([
                    'success' => true,
                    'message' => 'Aula salva com sucesso!'
                ]), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Conteúdo da aula atualizado com sucesso!");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/lessons/' . $lessonId . '/editor');
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Erro ao salvar: ' . $e->getMessage()
                ]), 500, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao salvar aula: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/lessons/' . $lessonId . '/editor');
        }
    }

    private function isAjax(Request $request): bool
    {
        $accept = (string)($request->server['HTTP_ACCEPT'] ?? '');
        $xrw = (string)($request->server['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH'] ?? '');
        $ct = (string)($request->server['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '');

        return str_contains($accept, 'application/json')
            || str_contains($xrw, 'XMLHttpRequest')
            || str_contains($ct, 'application/json');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

class PdoCourseStructureRepository implements CourseStructureRepositoryInterface
{
    private const VALID_STATUSES = ['draft', 'published'];
    private const VALID_SOURCE_TYPES = ['theme_file', 'content'];

    private static array $accentMap = [
        'á'=>'a','à'=>'a','ã'=>'a','â'=>'a','ä'=>'a',
        'é'=>'e','è'=>'e','ê'=>'e','ë'=>'e',
        'í'=>'i','ì'=>'i','î'=>'i','ï'=>'i',
        'ó'=>'o','ò'=>'o','õ'=>'o','ô'=>'o','ö'=>'o',
        'ú'=>'u','ù'=>'u','û'=>'u','ü'=>'u',
        'ç'=>'c','ñ'=>'n',
        'Á'=>'a','À'=>'a','Ã'=>'a','Â'=>'a','Ä'=>'a',
        'É'=>'e','È'=>'e','Ê'=>'e','Ë'=>'e',
        'Í'=>'i','Ì'=>'i','Î'=>'i','Ï'=>'i',
        'Ó'=>'o','Ò'=>'o','Õ'=>'o','Ô'=>'o','Ö'=>'o',
        'Ú'=>'u','Ù'=>'u','Û'=>'u','Ü'=>'u',
        'Ç'=>'c','Ñ'=>'n'
    ];

    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tablesEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
        $this->ensureTables();
    }

    public function getModules(int $courseId): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_modules 
            WHERE course_id = ? 
            ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function createModule(int $courseId, string $title, int $position = 0): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_modules (course_id, title, position) 
            VALUES (?, ?, ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $title, $position]);
        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function updateModule(int $moduleId, array $data): bool
    {
        $fields = [];
        $values = [];

        if (isset($data['title'])) {
            $fields[] = 'title = ?';
            $values[] = $data['title'];
        }
        if (isset($data['position'])) {
            $fields[] = 'position = ?';
            $values[] = (int)$data['position'];
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            return false;
        }

        $values[] = $moduleId;
        $sql = "UPDATE academy_modules SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($values);
    }

    public function deleteModule(int $moduleId): bool
    {
        // Ao excluir módulo, desvincula as aulas para não perdê-las (ou exclui dependendo da regra)
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE academy_lessons SET module_id = NULL WHERE module_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$moduleId]);

        $del = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE id = ?");
        return $del->execute([$moduleId]);
    }

    public function getLessons(int $courseId, ?int $moduleId = null): array
    {
        if ($moduleId !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
                WHERE course_id = ? AND module_id = ? 
                ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$courseId, $moduleId]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
                WHERE course_id = ? 
                ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        }

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function getLessonById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND slug = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getPublishedLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND slug = ? AND status = 'published'");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function createLesson(array $data): int
    {
        $sourceType = (string)($data['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
        $status = (string)($data['status'] ?? 'published');

        $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);

        $rawSlug = trim((string)($data['slug'] ?? ''));
        $rawTitle = trim((string)($data['title'] ?? 'Aula'));
        $slug = $this->sanitizeSlug($rawSlug !== '' ? $rawSlug : $rawTitle, (int)($data['position'] ?? 1));

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_lessons (
                course_id, module_id, title, slug, source_type, source, content, position, status
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            $data['course_id'],
            $data['module_id'] ?? null,
            $rawTitle !== '' ? $rawTitle : 'Aula',
            $slug,
            $sourceType,
            $data['source'] ?? null,
            $data['content'] ?? null,
            $data['position'] ?? 0,
            $status,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function updateLesson(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        if (array_key_exists('source_type', $data) || array_key_exists('status', $data)) {
            $sourceType = array_key_exists('source_type', $data) ? (string)$data['source_type'] : 'theme_file';
            $status = array_key_exists('status', $data) ? (string)$data['status'] : 'published';
            $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);
        }

        if (array_key_exists('slug', $data)) {
            $data['slug'] = $this->sanitizeSlug((string)$data['slug'], (int)($data['position'] ?? 1));
        }

        $allowed = ['title', 'slug', 'module_id', 'source_type', 'source', 'content', 'position', 'status'];
        $fields = [];
        $values = [];

        foreach ($allowed as $col) {
            if (array_key_exists($col, $data)) {
                $fields[] = "{$col} = ?";
                $values[] = $data[$col];
            }
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            return false;
        }

        $values[] = $id;
        $sql = "UPDATE academy_lessons SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($values);
    }

    public function deleteLesson(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    /**
     * Sincroniza a estrutura do curso por diff (H-04), preservando os IDs existentes de módulos
     * e aulas quando correspondem por ID (ou por slug do curso) e validando os campos (M-10).
     */
    public function replaceCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool
    {
        return $this->syncCourseStructure($courseId, $structure);
    }

    public function syncCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $existingModules = [];
            foreach ($this->getModules($courseId) as $m) {
                $existingModules[(int)$m['id']] = $m;
            }

            $existingLessonsById = [];
            $existingLessonsBySlug = [];
            foreach ($this->getLessons($courseId) as $l) {
                $lId = (int)$l['id'];
                $existingLessonsById[$lId] = $l;
                $existingLessonsBySlug[(string)$l['slug']] = $l;
            }

            $keptModuleIds = [];
            $keptLessonIds = [];
            $usedSlugs = [];

            $modulePos = 1;
            $lessonPosGlobal = 1;

            foreach ($structure as $modData) {
                $modTitle = trim((string)($modData['title'] ?? 'Módulo Geral'));
                if ($modTitle === '') {
                    $modTitle = 'Módulo Geral';
                }

                $candidateModId = isset($modData['id']) ? (int)$modData['id'] : 0;
                if ($candidateModId > 0 && isset($existingModules[$candidateModId]) && !in_array($candidateModId, $keptModuleIds, true)) {
                    $this->updateModule($candidateModId, [
                        'title'    => $modTitle,
                        'position' => $modulePos++,
                    ]);
                    $moduleId = $candidateModId;
                } else {
                    $moduleId = $this->createModule($courseId, $modTitle, $modulePos++);
                }
                $keptModuleIds[] = $moduleId;

                $lessons = $modData['lessons'] ?? [];
                if (!is_array($lessons)) {
                    continue;
                }

                foreach ($lessons as $lesson) {
                    $pos = $lessonPosGlobal++;
                    $title = trim((string)($lesson['title'] ?? 'Aula'));
                    if ($title === '') {
                        $title = 'Aula ' . $pos;
                    }

                    $sourceType = (string)($lesson['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
                    $status = (string)($lesson['status'] ?? 'published');
                    $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);

                    $rawSlug = trim((string)($lesson['slug'] ?? ''));
                    $baseSlug = $this->sanitizeSlug($rawSlug !== '' ? $rawSlug : $title, $pos);
                    $slug = $this->deduplicateSlugInBatch($baseSlug, $usedSlugs);
                    $usedSlugs[$slug] = true;

                    $matchedLessonId = 0;
                    $candidateLessonId = isset($lesson['id']) ? (int)$lesson['id'] : 0;
                    if ($candidateLessonId > 0 && isset($existingLessonsById[$candidateLessonId]) && !in_array($candidateLessonId, $keptLessonIds, true)) {
                        $matchedLessonId = $candidateLessonId;
                    } elseif (isset($existingLessonsBySlug[$baseSlug])) {
                        $bySlugId = (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$baseSlug]['id'];
                        if (!in_array($bySlugId, $keptLessonIds, true)) {
                            $matchedLessonId = $bySlugId;
                        }
                    }

                    // Se vai atualizar ou criar com um slug que já pertence a outra aula do curso ainda no BD,
                    // limpa temporariamente o slug conflitante caso a outra aula vá ser removida/renomeada.
                    if (isset($existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]) && (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]['id'] !== $matchedLessonId) {
                        $conflictId = (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]['id'];
                        $tmpStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE academy_lessons SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?");
                        $tmpStmt->execute(['__tmp_' . $conflictId . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3)), $conflictId]);
                    }

                    $lessonPayload = [
                        'course_id'   => $courseId,
                        'module_id'   => $moduleId,
                        'title'       => $title,
                        'slug'        => $slug,
                        'source_type' => $sourceType,
                        'source'      => $lesson['source'] ?? $lesson['theme_file'] ?? null,
                        'content'     => $lesson['content'] ?? ($matchedLessonId > 0 ? ($existingLessonsById[$matchedLessonId]['content'] ?? null) : null),
                        'position'    => $pos,
                        'status'      => $status,
                    ];

                    if ($matchedLessonId > 0) {
                        $this->updateLesson($matchedLessonId, $lessonPayload);
                        $keptLessonIds[] = $matchedLessonId;
                    } else {
                        $newLessonId = $this->createLesson($lessonPayload);
                        $keptLessonIds[] = $newLessonId;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Remove apenas aulas que não fazem mais parte da estrutura
            if (empty($keptLessonIds)) {
                $delLessons = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ?");
                $delLessons->execute([$courseId]);
            } else {
                $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($keptLessonIds), '?'));
                $delLessons = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND id NOT IN ({$placeholders})");
                $delLessons->execute(array_merge([$courseId], $keptLessonIds));
            }

            // Remove apenas módulos que não fazem mais parte da estrutura
            if (empty($keptModuleIds)) {
                $delModules = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE course_id = ?");
                $delModules->execute([$courseId]);
            } else {
                $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($keptModuleIds), '?'));
                $delModules = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE course_id = ? AND id NOT IN ({$placeholders})");
                $delModules->execute(array_merge([$courseId], $keptModuleIds));
            }

            $this->pdo->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function ensureTables(): void
    {
        if ($this->tablesEnsured) {
            return;
        }

        $driver = $this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);

        if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
            $this->pdo->exec("
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_modules (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    title TEXT NOT NULL,
                    position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                );

                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_lessons (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    module_id INTEGER NULL,
                    title TEXT NOT NULL,
                    slug TEXT NOT NULL,
                    source_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'theme_file',
                    source TEXT NULL,
                    content TEXT NULL,
                    position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                );

                CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_acad_less_slug ON academy_lessons (course_id, slug);
            ");
        } else {
            $this->pdo->exec("
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_modules (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    course_id INT NOT NULL,
                    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                    position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    INDEX idx_acad_mod_course (course_id)
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_lessons (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    course_id INT NOT NULL,
                    module_id INT NULL,
                    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                    slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                    source_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'theme_file',
                    source VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                    content LONGTEXT NULL,
                    position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    INDEX idx_acad_less_course (course_id),
                    UNIQUE INDEX idx_acad_less_slug (course_id, slug)
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
            ");
        }

        $this->tablesEnsured = true;
    }

    private function assertValidLessonEnums(string $sourceType, string $status): void
    {
        if (!in_array($sourceType, self::VALID_SOURCE_TYPES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Tipo de origem de aula inválido: {$sourceType}");
        }

        if (!in_array($status, self::VALID_STATUSES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Status de aula inválido: {$status}");
        }
    }

    private function sanitizeSlug(string $raw, int $fallbackPos = 1): string
    {
        $text = strtr($raw, self::$accentMap);
        if (function_exists('transliterator_transliterate')) {
            $trans = transliterator_transliterate('Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII; Lower()', $text);
            if ($trans !== false) {
                $text = $trans;
            }
        }

        $slug = strtolower(trim((string)preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/', '-', $text), '-'));
        return $slug !== '' ? $slug : ('aula-' . $fallbackPos);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, bool> $usedSlugs
     */
    private function deduplicateSlugInBatch(string $baseSlug, array $usedSlugs): string
    {
        $slug = $baseSlug;
        $counter = 1;
        while (isset($usedSlugs[$slug])) {
            $slug = "{$baseSlug}-{$counter}";
            $counter++;
        }
        return $slug;
    }
}

// Arquivo: academy/Services\LocalCourseImageStorage.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\LocalPublicStorage;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseImageStorageInterface;

class LocalCourseImageStorage implements CourseImageStorageInterface
{
    private PublicStorageInterface $storage;
    private const MAX_BYTES = 2097152; // 2 MB
    private const ALLOWED_MIMES = [
        'image/jpeg' => 'jpg',
        'image/png'  => 'png',
        'image/webp' => 'webp',
    ];

    /**
     * @param PublicStorageInterface|string $storage Instância do PublicStorage do Core ou caminho para retrocompatibilidade
     */
    public function __construct(PublicStorageInterface|string $storage)
    {
        if (is_string($storage)) {
            $this->storage = new LocalPublicStorage($storage);
        } else {
            $this->storage = $storage;
        }
    }

    public function storeUpload(array $fileInfo): string
    {
        if (empty($fileInfo['tmp_name']) || !file_exists($fileInfo['tmp_name'])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Nenhum arquivo válido enviado.");
        }

        $size = (int)($fileInfo['size'] ?? filesize($fileInfo['tmp_name']));
        if ($size > self::MAX_BYTES) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("A imagem deve ter no máximo 2MB.");
        }

        // Validação estrita de MIME type real (finfo com fallbacks resilientes)
        $realMime = null;
        if (class_exists('\finfo')) {
            try {
                $finfo = new \finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                $realMime = $finfo->file($fileInfo['tmp_name']);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $realMime = null;
            }
        }
        if (empty($realMime) && function_exists('mime_content_type')) {
            $realMime = @mime_content_type($fileInfo['tmp_name']);
        }

        // Validação de dimensões e aspect ratio
        $imageSize = @getimagesize($fileInfo['tmp_name']);
        if (!$imageSize) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo enviado não é uma imagem válida.");
        }

        if (empty($realMime) && !empty($imageSize['mime'])) {
            $realMime = $imageSize['mime'];
        }

        if (empty($realMime) || !isset(self::ALLOWED_MIMES[$realMime])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Formato inválido. Apenas JPG, PNG ou WEBP são aceitos.");
        }

        $width = (int)$imageSize[0];
        $height = (int)$imageSize[1];
        if ($width < 640 || $height < 360) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Dimensão mínima exigida: 640x360 pixels (enviado: {$width}x{$height}).");
        }

        $aspectRatio = $width / $height;
        $expectedRatio = 16.0 / 9.0; // ~1.777
        if (abs($aspectRatio - $expectedRatio) > 0.10) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("A imagem do card deve respeitar a proporção 16:9 (horizontal).");
        }

        $extension = self::ALLOWED_MIMES[$realMime];
        $safeName = 'course_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(10)) . '.' . $extension;
        $destination = $this->storage->getUploadPath('academy/' . $safeName);

        $destDir = dirname($destination);
        if (!is_dir($destDir)) {
            @mkdir($destDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $moved = false;
        if (is_uploaded_file($fileInfo['tmp_name'])) {
            $moved = @move_uploaded_file($fileInfo['tmp_name'], $destination);
        }
        if (!$moved) {
            $moved = @copy($fileInfo['tmp_name'], $destination);
        }

        if (!$moved) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Falha ao salvar a imagem no diretório de destino ('{$destination}'). Verifique as permissões de escrita na pasta 'uploads/academy'.");
        }

        return 'uploads/academy/' . $safeName;
    }

    public function deleteFile(string $relativePath): void
    {
        $this->storage->delete($relativePath);
    }

    public function getUploadDir(): string
    {
        return $this->storage->getUploadPath('academy');
    }

    public function getStorage(): PublicStorageInterface
    {
        return $this->storage;
    }
}

// Arquivo: academy/Services\CourseService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseImageStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;

class CourseService
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private CourseImageStorageInterface $storage;

    private static array $accentMap = [
        'á'=>'a','à'=>'a','ã'=>'a','â'=>'a','ä'=>'a',
        'é'=>'e','è'=>'e','ê'=>'e','ë'=>'e',
        'í'=>'i','ì'=>'i','î'=>'i','ï'=>'i',
        'ó'=>'o','ò'=>'o','õ'=>'o','ô'=>'o','ö'=>'o',
        'ú'=>'u','ù'=>'u','û'=>'u','ü'=>'u',
        'ç'=>'c','ñ'=>'n',
        'Á'=>'a','À'=>'a','Ã'=>'a','Â'=>'a','Ä'=>'a',
        'É'=>'e','È'=>'e','Ê'=>'e','Ë'=>'e',
        'Í'=>'i','Ì'=>'i','Î'=>'i','Ï'=>'i',
        'Ó'=>'o','Ò'=>'o','Õ'=>'o','Ô'=>'o','Ö'=>'o',
        'Ú'=>'u','Ù'=>'u','Û'=>'u','Ü'=>'u',
        'Ç'=>'c','Ñ'=>'n'
    ];

    public function __construct(CourseRepositoryInterface $repository, CourseImageStorageInterface $storage)
    {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->storage = $storage;
    }

    public function createCourse(array $data, ?array $uploadedFile = null): int
    {
        $this->validateData($data);

        $slug = $this->generateUniqueSlug((string)$data['title']);
        $thumbnail = null;

        if (!empty($uploadedFile['tmp_name'])) {
            $thumbnail = $this->storage->storeUpload($uploadedFile);
        }

        try {
            $courseId = $this->repository->create([
                'title'       => trim((string)$data['title']),
                'slug'        => $slug,
                'description' => trim((string)($data['description'] ?? '')),
                'thumbnail'   => $thumbnail,
                'status'      => $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
                'link'        => trim((string)($data['link'] ?? '')),
            ]);
            if ($courseId <= 0 && $thumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($thumbnail);
            }
            return $courseId;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if ($thumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($thumbnail);
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function updateCourse(int $id, array $data, ?array $uploadedFile = null): bool
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById($id);
        if (!$course) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Curso #{$id} não encontrado.");
        }

        $this->validateData($data);

        $slug = $course['slug'];
        if (trim((string)$data['title']) !== (string)$course['title']) {
            $slug = $this->generateUniqueSlug((string)$data['title'], $id);
        }

        $oldThumbnail = $course['thumbnail'] ?? null;
        $newThumbnail = null;
        if (!empty($uploadedFile['tmp_name'])) {
            $newThumbnail = $this->storage->storeUpload($uploadedFile);
        }

        $effectiveThumbnail = $newThumbnail ?? $oldThumbnail;

        try {
            $updated = $this->repository->update($id, [
                'title'       => trim((string)$data['title']),
                'slug'        => $slug,
                'description' => trim((string)($data['description'] ?? '')),
                'thumbnail'   => $effectiveThumbnail,
                'status'      => $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
                'link'        => trim((string)($data['link'] ?? '')),
            ]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if ($newThumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($newThumbnail);
            }
            throw $e;
        }

        if (!$updated) {
            if ($newThumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($newThumbnail);
            }
            return false;
        }

        if ($newThumbnail !== null && !empty($oldThumbnail) && $oldThumbnail !== $newThumbnail) {
            $this->storage->deleteFile((string)$oldThumbnail);
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function deleteCourse(int $id): bool
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById($id);
        $deleted = $this->repository->delete($id);

        if ($deleted && $course && !empty($course['thumbnail'])) {
            $this->storage->deleteFile((string)$course['thumbnail']);
        }

        return $deleted;
    }

    public function generateUniqueSlug(string $title, ?int $ignoreId = null): string
    {
        $text = strtr($title, self::$accentMap);

        if (function_exists('transliterator_transliterate')) {
            $trans = transliterator_transliterate('Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII; Lower()', $text);
            if ($trans !== false) {
                $text = $trans;
            }
        }

        $slug = strtolower(trim((string)preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/', '-', $text), '-'));
        if (empty($slug)) {
            $slug = 'curso';
        }

        $base = $slug;
        $counter = 1;

        while ($existing = $this->repository->findBySlug($slug)) {
            if ($ignoreId !== null && (int)$existing['id'] === $ignoreId) {
                break;
            }
            $slug = "{$base}-{$counter}";
            $counter++;
        }

        return $slug;
    }

    private function validateData(array $data): void
    {
        if (empty(trim((string)($data['title'] ?? '')))) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O título do curso é obrigatório.");
        }

        $validStatuses = ['draft', 'soon', 'published'];
        if (!in_array($data['status'] ?? 'draft', $validStatuses, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Status inválido.");
        }

        if (!empty($data['link'])) {
            $link = (string)$data['link'];
            if (!filter_var($link, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) && !str_starts_with($link, '/') && !str_starts_with($link, '#')) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("O link informado deve ser uma URL válida ou um caminho relativo.");
            }
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: academy/Services\CourseNavigationService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;

class CourseNavigationService implements CourseNavigationInterface
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private string $baseUrl;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        ?string $baseUrl = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->baseUrl = $baseUrl ?? (defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '');
    }

    private function resolveCourse(string|int $courseIdentifier): ?array
    {
        if (is_numeric($courseIdentifier)) {
            return $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$courseIdentifier);
        }
        return $this->courseRepo->findBySlug((string)$courseIdentifier);
    }

    public function getCourseTree(string|int $courseIdentifier): array
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return [];
        }

        $courseId = (int)$course['id'];
        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];

        $modules = $this->structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);

        // Agrupa apenas aulas publicadas por module_id
        $lessonsByModule = [];
        $standaloneLessons = [];

        foreach ($allLessons as $lesson) {
            if (($lesson['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
                continue;
            }
            $lessonSlug = (string)$lesson['slug'];
            $lesson['url'] = $this->baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug) . '/' . urlencode($lessonSlug);

            $modId = $lesson['module_id'] !== null ? (int)$lesson['module_id'] : null;
            if ($modId !== null && $modId > 0) {
                $lessonsByModule[$modId][] = $lesson;
            } else {
                $standaloneLessons[] = $lesson;
            }
        }

        $tree = [];

        foreach ($modules as $mod) {
            $mId = (int)$mod['id'];
            $tree[] = [
                'id'       => $mId,
                'title'    => (string)$mod['title'],
                'position' => (int)$mod['position'],
                'lessons'  => $lessonsByModule[$mId] ?? [],
            ];
        }

        // Se houver aulas sem módulo cadastrado, agrupa num módulo geral
        if (!empty($standaloneLessons)) {
            $tree[] = [
                'id'       => 0,
                'title'    => 'Aulas Gerais',
                'position' => 999,
                'lessons'  => $standaloneLessons,
            ];
        }

        return $tree;
    }

    public function renderCourseNav(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug = '', array $options = []): string
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return '';
        }

        $tree = $this->getCourseTree($courseIdentifier);
        if (empty($tree)) {
            return '';
        }

        $courseTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];
        $courseUrl = $this->baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug);

        $html = '<nav class="course-nav ds-academy-nav" aria-label="Navegação do Curso ' . $courseTitle . '">';
        $html .= '<div class="course-nav-header">';
        $html .= '<a href="' . $courseUrl . '" class="course-nav-home-link">🎓 ' . $courseTitle . '</a>';
        $html .= '</div>';

        $html .= '<div class="course-nav-body">';

        $globalLessonCounter = 1;

        foreach ($tree as $mod) {
            $modTitle = htmlspecialchars($mod['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $lessons = $mod['lessons'] ?? [];

            $html .= '<div class="course-nav-module">';
            $html .= '<h4 class="course-nav-module-title">' . $modTitle . '</h4>';
            $html .= '<ul class="course-nav-lessons">';

            foreach ($lessons as $lesson) {
                $lTitle = htmlspecialchars($lesson['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $lSlug = (string)$lesson['slug'];
                $lUrl = htmlspecialchars($lesson['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $isActive = ($lSlug === $currentLessonSlug);

                $activeClass = $isActive ? ' is-active current-lesson' : '';
                $ariaCurrent = $isActive ? ' aria-current="page"' : '';

                $html .= '<li class="course-nav-lesson-item' . $activeClass . '">';
                $html .= '<a href="' . $lUrl . '"' . $ariaCurrent . ' class="course-nav-lesson-link">';
                $html .= '<span class="lesson-index">' . sprintf('%02d', $globalLessonCounter++) . '</span> ';
                $html .= '<span class="lesson-title">' . $lTitle . '</span>';
                $html .= '</a>';
                $html .= '</li>';
            }

            $html .= '</ul>';
            $html .= '</div>';
        }

        $html .= '</div>';
        $html .= '</nav>';

        return $html;
    }

    public function getAdjacentLessons(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug): array
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];
        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);

        if (empty($allLessons)) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        // Filtra apenas aulas publicadas e normaliza
        $flat = [];
        foreach ($allLessons as $l) {
            if (($l['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
                continue;
            }
            $slug = (string)$l['slug'];
            $flat[] = [
                'id'    => (int)$l['id'],
                'title' => (string)$l['title'],
                'slug'  => $slug,
                'url'   => $this->baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug) . '/' . urlencode($slug),
            ];
        }

        $currentIndex = -1;
        foreach ($flat as $index => $item) {
            if ($item['slug'] === $currentLessonSlug) {
                $currentIndex = $index;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($currentIndex === -1) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        $prev = ($currentIndex > 0) ? $flat[$currentIndex - 1] : null;
        $next = ($currentIndex < count($flat) - 1) ? $flat[$currentIndex + 1] : null;

        return ['prev' => $prev, 'next' => $next];
    }
}

// Arquivo: academy/Services\CourseCatalogRenderer.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;

class CourseCatalogRenderer
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private ?PublicStorageInterface $storage;

    public function __construct(CourseRepositoryInterface $repository, ?PublicStorageInterface $storage = null)
    {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->storage = $storage;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attrs Atributos do shortcode [hub_de_cursos limit="6" status="published"]
     */
    public function render(array $attrs = []): string
    {
        $limit = isset($attrs['limit']) ? (int)$attrs['limit'] : 12;
        if ($limit <= 0) {
            $limit = 12;
        }

        $status = $attrs['status'] ?? null;
        $filters = ['limit' => $limit];
        if (!empty($status) && in_array($status, ['published', 'soon', 'draft'], true)) {
            $filters['status'] = $status;
        }

        $courses = $this->repository->findPublished($filters);

        if (empty($courses)) {
            return "<div class='ds-academy-empty' style='text-align:center; padding:40px 20px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:12px; border:1px dashed rgba(69,243,255,0.2); color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94);'>
                <p style='margin:0; font-size:1.05rem;'>Nenhum curso disponível no momento.</p>
            </div>";
        }

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $html = "<div class='academy-grid' style='display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; margin: 30px 0;'>";

        foreach ($courses as $course) {
            $title = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['title'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $desc = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['description'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $defaultCourseUrl = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''));
            $link = !empty($course['link']) ? htmlspecialchars((string)$course['link'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : htmlspecialchars($defaultCourseUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

            if (!empty($course['thumbnail'])) {
                $rawThumb = (string)$course['thumbnail'];
                if ($this->storage !== null) {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($this->storage->getPublicUrl($rawThumb), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                } elseif (str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'http://') || str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'https://') || str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'data:')) {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($rawThumb, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                } else {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($rawThumb, '/'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                }
            } else {
                $thumbUrl = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="640" height="360" viewBox="0 0 640 360"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="%231e2327"/><text x="50%" y="50%" fill="%2345f3ff" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">🎓 Academy</text></svg>';
            }

            $badge = '';
            if (($course['status'] ?? '') === 'soon') {
                $badge = "<span style='position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px; background:#f0ad4e; color:#0b0c10; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:20px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); text-transform:uppercase;'>EM BREVE</span>";
            }

            $html .= "
            <div class=\"course-card glass-panel\" style=\"background:var(--bg-panel, #1d2327); border:1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15); border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:relative; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;\">
                <div style=\"position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; background:#0b0c10; overflow:hidden;\">
                    <img src=\"{$thumbUrl}\" alt=\"{$title}\" style=\"width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block;\" loading=\"lazy\">
                    {$badge}
                </div>
                <div style=\"padding:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; flex-grow:1;\">
                    <h3 style=\"margin:0 0 10px 0; font-size:1.2rem; color:var(--text-main, #ffffff); line-height:1.4;\">{$title}</h3>
                    <p style=\"margin:0 0 18px 0; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); font-size:0.95rem; line-height:1.5; flex-grow:1;\">{$desc}</p>
                    <a href=\"{$link}\" style=\"display:inline-block; text-align:center; padding:10px 18px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--primary, #45f3ff); color:#0b0c10; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition:opacity 0.2s;\" onmouseover=\"this.style.opacity='0.85'\" onmouseout=\"this.style.opacity='1'\">
                        Acessar Conteúdo &rarr;
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>";
        }

        $html .= "</div>";

        $html .= "
        <style>
            .course-card:hover {
                transform: translateY(-4px);
                box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 12px rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2);
            }
        </style>";

        return $html;
    }
}
