// Arquivo: academy/Plugin.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseImageStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseFrontController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\LessonAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseStructureRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseCatalogRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseNavigationService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LocalCourseImageStorage;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->requireLink('core.storage');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('shortcodes.register');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // 1. Injeção de Dependências no Container
        $runtime->singleton(CourseRepositoryInterface::class, function() use ($runtime) {
            $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db')->getPdo();
            return new PdoCourseRepository($db);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class, function() use ($runtime) {
            $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db')->getPdo();
            return new PdoCourseStructureRepository($db);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseImageStorageInterface::class, function() use ($runtime) {
            $storage = $runtime->getLink('core.storage');
            return new LocalCourseImageStorage($storage);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseService::class, function() use ($runtime) {
            return new CourseService(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseImageStorageInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseNavigationInterface::class, function() use ($runtime) {
            $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
            return new CourseNavigationService(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class),
                $baseUrl
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseCatalogRenderer::class, function() use ($runtime) {
            return new CourseCatalogRenderer(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->getLink('core.storage')
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(LessonBlockRenderer::class, function() {
            return new LessonBlockRenderer();
        });

        // 2. Menu Administrativo
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function($menus, $role = 'guest') {
            if ($role === 'admin') {
                $menus[] = [
                    'title' => 'Academy (Cursos)',
                    'url'   => '/admin/academy',
                    'icon'  => '🎓'
                ];
            }
            return $menus;
        });

        // 3. Rotas Administrativas e Públicas
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function(Router $router) {
            // Administrativas - Cursos
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy', [CourseAdminController::class, 'index'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy/edit/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'edit'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/store', [CourseAdminController::class, 'store'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/update/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'update'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/structure/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'updateStructure'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/delete/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'delete'], 'academy', ['admin']);

            // Administrativas - Editor em Blocos de Aulas
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy/lessons/{id}/editor', [LessonAdminController::class, 'editor'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/lessons/{id}/update-content', [LessonAdminController::class, 'updateContent'], 'academy', ['admin']);

            // Públicas
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cursos', [CourseFrontController::class, 'index'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cursos/{courseSlug}', [CourseFrontController::class, 'showCourse'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cursos/{courseSlug}/{lessonSlug}', [CourseFrontController::class, 'showLesson'], 'academy');
        });

        // 4. Shortcode: [hub_de_cursos]
        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function(\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $manager) use ($runtime) {
            $manager->add('hub_de_cursos', function($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                try {
                    /** @var CourseCatalogRenderer $renderer */
                    $renderer = $runtime->make(CourseCatalogRenderer::class);
                    return $renderer->render(is_array($attrs) ? $attrs : []);
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    return "<div style='text-align:center; padding:30px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:8px; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94);'>Hub de Cursos em configuração.</div>";
                }
            });
        });
    }

    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db')->getPdo();
        new PdoCourseRepository($db);
        $structureRepo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($db);
        $structureRepo->ensureTables();
    }
}

// Arquivo: academy/Controllers\CourseFrontController.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseCatalogRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\seo\Contracts\SeoManagerInterface;

class CourseFrontController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private CourseNavigationInterface $navService;
    private CourseCatalogRenderer $catalogRenderer;
    private ?SeoManagerInterface $seo;
    private ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;
    private LessonBlockRenderer $blockRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        CourseNavigationInterface $navService,
        CourseCatalogRenderer $catalogRenderer,
        ?SeoManagerInterface $seo = null,
        ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        ?LessonBlockRenderer $blockRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->navService = $navService;
        $this->catalogRenderer = $catalogRenderer;
        $this->seo = $seo;
        $this->themeManager = $themeManager;
        $this->blockRenderer = $blockRenderer ?? new LessonBlockRenderer();
    }

    /**
     * Catálogo geral de cursos: GET /cursos
     */
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        if ($this->seo !== null) {
            $this->seo->setTitle('Cursos & Tutoriais | Rachid')
                ->setDescription('Explore os cursos e tutoriais de arquitetura de software, PHP e engenharia de sistemas.');
        }

        $catalogHtml = $this->catalogRenderer->render();

        $themePath = $this->resolveActiveThemePath();
        $academyTemplateCandidate = $themePath . '/templates/academy.php';

        if ($this->themeManager !== null && file_exists($academyTemplateCandidate)) {
            try {
                $html = $this->themeManager->render('templates/academy', [
                    'page' => [
                        'title'   => 'Cursos & Tutoriais',
                        'content' => $catalogHtml,
                    ],
                ]);
                return new Response($html);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                // Fallback para renderização direta
            }
        }

        $html = "
        <section class='ds-academy-catalog-section' style='padding: 60px 20px; min-height: 70vh;'>
            <div class='container' style='max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;'>
                <header style='text-align: center; margin-bottom: 50px;'>
                    <div style='display: inline-block; background: rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.1); color: var(--primary, #45f3ff); padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.3); margin-bottom: 1.5rem;'>
                        Academy
                    </div>
                    <h1 style='font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1rem; color: #fff; letter-spacing: -1.5px;'>
                        Cursos &amp; Tutoriais
                    </h1>
                    <p style='font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.7;'>
                        Aprenda engenharia de software avançada, padrões arquiteturais e práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
                    </p>
                </header>
                {$catalogHtml}
            </div>
        </section>";

        return new Response($html);
    }

    /**
     * Página de apresentação e índice do curso: GET /cursos/{courseSlug}
     */
    public function showCourse(string $courseSlug): Response
    {
        $course = $this->courseRepo->findBySlug($courseSlug);
        if (!$course || ($course['status'] ?? '') === 'draft') {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1><p>Não encontramos o curso solicitado: [" . htmlspecialchars($courseSlug, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "]</p>", 404);
        }

        $title = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $desc = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['description'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        if ($this->seo !== null) {
            $this->seo->setTitle($title . ' | Academy Rachid')
                ->setDescription(mb_substr(strip_tags((string)($course['description'] ?? '')), 0, 150) . '...');
        }

        $navHtml = $this->navService->renderCourseNav($courseSlug);
        $tree = $this->navService->getCourseTree($courseSlug);

        // Identifica a primeira aula para o botão "Começar Agora" apenas se o curso estiver publicado
        $firstLessonUrl = null;
        if (($course['status'] ?? '') === 'published') {
            foreach ($tree as $mod) {
                if (!empty($mod['lessons'])) {
                    $firstLessonUrl = $mod['lessons'][0]['url'] ?? null;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        $ctaButton = '';
        if ($firstLessonUrl) {
            $ctaButton = "<a href='{$firstLessonUrl}' class='btn btn-primary' style='display:inline-block; margin-top:20px; text-decoration:none;'>🚀 Começar Agora &rarr;</a>";
        }

        $html = "
        <section class='ds-academy-course-overview' style='padding: 60px 20px; min-height: 75vh;'>
            <div class='container' style='max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto;'>
                <div class='glass-panel' style='padding: 40px; margin-bottom: 40px; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2);'>
                    <div style='display: inline-block; background: rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.1); color: var(--primary, #45f3ff); padding: 0.35rem 1rem; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 1rem;'>
                        Curso Academy
                    </div>
                    <h1 style='color: #fff; font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1rem;'>{$title}</h1>
                    <p style='color: var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 800px; margin-bottom: 20px;'>{$desc}</p>
                    {$ctaButton}
                </div>

                <div class='glass-panel' style='padding: 30px; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15);'>
                    <h3 style='margin-bottom: 20px; color: #fff; font-size: 1.4rem;'>Índice de Módulos &amp; Aulas</h3>
                    {$navHtml}
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>";

        return new Response($html);
    }

    /**
     * Exibição de aula específica com sidebar navegável: GET /cursos/{courseSlug}/{lessonSlug}
     */
    public function showLesson(string $courseSlug, string $lessonSlug): Response
    {
        $course = $this->courseRepo->findBySlug($courseSlug);
        if (!$course) {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1>", 404);
        }
        if (($course['status'] ?? '') !== 'published') {
            $statusLabel = ($course['status'] ?? '') === 'soon' ? 'Em Breve' : 'Rascunho';
            return new Response(
                "<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1>" .
                "<p>O curso <strong>" . htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</strong> está com o status <strong>{$statusLabel}</strong>. Altere o status do curso para <strong>Publicado</strong> no painel Academy para liberar o acesso às aulas.</p>",
                404
            );
        }

        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getPublishedLessonBySlug((int)$course['id'], $lessonSlug);
        if (!$lesson || ($lesson['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Aula não encontrada</h1><p>A aula solicitada não existe ou está em rascunho neste curso.</p>", 404);
        }

        $lessonTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$lesson['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $courseTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        if ($this->seo !== null) {
            $plainDesc = $this->blockRenderer->extractPlainText((string)($lesson['content'] ?? ''));
            if ($plainDesc === '') {
                $plainDesc = strip_tags((string)($course['description'] ?? ''));
            }
            $this->seo->setTitle($lessonTitle . ' - ' . $courseTitle . ' | Academy Rachid')
                ->setDescription(mb_substr($plainDesc, 0, 150) . '...');
        }

        $navHtml = $this->navService->renderCourseNav($courseSlug, $lessonSlug);
        $adjacent = $this->navService->getAdjacentLessons($courseSlug, $lessonSlug);

        // Resolução híbrida do conteúdo da aula (Arquivo de Tema vs Editor em Blocos / Conteúdo)
        $bodyContent = '';
        $themeFile = $lesson['source'] ?? $lesson['theme_file'] ?? null;
        if (!empty($themeFile) && ($lesson['source_type'] ?? '') !== 'content') {
            $bodyContent = $this->renderThemeFile((string)$themeFile, [
                'course'   => $course,
                'lesson'   => $lesson,
                'adjacent' => $adjacent,
                'navHtml'  => $navHtml,
            ]);
        } elseif (!empty($lesson['content'])) {
            $bodyContent = $this->blockRenderer->render((string)$lesson['content']);
        } else {
            $bodyContent = "<div class='ds-academy-empty-lesson' style='padding:40px; text-align:center; color:var(--text-muted);'><p>O conteúdo desta aula está sendo preparado.</p></div>";
        }

        // Paginação (Anterior / Próxima)
        $paginationHtml = $this->renderPagination($adjacent);

        $courseUrl = (defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '') . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug);

        $html = "
        <section class='ds-academy-classroom' style='padding: 40px 20px; min-height: 80vh;'>
            <div class='container' style='max-width: 1300px; margin: 0 auto;'>
                
                <!-- Barra Mobile Interativa de Índice de Aulas (visível apenas em telas <= 900px) -->
                <div class='ds-academy-mobile-bar'>
                    <button type='button' class='ds-academy-drawer-toggle' onclick='window.toggleAcademyMobileDrawer(true)' aria-label='Abrir Índice de Aulas'>
                        <span>📚 Índice de Módulos &amp; Aulas</span>
                        <span class='ds-drawer-pill'>Ver Aulas &#9776;</span>
                    </button>
                </div>

                <!-- Backdrop do Drawer Mobile -->
                <div id='ds-academy-drawer-backdrop' class='ds-academy-drawer-backdrop' onclick='window.toggleAcademyMobileDrawer(false)'></div>

                <div class='ds-academy-grid' style='display: grid; grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr; gap: 30px; align-items: start;'>
                    
                    <!-- Sidebar / Drawer com Navegação do Curso -->
                    <aside id='ds-academy-sidebar' class='ds-academy-sidebar glass-panel' style='padding: 24px; position: sticky; top: 100px; max-height: calc(100vh - 120px); overflow-y: auto;'>
                        <div class='ds-academy-drawer-close-bar'>
                            <span style='font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:1px; color:var(--primary, #45f3ff);'>Navegação do Curso</span>
                            <button type='button' onclick='window.toggleAcademyMobileDrawer(false)' class='ds-academy-drawer-close-btn' aria-label='Fechar menu'>✕</button>
                        </div>
                        {$navHtml}
                    </aside>

                    <!-- Conteúdo Principal da Aula -->
                    <article class='ds-academy-main-article glass-panel' style='padding: 40px; min-width: 0;'>
                        <header style='margin-bottom: 30px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15); padding-bottom: 20px;'>
                            <div style='font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 8px;'>
                                <a href='{$courseUrl}' style='color: var(--primary, #45f3ff); text-decoration: none;'>&larr; {$courseTitle}</a>
                            </div>
                            <h1 class='ds-academy-lesson-h1' style='color: #fff; font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 800; margin: 0;'>{$lessonTitle}</h1>

    private function renderPagination(array $adjacent): string
    {
        $prev = $adjacent['prev'] ?? null;
        $next = $adjacent['next'] ?? null;

        if (!$prev && !$next) {
            return '';
        }

        $prevHtml = '';
        if ($prev) {
            $prevTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$prev['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $prevUrl = htmlspecialchars((string)$prev['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $prevHtml = "<a href='{$prevUrl}' class='btn btn-outline' style='text-decoration:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;'>
                &larr; Anterior: {$prevTitle}
            </a>";
        }

        $nextHtml = '';
        if ($next) {
            $nextTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$next['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $nextUrl = htmlspecialchars((string)$next['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $nextHtml = "<a href='{$nextUrl}' class='btn btn-primary' style='text-decoration:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;'>
                Próxima Aula: {$nextTitle} &rarr;
            </a>";
        }

        return "
        <nav class='ds-academy-pagination' aria-label='Navegação entre Aulas' style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:16px; margin-top:50px; padding-top:30px; border-top:1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15);'>
            <div>{$prevHtml}</div>
            <div>{$nextHtml}</div>
        </nav>";
    }

    private function renderThemeFile(string $themeFile, array $context): string
    {
        $themePath = $this->resolveActiveThemePath();
        $target = $themePath . '/' . ltrim($themeFile, '/\\');

        $realTarget = realpath($target);
        $realTheme = realpath($themePath);
        $realThemePrefix = $realTheme !== false ? rtrim($realTheme, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR : '';

        if ($realTarget === false || $realTheme === false || !str_starts_with($realTarget, $realThemePrefix) || !is_file($realTarget)) {
            return "<div class='alert alert-warning' style='padding:20px; color:#ffb703; background:rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.1); border-radius:8px;'>Arquivo do tema não encontrado ou inacessível: " . htmlspecialchars($themeFile, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</div>";
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($context, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $realTarget;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }

    private function resolveActiveThemePath(): string
    {
        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $activePath = $this->themeManager->getActiveThemePath();
            if (!empty($activePath) && is_dir($activePath)) {
                return $activePath;
            }
        }

        $baseRoot = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4);
        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $baseRoot . '/themes',
            $baseRoot . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes',
        ]);

        $siteState = new EnvSiteState();
        return $resolver->resolveThemePath($siteState->getActiveTheme());
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: academy/Services\LessonBlockRenderer.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

/**
 * Renderizador de Conteúdo em Blocos para Aulas do Academy (SOLID - SRP).
 *
 * Converte estruturas de blocos JSON (estilo Gutenberg / Notion / Editor.js)
 * em HTML semântico, responsivo, seguro (anti-XSS) e perfeitamente integrado
 * ao design Dark/Cyberpunk do sistema.
 */
class LessonBlockRenderer
{
    private const ALLOWED_INLINE_TAGS = '<strong><b><em><i><code><a><mark><kbd><br><small><u><del>';

    /**
     * Renderiza o conteúdo da aula.
     * Se for um JSON de blocos, renderiza cada bloco em HTML semântico.
     * Se for uma string comum/legada, retorna diretamente.
     */
    public function render(?string $content): string
    {
        if ($content === null || trim($content) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $trimmed = trim($content);

        // Detecta se é JSON de blocos
        if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '{') || str_starts_with($trimmed, '[')) {
            $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $blocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : null);
                if (is_array($blocks)) {
                    return $this->renderBlocks($blocks);
                }
            }
        }

        // Conteúdo legado / HTML cru
        return $content;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $blocks
     */
    public function renderBlocks(array $blocks): string
    {
        $html = [];
        $html[] = '<div class="ds-lesson-blocks" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px;">';

        foreach ($blocks as $block) {
            $type = (string)($block['type'] ?? '');
            $data = is_array($block['data'] ?? null) ? $block['data'] : [];

            switch ($type) {
                case 'header':
                case 'heading':
                    $html[] = $this->renderHeader($data);
                    break;

                case 'paragraph':
                case 'text':
                    $html[] = $this->renderParagraph($data);
                    break;

                case 'video':
                case 'embed':
                    $html[] = $this->renderVideo($data);
                    break;

                case 'code':
                    $html[] = $this->renderCode($data);
                    break;

                case 'callout':
                case 'alert':
                    $html[] = $this->renderCallout($data);
                    break;

                case 'list':
                    $html[] = $this->renderList($data);
                    break;

                case 'image':
                    $html[] = $this->renderImage($data);
                    break;

                case 'delimiter':
                case 'divider':
                    $html[] = $this->renderDelimiter($data);
                    break;

                default:
                    // Bloco desconhecido: se houver texto, renderiza parágrafo seguro
                    if (!empty($data['text'])) {
                        $html[] = $this->renderParagraph($data);
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }

        $html[] = '</div>';
        return implode("\n", $html);
    }

    public function renderHeader(array $data): string
    {
        $rawLevel = (int)($data['level'] ?? 2);
        $level = in_array($rawLevel, [1, 2, 3, 4], true) ? $rawLevel : 2;
        $text = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['text'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $fontSizes = [
            1 => '2rem',
            2 => '1.6rem',
            3 => '1.3rem',
            4 => '1.1rem',
        ];
        $fontSize = $fontSizes[$level];

        return "<h{$level} class=\"ds-block-heading ds-heading-h{$level}\" style=\"margin: 25px 0 10px 0; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: {$fontSize}; letter-spacing: -0.5px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding-bottom: 8px;\">{$text}</h{$level}>";
    }

    public function renderParagraph(array $data): string
    {
        $raw = (string)($data['text'] ?? '');
        $safeHtml = $this->sanitizeInlineHtml($raw);

        return "<p class=\"ds-block-paragraph\" style=\"margin: 0; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-main, #c5c6c7); font-size: 1.05rem;\">{$safeHtml}</p>";
    }

    public function renderVideo(array $data): string
    {
        $url = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? $data['source'] ?? ''));
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $caption = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['caption'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $captionHtml = $caption !== '' 
            ? "<figcaption style=\"margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); text-align: center;\">{$caption}</figcaption>" 
            : '';

        $embedUrl = $this->convertVideoUrlToEmbed($url);

        if ($embedUrl !== null) {
            return "
            <figure class=\"ds-block-video\" style=\"margin: 24px 0;\">
                <div style=\"position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: #000; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);\">
                    <iframe src=\"{$embedUrl}\" style=\"position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0;\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture\" allowfullscreen loading=\"lazy\"></iframe>
                </div>
                {$captionHtml}
            </figure>";
        }

        // Vídeo direto MP4/WEBM
        $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        return "
        <figure class=\"ds-block-video\" style=\"margin: 24px 0;\">
            <div style=\"border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2);\">
                <video controls style=\"width: 100%; display: block; max-height: 550px;\">
                    <source src=\"{$safeUrl}\">
                    Seu navegador não suporta a tag de vídeo.
                </video>
            </div>
            {$captionHtml}
        </figure>";
    }

    public function renderCode(array $data): string
    {
        $code = (string)($data['code'] ?? '');
        $lang = htmlspecialchars(trim((string)($data['language'] ?? 'php')), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $escapedCode = htmlspecialchars($code, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $displayLang = strtoupper($lang ?: 'CODE');

        return "
        <div class=\"ds-block-code\" style=\"margin: 24px 0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #0b0c10; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);\">
            <div style=\"display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: #14191c; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px;\">
                <span style=\"color: var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); font-weight: bold;\">{$displayLang}</span>
                <button type=\"button\" onclick=\"navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.closest('.ds-block-code').querySelector('code').innerText); var b=this; b.innerText='Copiado!'; setTimeout(function(){b.innerText='Copiar';}, 2000);\" style=\"background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #8c8f94; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;\">
                    Copiar
                </button>
            </div>
            <pre style=\"margin: 0; padding: 18px; overflow-x: auto; font-family: 'Fira Code', Consolas, Monaco, monospace; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: #e6edf3;\"><code class=\"language-{$lang}\">{$escapedCode}</code></pre>
        </div>";
    }

    public function renderCallout(array $data): string
    {
        $type = (string)($data['type'] ?? 'info');
        $raw = (string)($data['text'] ?? '');
        $safeHtml = $this->sanitizeInlineHtml($raw);

        $styles = [
            'info' => [
                'border' => 'var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff)',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '💡',
                'title'  => 'Nota Didática',
            ],
            'success' => [
                'border' => 'var(--accent-green, #00d284)',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '✅',
                'title'  => 'Boas Práticas & SOLID',
            ],
            'warning' => [
                'border' => 'var(--accent-orange, #f56e28)',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(245, 110, 40, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '⚠️',
                'title'  => 'Atenção',
            ],
            'danger' => [
                'border' => '#ff4d4f',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(255, 77, 79, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '🛑',
                'title'  => 'Cuidado / Erro Comum',
            ],
        ];

        $current = $styles[$type] ?? $styles['info'];

        return "
        <div class=\"ds-block-callout ds-callout-{$type}\" style=\"margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid {$current['border']}; background: {$current['bg']}; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start;\">
            <div style=\"font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1;\">{$current['icon']}</div>
            <div style=\"flex: 1; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--text-main, #fff);\">
                {$safeHtml}
            </div>
        </div>";
    }

    public function renderList(array $data): string
    {
        $style = (string)($data['style'] ?? 'unordered');
        $rawItems = is_array($data['items'] ?? null) ? $data['items'] : [];

        if (empty($rawItems)) {
            return '';
        }

        $tag = ($style === 'ordered') ? 'ol' : 'ul';
        $itemsHtml = [];

        foreach ($rawItems as $item) {
            $itemText = is_string($item) ? $item : (string)($item['content'] ?? '');
            $safe = $this->sanitizeInlineHtml($itemText);
            $itemsHtml[] = "<li style=\"margin-bottom: 8px;\">{$safe}</li>";
        }

        $inner = implode("\n", $itemsHtml);
        return "<{$tag} class=\"ds-block-list\" style=\"margin: 16px 0 16px 24px; padding: 0; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-main, #c5c6c7); font-size: 1.05rem;\">\n{$inner}\n</{$tag}>";
    }

    public function renderImage(array $data): string
    {
        $url = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? $data['file']['url'] ?? ''));
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $caption = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['caption'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $captionHtml = $caption !== '' 
            ? "<figcaption style=\"margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); text-align: center;\">{$caption}</figcaption>" 
            : '';

        return "
        <figure class=\"ds-block-figure\" style=\"margin: 28px 0; text-align: center;\">
            <img src=\"{$safeUrl}\" alt=\"{$caption}\" style=\"max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);\" loading=\"lazy\">
            {$captionHtml}
        </figure>";
    }

    public function renderDelimiter(array $data): string
    {
        return '<hr class="ds-block-delimiter" style="margin: 35px 0; border: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.4), transparent);">';
    }

    public function convertVideoUrlToEmbed(string $url): ?string
    {
        // YouTube: youtube.com/watch?v=ID ou youtu.be/ID ou youtube.com/embed/ID
        if (preg_match('/(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/i', $url, $matches)) {
            return 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' . $matches[1];
        }

        // Vimeo: vimeo.com/ID
        if (preg_match('/vimeo\.com\/(?:channels\/(?:\w+\/)?|groups\/(?:[^\/]*)\/videos\/|album\/(?:\d+)\/video\/|video\/|)(\d+)/i', $url, $matches)) {
            return 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' . $matches[1];
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Extrai texto puro de um conteúdo (seja JSON de blocos ou HTML legado) para uso em SEO / resumos.
     */
    public function extractPlainText(?string $content): string
    {
        if ($content === null || trim($content) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $trimmed = trim($content);
        if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '{') || str_starts_with($trimmed, '[')) {
            $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $blocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : null);
                if (is_array($blocks)) {
                    $parts = [];
                    foreach ($blocks as $block) {
                        $data = is_array($block['data'] ?? null) ? $block['data'] : [];
                        if (!empty($data['text'])) {
                            $parts[] = strip_tags((string)$data['text']);
                        } elseif (!empty($data['caption'])) {
                            $parts[] = strip_tags((string)$data['caption']);
                        }
                    }
                    return trim(implode(' ', $parts));
                }
            }
        }

        return trim(strip_tags($content));
    }

    private function sanitizeInlineHtml(string $html): string
    {
        // Remove scripts e tags perigosas preservando tags de formatação segura
        $stripped = strip_tags($html, self::ALLOWED_INLINE_TAGS);
        // Remove manipuladores de eventos maliciosos tipo onclick, onerror
        $cleaned = (string)preg_replace('/\s*on\w+\s*=\s*(["\'][^"\']*["\']|[^\s>]+)/i', '', $stripped);
        // Bloqueia protocolos perigosos (javascript:, data:, vbscript:) em atributos href
        return (string)preg_replace('/\s*href\s*=\s*(["\']?)\s*(?:javascript|vbscript|data):[^"\'>\s]*\1/i', ' href="#"', $cleaned);
    }
}

// Arquivo: academy/Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de persistência para módulos e aulas de cursos (SOLID - DIP).
 */
interface CourseStructureRepositoryInterface
{
    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: int, course_id: int, title: string, position: int, created_at?: string}>
     */
    public function getModules(int $courseId): array;

    public function createModule(int $courseId, string $title, int $position = 0): int;

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function updateModule(int $moduleId, array $data): bool;

    public function deleteModule(int $moduleId): bool;

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{
     *     id: int,
     *     course_id: int,
     *     module_id: ?int,
     *     title: string,
     *     slug: string,
     *     source_type: string,
     *     source: ?string,
     *     content: ?string,
     *     position: int,
     *     status: string,
     *     created_at?: string
     * }>
     */
    public function getLessons(int $courseId, ?int $moduleId = null): array;

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function getLessonById(int $id): ?array;

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function getLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array;

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function getPublishedLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array;

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function createLesson(array $data): int;

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function updateLesson(int $id, array $data): bool;

    public function deleteLesson(int $id): bool;

    /**
     * Substitui a estrutura completa do curso de forma atômica e transacional (com rollback em erros).
     *
     * @param int $courseId
     * @param array<int, array{
     *     id?: int,
     *     title: string,
     *     position?: int,
     *     lessons: array<int, array{
     *         id?: int,
     *         title: string,
     *         slug?: string,
     *         source_type?: string,
     *         source?: ?string,
     *         content?: ?string,
     *         status?: string
     *     }>
     * }> $structure
     */
    public function replaceCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool;

    /**
     * Garante a criação resiliente das tabelas 'academy_modules' e 'academy_lessons'.
     */
    public function ensureTables(): void;
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts;

interface CourseImageStorageInterface
{
    /**
     * Valida e armazena a imagem do curso no padrão 16:9.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $fileInfo Informações do arquivo ($_FILES['thumbnail'])
     * @return string Caminho relativo salvo (ex: 'uploads/academy/course_xyz.webp')
     * @throws \InvalidArgumentException Se arquivo for inválido, ultrapassar limite ou violar padrão 16:9
     * @throws \RuntimeException Se falhar ao mover/gravar o arquivo
     */
    public function storeUpload(array $fileInfo): string;

    /**
     * Remove o arquivo físico correspondente.
     * 
     * @param string $relativePath
     */
    public function deleteFile(string $relativePath): void;
}

// Arquivo: academy/migrations\2026_10_15_000001_create_academy_courses.php

<?php

use PDO;

return [
    'up' => function (PDO $db) {
        $driver = $db->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        $autoInc = $driver === 'sqlite' ? 'INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT' : 'INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY';

        $db->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_courses (
                id {$autoInc},
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                thumbnail VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                description TEXT NULL,
                status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
                link VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");
    },
    'down' => function (PDO $db) {
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS academy_courses");
    },
];

    public function edit(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById((int)$id);
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $csrfToken = $this->session->getCsrfToken();

        ob_start();
        ?>
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 20px;">

            </h1>
            <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy" class="btn btn-outline" style="padding: 8px 16px; border:1px solid #4a545a; border-radius:6px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">
                &larr; Voltar para Lista
            </a>
        </div>

            <form method="POST" action="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy/update/<?= $course['id'] ?>" enctype="multipart/form-data">

                </div>

            <script>
            (function() {
                var baseUrl = <?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?>;
                var structure = <?= json_encode($initialStructure, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?> || [];
                var availablePages = <?= json_encode($availablePages, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?> || [];

                // Agrupa páginas por pasta para o recurso de Auto-Importação de Pasta
                var foldersMap = {};
                availablePages.forEach(function(pagePath) {
                    var lastSlash = pagePath.lastIndexOf('/');
                    var dir = lastSlash > 0 ? pagePath.substring(0, lastSlash) : 'pages';
                    if (!foldersMap[dir]) {
                        foldersMap[dir] = [];
                    }
                    foldersMap[dir].push(pagePath);
                });

                function renderModules() {
                    var container = document.getElementById('modulesContainer');
                    container.innerHTML = '';

                    if (structure.length === 0) {
                        container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:24px; text-align:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border-radius:6px; color:#8c8f94; border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">Nenhum módulo criado ainda. Clique em "Adicionar Módulo" para começar.</div>';
                        return;
                    }

                    structure.forEach(function(mod, modIdx) {
                        var modCard = document.createElement('div');
                        modCard.style.cssText = 'background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:6px; padding:18px;';

                        // Header do Módulo
                        var modHeader = document.createElement('div');
                        modHeader.style.cssText = 'display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:14px; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;';
                        modHeader.innerHTML = `
                            <div style="flex:1; min-width:240px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
                                <span style="font-size:12px; font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); text-transform:uppercase;">Módulo ` + (modIdx + 1) + `</span>
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(mod.title || '') + `" placeholder="Título do Módulo" onchange="updateModTitle(` + modIdx + `, this.value)" style="flex:1; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #4a545a; background:#14191c; color:#fff; font-weight:600;">
                            </div>
                            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                                <button type="button" onclick="openImportFolderModal(` + modIdx + `)" style="padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.35); background:rgba(69,243,255,0.08); color:#45f3ff; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; font-weight:600;" title="Importar todas as aulas de uma pasta do tema">
                                    📂 Importar Pasta do Tema
                                </button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="removeModule(` + modIdx + `)" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#e06c75; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; padding:4px 8px;" title="Excluir Módulo">
                                    <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        `;
                        modCard.appendChild(modHeader);

                        // Lista de Aulas
                        var lessonsList = document.createElement('div');
                        lessonsList.style.cssText = 'display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-left:15px; border-left:2px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2); padding-left:15px;';

                        (mod.lessons || []).forEach(function(lesson, lesIdx) {
                            var lesRow = document.createElement('div');
                            lesRow.style.cssText = 'background:#14191c; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:6px; padding:12px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;';

                            var srcType = lesson.source_type || (lesson.source ? 'theme_file' : 'content');
                            var statusVal = lesson.status || 'published';

                            // Opções de páginas do tema para o select
                            var optionsHtml = '<option value="">-- Selecione arquivo de tema (.php) --</option>';
                            availablePages.forEach(function(p) {
                                var selected = (lesson.source === p) ? 'selected' : '';
                                optionsHtml += '<option value="' + escapeHtml(p) + '" ' + selected + '>' + escapeHtml(p) + '</option>';
                            });

                            var editorActionHtml = '';
                            if (lesson.id && parseInt(lesson.id) > 0) {
                                editorActionHtml = `<a href="` + baseUrl + `/admin/academy/lessons/` + parseInt(lesson.id) + `/editor" style="padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(0,210,132,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(0,210,132,0.4); color:#00d284; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px;" title="Abrir Editor Visual em Blocos desta aula">⚡ Editor de Blocos</a>`;
                            } else {
                                editorActionHtml = `<span style="font-size:11px; color:#8c8f94; padding:4px 8px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border-radius:4px;" title="Salve a estrutura abaixo para habilitar o Editor de Blocos desta nova aula">💾 Salve p/ Editar Blocos</span>`;
                            }

                            var themeSelectDisplay = (srcType === 'theme_file') ? 'flex' : 'none';

                            lesRow.innerHTML = `
                                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                                    <div style="flex:1; min-width:260px; display:flex; gap:8px;">
                                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(lesson.title || '') + `" placeholder="Título da Aula" onchange="updateLessonField(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, 'title', this.value)" style="flex:2; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:13px;">
                                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(lesson.slug || '') + `" placeholder="slug-da-aula" onchange="updateLessonField(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, 'slug', this.value)" style="flex:1; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#8c8f94; font-family:monospace; font-size:12px;">
                                    </div>
                                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                                        <select onchange="updateLessonField(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, 'status', this.value)" style="padding:6px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:12px;">
                                            <option value="published" ` + (statusVal === 'published' ? 'selected' : '') + `>🟢 Publicada</option>
                                            <option value="draft" ` + (statusVal === 'draft' ? 'selected' : '') + `>⚪ Rascunho</option>
                                        </select>
                                        ` + editorActionHtml + `
                                        <button type="button" onclick="removeLesson(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `)" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#e06c75; cursor:pointer; padding:4px 6px;" title="Excluir Aula">
                                            <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;">

                                        <option value="content" ` + (srcType === 'content' ? 'selected' : '') + `>⚡ Editor em Blocos (Conteúdo)</option>
                                        <option value="theme_file" ` + (srcType === 'theme_file' ? 'selected' : '') + `>📄 Arquivo do Tema (.php)</option>
                                    </select>
                                    <div style="flex:1; min-width:220px; display:` + themeSelectDisplay + `; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                                        <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Arquivo:</span>
                                        <select onchange="updateLessonField(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, 'source', this.value)" style="flex:1; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-size:12px; font-family:monospace;">
                                            ` + optionsHtml + `

                function escapeHtml(str) {
                    return String(str).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
                }

                function formatFilenameToTitle(filePath) {
                    var fileName = filePath.split('/').pop().replace(/\.(php|html)$/i, '');
                    var match = fileName.match(/^(\d+)[-_]+(.*)$/);
                    if (match) {
                        var num = match[1];
                        var rest = match[2].replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function(l) { return l.toUpperCase(); });
                        return num + ' - ' + rest;
                    }
                    return fileName.replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function(l) { return l.toUpperCase(); });
                }

                function formatFilenameToSlug(filePath) {
                    var fileName = filePath.split('/').pop().replace(/\.(php|html)$/i, '');
                    return fileName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
                }

                window.openImportFolderModal = function(modIdx) {
                    document.getElementById('import_target_mod_idx').value = modIdx;
                    var select = document.getElementById('import_folder_select');
                    select.innerHTML = '';

                    var folderKeys = Object.keys(foldersMap);
                    if (folderKeys.length === 0) {
                        select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Nenhuma pasta encontrada em pages/</option>';
                        document.getElementById('import_folder_preview').innerHTML = 'Nenhum arquivo .php encontrado na pasta pages/ do tema.';
                    } else {
                        folderKeys.forEach(function(folder) {
                            var opt = document.createElement('option');
                            opt.value = folder;
                            opt.textContent = folder + '/ (' + foldersMap[folder].length + ' arquivos)';
                            select.appendChild(opt);
                        });
                        updateImportFolderPreview();
                    }

                    select.onchange = updateImportFolderPreview;
                    document.getElementById('modalImportFolder').style.display = 'flex';
                };

                function updateImportFolderPreview() {
                    var folder = document.getElementById('import_folder_select').value;
                    var preview = document.getElementById('import_folder_preview');
                    var files = foldersMap[folder] || [];
                    if (files.length === 0) {
                        preview.innerHTML = 'Nenhum arquivo nesta pasta.';
                        return;
                    }
                    preview.innerHTML = files.map(function(f) {
                        return '<div style="padding:3px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);">📄 ' + escapeHtml(f) + ' &rarr; <strong style="color:#45f3ff;">' + escapeHtml(formatFilenameToTitle(f)) + '</strong></div>';
                    }).join('');
                }

                window.closeImportFolderModal = function() {
                    document.getElementById('modalImportFolder').style.display = 'none';
                };

                window.confirmImportFolder = function() {
                    var modIdx = parseInt(document.getElementById('import_target_mod_idx').value, 10);
                    var folder = document.getElementById('import_folder_select').value;
                    var files = foldersMap[folder] || [];

                    if (!structure[modIdx] || files.length === 0) {
                        closeImportFolderModal();
                        return;
                    }

                    if (!Array.isArray(structure[modIdx].lessons)) {
                        structure[modIdx].lessons = [];
                    }

                    var existingSources = {};
                    structure[modIdx].lessons.forEach(function(l) {
                        if (l.source) existingSources[l.source] = true;
                    });

                    files.forEach(function(filePath) {
                        if (!existingSources[filePath]) {
                            structure[modIdx].lessons.push({
                                title: formatFilenameToTitle(filePath),
                                slug: formatFilenameToSlug(filePath),
                                source_type: 'theme_file',
                                source: filePath,
                                content: '',
                                status: 'published'
                            });
                        }
                    });

                    closeImportFolderModal();
                    renderModules();
                };

                window.addModule = function() {
                    structure.push({
                        title: 'Novo Módulo',
                        position: structure.length + 1,
                        lessons: []
                    });
                    renderModules();
                };

                window.removeModule = function(modIdx) {
                    if (confirm('Deseja excluir este módulo e todas as suas aulas?')) {
                        structure.splice(modIdx, 1);
                        renderModules();
                    }
                };

                window.updateModTitle = function(modIdx, val) {
                    if (structure[modIdx]) {
                        structure[modIdx].title = val;
                    }
                };

                window.addLesson = function(modIdx) {
                    if (structure[modIdx]) {
                        var lesCount = (structure[modIdx].lessons || []).length + 1;
                        structure[modIdx].lessons.push({
                            title: 'Aula ' + lesCount,
                            slug: 'aula-' + lesCount,
                            source_type: 'content',
                            source: '',
                            content: '',
                            status: 'published'
                        });
                        renderModules();
                    }
                };

                window.removeLesson = function(modIdx, lesIdx) {
                    if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons) {
                        structure[modIdx].lessons.splice(lesIdx, 1);
                        renderModules();
                    }
                };

                window.updateLessonField = function(modIdx, lesIdx, field, val) {
                    if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons && structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx]) {
                        structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx][field] = val;
                        if (field === 'source' && val !== '') {
                            structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx].source_type = 'theme_file';
                        }
                    }
                };

                window.updateLessonSourceType = function(modIdx, lesIdx, val) {
                    if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons && structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx]) {
                        structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx].source_type = val;
                        if (val === 'content') {
                            structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx].source = '';
                        }
                        renderModules();
                    }
                };

                window.prepareStructureJson = function() {
                    document.getElementById('structure_json_input').value = JSON.stringify(structure);
                    return true;
                };

                renderModules();
            })();
            </script>
        <?php endif; ?>

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    private function verifyCsrfToken(Request $request): bool
    {
        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();

        if ($token === '' || $expected === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return hash_equals($expected, $token);
    }

    public function updateStructure(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)$id;

        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $course = $this->repository->findById($courseId);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        if ($this->structureRepo === null) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Repositório de estrutura não disponível.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $rawJson = $request->input('structure_json');
        if (!empty($rawJson)) {
            $structure = json_decode((string)$rawJson, true);
            if (!is_array($structure)) {
                $this->session->setFlash('error', "Formato da estrutura inválido.");
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
            }
        } else {
            $structure = $request->input('structure', []);
            if (!is_array($structure)) {
                $structure = [];
            }
        }

        try {
            $this->structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($courseId, $structure);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Estrutura do curso atualizada com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao atualizar estrutura: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $file = $request->file('thumbnail');
            if ($file && (empty($file['tmp_name']) || ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE)) {
                $file = null;
            } elseif ($file && ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                if ($file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE || $file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE) {
                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo de imagem enviado excedeu o tamanho máximo permitido pelo servidor.");
                }
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Erro no envio do arquivo de imagem (Código: " . ($file['error'] ?? 'desconhecido') . ").");
            }

            $data = [
                'title'       => $request->input('title'),
                'description' => $request->input('description'),
                'status'      => $request->input('status'),
                'link'        => $request->input('link'),
            ];

            $this->service->createCourse($data, $file);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso cadastrado com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao cadastrar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    public function update(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $file = $request->file('thumbnail');
            if ($file && (empty($file['tmp_name']) || ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE)) {
                $file = null;
            } elseif ($file && ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                if ($file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE || $file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE) {
                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo de imagem enviado excedeu o tamanho máximo permitido pelo servidor.");
                }
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Erro no envio do arquivo de imagem (Código: " . ($file['error'] ?? 'desconhecido') . ").");
            }

            $data = [
                'title'       => $request->input('title'),
                'description' => $request->input('description'),
                'status'      => $request->input('status'),
                'link'        => $request->input('link'),
            ];

            $this->service->updateCourse((int)$id, $data, $file);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso atualizado com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao atualizar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $id);
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    public function delete(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $this->service->deleteCourse((int)$id);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso excluído com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao excluir curso: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    /**
     * Resolve todas as páginas (.php / .html) disponíveis no tema público ativo para vinculação e importação em lote.
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function resolvePublicThemePages(): array
    {
        $pages = [];

        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $pages = $this->themeManager->getAvailablePages();
        }

        if (empty($pages)) {
            $baseRoot = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4);
            $siteState = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\EnvSiteState();
            $activePublicTheme = $siteState->getActiveTheme();

            if ($this->themeManager !== null && $activePublicTheme !== '') {
                $pages = $this->themeManager->getAvailablePages($activePublicTheme);
            }

            if (empty($pages)) {
                $resolver = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver([
                    $baseRoot . '/themes',
                    $baseRoot . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes',
                ]);
                $candidateThemes = array_unique(array_filter([$activePublicTheme, 'rachidd', 'default']));
                foreach ($candidateThemes as $themeName) {
                    if ($resolver->themeExists($themeName)) {
                        $pagesDir = $resolver->resolveThemePath($themeName) . '/pages';
                        if (is_dir($pagesDir)) {
                            $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                                new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($pagesDir, \FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)
                            );
                            foreach ($iterator as $file) {
                                if ($file->isFile() && in_array(strtolower($file->getExtension()), ['php', 'html'], true)) {
                                    $rel = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($file->getPathname(), strlen($pagesDir) + 1));
                                    $pages[] = 'pages/' . ltrim($rel, '/');
                                }
                            }
                            if (!empty($pages)) {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $pages = array_values(array_unique($pages));
        natsort($pages);
        return array_values($pages);
    }
}

        $db->exec("

                course_id INT NOT NULL,
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                folder_slug VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        $db->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_lessons (
                id {$autoInc},
                course_id INT NOT NULL,
                module_id INT NULL,
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                source_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'theme_file',
                source VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                content TEXT NULL,
                mobile_profile VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'drawer',
                position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                UNIQUE(course_id, slug)
            )
        ");

        // Garante colunas mobile_profile e folder_slug via SQL ANSI padrão (independente de ERRMODE ou driver)
        $hasMobileCol = false;
        try {
            $stmtMob = @$db->query("SELECT mobile_profile FROM academy_lessons LIMIT 1");
            $hasMobileCol = ($stmtMob !== false);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $hasMobileCol = false;
        }
        if (!$hasMobileCol) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_lessons ADD COLUMN mobile_profile VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'drawer'");
            } catch (\Throwable $inner) {
                // Coluna já existe ou não aplicável
            }
        }

        $hasFolderCol = false;
        try {
            $stmtFold = @$db->query("SELECT folder_slug FROM academy_modules LIMIT 1");
            $hasFolderCol = ($stmtFold !== false);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $hasFolderCol = false;
        }
        if (!$hasFolderCol) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_modules ADD COLUMN folder_slug VARCHAR(255) NULL");
            } catch (\Throwable $inner) {
                // Coluna já existe ou não aplicável
            }
        }
    },
    'down' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS academy_lessons");
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS academy_modules");
    },
];

    <script>
    (function() {
        var baseUrl = <?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?>;
        var courseSlug = <?= json_encode((string)$course['slug']) ?>;
        var structure = <?= json_encode($initialStructure, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?> || [];
        var availablePages = <?= json_encode($availablePages, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?> || [];

        var foldersMap = {};
        availablePages.forEach(function(pagePath) {
            var lastSlash = pagePath.lastIndexOf('/');
            var dir = lastSlash > 0 ? pagePath.substring(0, lastSlash) : 'pages';
            if (!foldersMap[dir]) {
                foldersMap[dir] = [];
            }
            foldersMap[dir].push(pagePath);
        });

        function slugifyText(raw) {
            var map = {'á':'a','à':'a','ã':'a','â':'a','ä':'a','é':'e','è':'e','ê':'e','ë':'e','í':'i','ì':'i','î':'i','ï':'i','ó':'o','ò':'o','õ':'o','ô':'o','ö':'o','ú':'u','ù':'u','û':'u','ü':'u','ç':'c','ñ':'n'};
            var str = String(raw || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[áàãâäéèêëíìîïóòõôöúùûüçñ]/g, function(c) { return map[c] || c; });
            return str.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'aula';
        }

        window.openCreateFolderModal = function() {
            document.getElementById('modalCreateFolder').style.display = 'flex';
        };
        window.closeCreateFolderModal = function() {
            document.getElementById('modalCreateFolder').style.display = 'none';
        };
        window.updateNewFolderSlugPreview = function(val) {
            var s = slugifyText(val);
            document.getElementById('new_folder_slug_preview').textContent = 'pages/' + s;
        };

        function renderModules() {
            var container = document.getElementById('modulesContainer');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            if (structure.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:24px; text-align:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border-radius:6px; color:#8c8f94; border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">Nenhum módulo criado ainda. Clique em "Adicionar Módulo" ou "📁 Criar Pasta (ou Módulo)" para começar.</div>';
                return;
            }

            structure.forEach(function(mod, modIdx) {
                var modCard = document.createElement('div');
                modCard.style.cssText = 'background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:6px; padding:18px;';

                var modFolderSlug = mod.folder_slug || '';
                var modHeader = document.createElement('div');
                modHeader.style.cssText = 'display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:14px; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;';
                modHeader.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="flex:1; min-width:260px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-size:12px; font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); text-transform:uppercase;">Módulo ` + (modIdx + 1) + `</span>
                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(mod.title || '') + `" placeholder="Título do Módulo" onchange="updateModTitle(` + modIdx + `, this.value)" style="flex:2; min-width:180px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #4a545a; background:#14191c; color:#fff; font-weight:600;">
                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(modFolderSlug) + `" placeholder="Pasta opcional (ex: modulo-1)" onchange="updateModFolderSlug(` + modIdx + `, this.value)" style="flex:1; min-width:140px; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#00d284; font-family:monospace; font-size:12px;" title="Subpasta dentro de pages/ onde novos arquivos .php deste módulo serão fabricados">
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                        <button type="button" onclick="openImportFolderModal(` + modIdx + `)" style="padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.35); background:rgba(69,243,255,0.08); color:#45f3ff; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; font-weight:600;" title="Importar todas as aulas de uma pasta do tema">
                            📂 Importar Pasta do Tema
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onclick="removeModule(` + modIdx + `)" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#e06c75; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; padding:4px 8px;" title="Excluir Módulo">
                            <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>

                    </div>

                modCard.appendChild(modHeader);

                var lessonsList = document.createElement('div');

                    var optionsHtml = '<option value="">-- Auto-Fabricar (' + escapeHtml(targetFile) + ') ou Selecione (.php) --</option>';
                    availablePages.forEach(function(p) {
                        var selected = (lesson.source === p) ? 'selected' : '';
                        optionsHtml += '<option value="' + escapeHtml(p) + '" ' + selected + '>' + escapeHtml(p) + '</option>';
                    });
                    if (lesson.source && availablePages.indexOf(lesson.source) === -1) {
                        optionsHtml += '<option value="' + escapeHtml(lesson.source) + '" selected>' + escapeHtml(lesson.source) + ' (Fabricado)</option>';
                    }

                    var editorActionHtml = '';
                    if (lesson.id && parseInt(lesson.id) > 0) {
                        editorActionHtml = `<a href="` + baseUrl + `/admin/academy/lessons/` + parseInt(lesson.id) + `/editor" style="padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(0,210,132,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(0,210,132,0.4); color:#00d284; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px;" title="Abrir Editor Visual em Blocos desta aula">⚡ Editor de Blocos</a>`;
                    } else {
                        editorActionHtml = `<span style="font-size:11px; color:#8c8f94; padding:4px 8px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border-radius:4px;" title="Salve a estrutura abaixo para habilitar o Editor de Blocos desta nova aula">💾 Salve p/ Editar Blocos</span>`;
                    }

                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(lesson.title || '') + `" placeholder="Título da Aula (ex: Estrutura de Dados)" onchange="updateLessonTitleAndAutoSlug(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, this.value)" style="flex:2; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:13px;">
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(lesson.slug || '') + `" placeholder="slug-da-aula" onchange="updateLessonField(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, 'slug', this.value)" style="flex:1; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#8c8f94; font-family:monospace; font-size:12px;">

                                    <option value="cinema" ` + (mobProfile === 'cinema' ? 'selected' : '') + `>🎬 Mobile: Cinema 16:9</option>
                                </select>
                                <select onchange="updateLessonField(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, 'status', this.value)" style="padding:6px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:12px;">

                                    <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                                </button>

                                <option value="content" ` + (srcType === 'content' ? 'selected' : '') + `>⚡ Editor em Blocos (Conteúdo + PHP)</option>
                                <option value="theme_file" ` + (srcType === 'theme_file' ? 'selected' : '') + `>📄 Arquivo do Tema (.php)</option>
