<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts;

interface MenuRepositoryInterface
{
    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: int, name: string, location: string, created_at?: string}>
     */
    public function getMenus(): array;

    /**
     * @return array{id: int, name: string, location: string, created_at?: string}|null
     */
    public function getMenuById(int $id): ?array;

    /**
     * @return array{id: int, name: string, location: string, created_at?: string}|null
     */
    public function getMenuByLocation(string $location): ?array;

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: int, menu_id: int, title: string, url: ?string, page_id: ?int, order_index: int}>
     */
    public function getMenuItems(int $menuId): array;

    /**
     * Salva ou atualiza um menu.
     * @return array{success: bool, message: string, id?: int}
     */
    public function saveMenu(string $name, string $location, ?int $id = null): array;

    /**
     * Substitui itens de um menu de forma estritamente transacional (com rollback em falhas).
     * @param array<int, array{title: string, url?: ?string, page_id?: ?int}> $items
     */
    public function replaceMenuItems(int $menuId, array $items): bool;

    /**
     * Exclui um menu e seus itens vinculados.
     */
    public function deleteMenu(int $id): bool;

    /**
     * Garante a existência das tabelas de menus e o auto-seed dos locais básicos ('header', 'footer').
     */
    public function ensureTables(): void;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/nav_menus/Controllers/MenuAdminController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageLookupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services\MenuRenderer;

class MenuAdminController
{
    private MenuRepositoryInterface $menuRepo;
    private ThemeManagerInterface $theme;
    private ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup;
    private ?MenuRenderer $menuRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        MenuRepositoryInterface $menuRepo,
        ThemeManagerInterface $theme,
        ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup = null,
        ?MenuRenderer $menuRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->menuRepo = $menuRepo;
        $this->theme = $theme;
        $this->pageLookup = $pageLookup;
        $this->menuRenderer = $menuRenderer ?? new MenuRenderer($menuRepo, $pageLookup);
    }

    public function index(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $menus = $this->menuRepo->getMenus();

        $pages = $this->pageLookup !== null ? $this->pageLookup->getSelectablePages() : [];

        // Injeta a Home (Início) no topo para facilitar seleção pelo usuário
        array_unshift($pages, [
            'id' => null,
            'title' => 'Início (Home)',
            'slug' => '/',
            'is_home' => true
        ]);

        $activeMenuIdRaw = $request->input('menu_id');

        if ($activeMenuIdRaw === 'new') {
            $activeMenuId = null;
        } else {
            $activeMenuId = $activeMenuIdRaw ? (int)$activeMenuIdRaw : ($menus[0]['id'] ?? null);
        }

        $menuItems = [];
        $activeMenu = null;
        if ($activeMenuId !== null) {
            $activeMenu = $this->menuRepo->getMenuById((int)$activeMenuId);
            if ($activeMenu !== null) {
                $menuItems = $this->menuRepo->getMenuItems((int)$activeMenuId);
            }
        }

        $html = $this->theme->render('admin_menus', [
            'menus' => $menus,
            'pages' => $pages,
            'activeMenuId' => $activeMenuId,
            'activeMenu' => $activeMenu,
            'menuItems' => $menuItems
        ], dirname(__DIR__) . '/views');

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function storeMenu(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $name = (string)$request->input('name', '');
        $location = (string)$request->input('location', '');
        $id = $request->input('id') ? (int)$request->input('id') : null;

        if (empty($name) || empty($location)) {
            return Response::json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Nome e Localização são obrigatórios.'], 400);
        }

        $result = $this->menuRepo->saveMenu($name, $location, $id);
        $status = $result['success'] ? 200 : 400;

        return Response::json($result, $status);
    }

    public function storeItems(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $menuId = $request->input('menu_id');
        $items = $request->input('items', []);

        if (!$menuId) {
            return Response::json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID do menu não informado.'], 400);
        }

        $success = $this->menuRepo->replaceMenuItems((int)$menuId, (array)$items);

        if ($success) {
            return Response::json(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Estrutura do menu salva com sucesso!']);
        }

        return Response::json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Erro ao salvar a estrutura do menu.'], 500);
    }

    public function deleteMenu(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $this->menuRepo->deleteMenu((int)$id);
        return Response::json(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Menu excluído com sucesso.']);
    }

    /**
     * Mantido para compatibilidade com eventuais chamadas diretas legadas.
     */
    public function renderNavMenu(string $location): string
    {
        return $this->menuRenderer->render($location);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/nav_menus/Plugin.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Repositories\PdoMenuRepository;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services\MenuRenderer;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Controllers\MenuAdminController;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('shortcodes.register');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $runtime->bind(MenuRepositoryInterface::class, PdoMenuRepository::class);
        $runtime->bind(
            \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface::class,
            \DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services\NavMenuProviderAdapter::class
        );

        // Interceptar o menu admin para adicionar o submenu "Menus" em "Temas"
        // Prioridade 99 para rodar APÓS o SystemAdmin (que cria o item "Temas")
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function($menus, $role = 'admin') {
            if ($role === 'admin' || $role === 'manager') {
                foreach ($menus as &$menu) {
                    if ($menu['title'] === 'Temas') {
                        if (!isset($menu['submenu'])) {
                            $menu['submenu'] = [];
                        }
                        $menu['submenu'][] = [
                            'title' => 'Menus (Navegação)',
                            'url' => '/admin/themes/menus',
                            'icon' => '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"></line><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"></line><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"></line></svg>'
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }
            return $menus;
        }, 99);

        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function(Router $router) {
            // Rotas Admin para Menus
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/themes/menus', [MenuAdminController::class, 'index'], 'nav_menus', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/themes/menus/store', [MenuAdminController::class, 'storeMenu'], 'nav_menus', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/themes/menus/items', [MenuAdminController::class, 'storeItems'], 'nav_menus', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/themes/menus/delete/{id}', [MenuAdminController::class, 'deleteMenu'], 'nav_menus', ['admin']);
        });

        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function(\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $sm) use ($runtime) {
            // Shortcode desacoplado do controller admin
            $sm->add('nav_menu', function($attrs) use ($runtime) {
                $location = $attrs['location'] ?? 'header';
                $renderer = $runtime->make(MenuRenderer::class);
                return $renderer->render($location);
            }, 'Renderiza um menu criado no painel. Ex: [nav_menu location="header"]');
        });
    }

    public function activate(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $runtime->bind(MenuRepositoryInterface::class, PdoMenuRepository::class);
        $repo = $runtime->make(MenuRepositoryInterface::class);
        $repo->ensureTables();
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/nav_menus/Repositories/PdoMenuRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection;
use PDO;
use PDOException;
use Throwable;

class PdoMenuRepository implements MenuRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tablesEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(Connection|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof Connection ? $connection->getPdo() : $connection;
    }

    public function ensureTables(): void
    {
        if ($this->tablesEnsured) {
            return;
        }

        $driver = $this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        $autoIncrement = ($driver === 'sqlite') ? 'AUTOINCREMENT' : 'AUTO_INCREMENT';

        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS theme_menus (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY $autoIncrement,
                name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                location VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS theme_menu_items (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY $autoIncrement,
                menu_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                url TEXT NULL,
                page_id INTEGER NULL,
                order_index INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        // Auto-seed: locais padrão ('header' e 'footer')
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT location FROM theme_menus");
        $existing = $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN) : [];

        if (!in_array('header', $existing, true)) {
            $insert = $this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO theme_menus (name, location) VALUES (?, ?)");
            $insert->execute(['Menu Principal', 'header']);
        }

        if (!in_array('footer', $existing, true)) {
            $insert = $this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO theme_menus (name, location) VALUES (?, ?)");
            $insert->execute(['Menu do Rodapé', 'footer']);
        }

        $this->tablesEnsured = true;
    }

    public function getMenus(): array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT * FROM theme_menus ORDER BY name ASC");
        return $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) : [];
    }

    public function getMenuById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM theme_menus WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getMenuByLocation(string $location): ?array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM theme_menus WHERE location = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$location]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getMenuItems(int $menuId): array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM theme_menu_items WHERE menu_id = ? ORDER BY order_index ASC");
        $stmt->execute([$menuId]);
        return $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) : [];
    }

    public function saveMenu(string $name, string $location, ?int $id = null): array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $name = trim($name);
        $location = trim($location);

        if (empty($name) || empty($location)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Nome e Localização são obrigatórios.'];
        }

        if ($id !== null && $id > 0) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE theme_menus SET name = ?, location = ? WHERE id = ?');
            $stmt->execute([$name, $location, $id]);
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Menu atualizado com sucesso.', 'id' => $id];
        }

        $check = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM theme_menus WHERE location = ?');
        $check->execute([$location]);
        if ($check->fetch()) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Já existe um menu atribuído a esta localização.'];
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO theme_menus (name, location) VALUES (?, ?)');
        $stmt->execute([$name, $location]);
        $newId = (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
        return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Menu criado com sucesso.', 'id' => $newId];
    }

    public function replaceMenuItems(int $menuId, array $items): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTables();

        $startedTransaction = false;
        if (!$this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
            $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
            $startedTransaction = true;
        }

        try {
            $deleteStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM theme_menu_items WHERE menu_id = ?');
            $deleteStmt->execute([$menuId]);

            if (!empty($items)) {
                $insertStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('
                    INSERT INTO theme_menu_items (menu_id, title, url, page_id, order_index)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ');

                foreach ($items as $index => $item) {
                    $title = trim((string)($item['title'] ?? ''));
                    if (empty($title)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $url = !empty($item['url']) ? (string)$item['url'] : null;
                    $pageId = !empty($item['page_id']) ? (int)$item['page_id'] : null;

                    $insertStmt->execute([
                        $menuId,
                        $title,
                        $url,
                        $pageId,
                        (int)$index
                    ]);
                }
            }

            if ($startedTransaction) {
                $this->pdo->commit();
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $t) {
            if ($startedTransaction && $this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function deleteMenu(int $id): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTables();

        $startedTransaction = false;
        if (!$this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
            $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
            $startedTransaction = true;
        }

        try {
            $stmtItems = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM theme_menu_items WHERE menu_id = ?');
            $stmtItems->execute([$id]);

            $stmtMenu = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM theme_menus WHERE id = ?');
            $stmtMenu->execute([$id]);

            if ($startedTransaction) {
                $this->pdo->commit();
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $t) {
            if ($startedTransaction && $this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/nav_menus/Services/MenuRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services;

use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageLookupInterface;
use Throwable;

class MenuRenderer
{
    private MenuRepositoryInterface $menuRepo;
    private ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup;

    public function __construct(MenuRepositoryInterface $menuRepo, ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup = null)
    {
        $this->menuRepo = $menuRepo;
        $this->pageLookup = $pageLookup;
    }

    public function render(string $location): string
    {
        try {
            $menu = $this->menuRepo->getMenuByLocation($location);
            if (!$menu) {
                return '';
            }

            $items = $this->menuRepo->getMenuItems((int)$menu['id']);
            if (empty($items)) {
                return '';
            }

            $pagesById = [];
            if ($this->pageLookup !== null) {
                $pages = $this->pageLookup->getSelectablePages();
                foreach ($pages as $p) {
                    $pagesById[(int)$p['id']] = (string)$p['slug'];
                }
            }

            $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '';
            $currentUri = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH);

            $html = '<ul style="list-style: none; gap: 30px; display: flex; flex-direction: inherit; margin: 0; padding: 0;">';
            foreach ($items as $item) {
                $pageId = !empty($item['page_id']) ? (int)$item['page_id'] : null;

                if ($pageId !== null && isset($pagesById[$pageId])) {
                    $pageSlug = $pagesById[$pageId];
                    $url = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($pageSlug, '/');
                } else {
                    $rawUrl = (string)($item['url'] ?? '');
                    if (str_starts_with($rawUrl, 'http://') || str_starts_with($rawUrl, 'https://')) {
                        $url = $rawUrl;
                    } elseif ($rawUrl === '/' || $rawUrl === '') {
                        $url = $baseUrl !== '' ? $baseUrl : '/';
                    } else {
                        $url = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($rawUrl, '/');
                    }
                }

                $path = parse_url($url, PHP_URL_PATH);
                $isActive = ($currentUri === $path) ? 'color: var(--primary);' : '';

                $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $safeTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$item['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

                $html .= '<li><a href="' . $safeUrl . '" class="nav-link" style="' . $isActive . '">' . $safeTitle . '</a></li>';
            }
            $html .= '</ul>';

            return $html;
        } catch (Throwable $t) {
            return '';
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/nav_menus/Services/NavMenuProviderAdapter.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Adaptador que conecta o repositório de nav_menus ao contrato Ring 0 MenuProviderInterface.
 */
class NavMenuProviderAdapter implements MenuProviderInterface
{
    private MenuRepositoryInterface $repo;

    public function __construct(MenuRepositoryInterface $repo)
    {
        $this->repo = $repo;
    }

    public function getMenus(): array
    {
        try {
            return $this->repo->getMenus();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return [];
        }
    }

    public function getMenuItems(string $location = 'header', ?int $menuId = null): array
    {
        try {
            $menu = null;
            if ($menuId !== null && $menuId > 0) {
                $menu = $this->repo->getMenuById($menuId);
            }
            if ($menu === null && $location !== '') {
                $menu = $this->repo->getMenuByLocation($location);
            }
            if ($menu !== null && isset($menu['id'])) {
                return $this->repo->getMenuItems((int)$menu['id']);
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        return [];
    }
}

<!-- Script ultra leve para Drag and Drop e manipulação de DOM -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@latest/Sortable.min.js"></script>
<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const list = document.getElementById('menu-items-list');
        if (list) {
            new Sortable(list, {
                animation: 150,
                ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost'
            });
        }
    });

    function addSelectedPages() {
        const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.page-checkbox:checked');
        const list = document.getElementById('menu-items-list');
        if (!list) { OS.notify('Você precisa criar ou selecionar um menu antes de adicionar itens.', 'error'); return; }
        
        checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
            const title = cb.getAttribute('data-title');
            const pageId = cb.getAttribute('data-id');
            const slug = cb.getAttribute('data-slug');
            
            const li = document.createElement('li');
            li.className = 'menu-item';
            li.dataset.title = title;
            li.dataset.pageId = pageId;
            li.dataset.url = pageId ? '' : slug;
            li.style = 'background: var(--bg-deep); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 15px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; cursor: grab;';
            const displayType = pageId ? "Página Dinâmica" : "Página Inicial (Home)";
            li.innerHTML = `
                <div>
                    <strong style="color: #fff;">${title}</strong>
                    <span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; margin-left: 10px;">${displayType}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <button type="button" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:var(--primary); cursor:pointer; margin-right: 10px;" onclick="editItemTitle(this)">Editar</button>
                    <button type="button" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#dc3545; cursor:pointer;" onclick="this.closest('.menu-item').remove()">Excluir</button>
                </div>
            `;
            list.appendChild(li);
            cb.checked = false; // reset
        });
        
        // Reset select-all se existir
        const selectAll = document.querySelector('input[onchange*="selectAll"]');
        if (selectAll) selectAll.checked = false;
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(cb => cb.checked = false);
    }

    function addCustomLink() {
        const urlInput = document.getElementById('custom-link-url');
        const textInput = document.getElementById('custom-link-text');
        
        const url = urlInput.value.trim();
        const text = textInput.value.trim();
        
        if (!url || !text) {
            OS.notify('Preencha a URL e o texto do link.', 'error');
            return;
        }
    const title = text;
    const displayType = 'Link Personalizado';

        const list = document.getElementById('menu-items-list');
        if (!list) { OS.notify('Você precisa criar ou selecionar um menu antes de adicionar itens.', 'error'); return; }

        const li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = 'menu-item';
        li.dataset.title = text;
        li.dataset.pageId = '';
        li.dataset.url = url;
        li.style = 'background: var(--bg-deep); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 15px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; cursor: grab;';
        li.innerHTML = `
                <div>
                    <strong style="color: #fff;">${title}</strong>
                    <span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; margin-left: 10px;">${displayType}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <button type="button" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:var(--primary); cursor:pointer; margin-right: 10px;" onclick="editItemTitle(this)">Editar</button>
                    <button type="button" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#dc3545; cursor:pointer;" onclick="this.closest('.menu-item').remove()">Excluir</button>
                </div>
            `;
        list.appendChild(li);
        
        urlInput.value = '';
        textInput.value = '';
    }

    async function saveMenuSettings(e, url) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const form = e.target;
        const formData = new FormData(form);
        const data = Object.fromEntries(formData.entries());
        const csrf = document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]')?.value || '';

        try {
            const response = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': csrf
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(data)
            });
            const resData = await response.json();
            if (resData.success) {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'success');
                if (!data.id) { // Foi criado um novo
                    setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '?menu_id=' + resData.id, 1000);
                }
            } else {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'error');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            OS.notify('Erro ao salvar as configurações.', 'error');
        }
    }

    async function saveMenuItems(url) {
        const listItems = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item');
        const items = [];
        listItems.forEach(li => {
            items.push({
                title: li.dataset.title,
                url: li.dataset.url,
                page_id: li.dataset.pageId
            });
        });

        const menuId = document.querySelector('input[name="menu_id"]').value;
        const csrf = document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]').value;

        try {
            const response = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': csrf
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({ menu_id: menuId, items: items, csrf_token: csrf })
            });
            const resData = await response.json();
            if (resData.success) {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'success');
            } else {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'error');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            OS.notify('Erro ao salvar a estrutura do menu.', 'error');
        }
    }

    async function deleteMenuData(event, url) {
        
    // Confirm is handled by OS.confirm wrapper
    const btn = event.currentTarget;
    if (!btn.dataset.confirmed) {
        OS.confirm('Tem certeza absoluta que deseja excluir este menu?', () => {
            btn.dataset.confirmed = 'true';
            btn.click();
        });
        return;
    }

        
        try {
            const response = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]').value
                }
            });
            const resData = await response.json();
            if (resData.success) {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'success');
                setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '?deleted=1', 1000);
            } else {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'error');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            OS.notify('Erro ao excluir.', 'error');
        }
    }

    function editItemTitle(btn) {
        const li = btn.closest('.menu-item');
        const titleEl = li.querySelector('strong');
        const currentTitle = li.dataset.title;
        
        // Using OS.prompt if exists, otherwise fallback to native for now or just prompt
        const newTitle = prompt('Digite o novo texto para o link:', currentTitle);

        if (newTitle && newTitle.trim() !== '') {
            li.dataset.title = newTitle.trim();
            titleEl.innerText = newTitle.trim();
        }
    }
</script>

<script>
// Mantém o JSON do catálogo no JS para popular o segundo combobox dinamicamente
const catalog = <?= json_encode($catalog) ?>;
const currentUserWidgets = <?= json_encode($userWidgets) ?>;

const addWidgetBtn = document.getElementById('addWidgetBtn');
const widgetModal = document.getElementById('widgetModal');
const closeModalBtn = document.getElementById('closeModalBtn');
const providerSelect = document.getElementById('providerSelect');
const widgetSelect = document.getElementById('widgetSelect');
const addWidgetForm = document.getElementById('addWidgetForm');

addWidgetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    widgetModal.style.display = 'flex';
});

closeModalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    widgetModal.style.display = 'none';
});

// Popula os widgets quando o provedor muda
providerSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
    const providerClass = this.value;
    widgetSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Escolha --</option>';
    
    if (!providerClass) {
        widgetSelect.disabled = true;
        return;
    }

    const providerData = catalog.find(p => p.provider_class === providerClass);
    if (providerData && providerData.widgets) {
        Object.entries(providerData.widgets).forEach(([id, meta]) => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = id;
            opt.textContent = meta.title + ' (' + meta.description + ')';
            widgetSelect.appendChild(opt);
        });
        widgetSelect.disabled = false;
    }
});

// Ao submeter, envia a nova array de widgets via form dinâmico
addWidgetForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pClass = providerSelect.value;
    const wId = widgetSelect.value;
    
    if(!pClass || !wId) {
        alert("Selecione um módulo e um widget!");
        return;
    }

    // Adiciona na array
    currentUserWidgets.push({provider: pClass, id: wId});
    
    // Cria form invisível e submete para save-layout
    const form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '<?= BASE_URL ?>/admin/dashboard/save-layout';
    
    // INJETANDO O CSRF TOKEN TAMBÉM NO FORM INVISÍVEL PARA NÃO DAR ERRO DE CSRF DEPOIS!
    const csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
    csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
    csrfInput.name = 'csrf_token';
    csrfInput.value = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>';
    form.appendChild(csrfInput);

    currentUserWidgets.forEach(w => {
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'hidden';
        input.name = 'widgets[]';
        input.value = JSON.stringify(w);
        form.appendChild(input);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
});

// Remove um widget da array pelo index e salva o layout
function removeWidget(index) {
    // Remove o widget do index específico
    currentUserWidgets.splice(index, 1);
    
    // Cria o form para salvar
    const form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '<?= BASE_URL ?>/admin/dashboard/save-layout';
    
    const csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
    csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
    csrfInput.name = 'csrf_token';
    csrfInput.value = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>';
    form.appendChild(csrfInput);

    currentUserWidgets.forEach(w => {
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'hidden';
        input.name = 'widgets[]';
        input.value = JSON.stringify(w);
        form.appendChild(input);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
}
</script>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const hasSubmenuLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.has-submenu > a');
            const currentPath = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "");
            
            let activeLinkFound = false;
            document.querySelectorAll('#adminmenu a').forEach(link => {
                let href = link.getAttribute('href');
                if (!href.startsWith('http')) {
                    href = '<?= BASE_URL ?>/' + href;
                }
                
                let linkPath = new URL(href, window.location.origin).pathname.replace(/\/$/, "");
                
                if (linkPath === currentPath) {
                    link.parentElement.classList.add('current');
                    let parentUl = link.parentElement.parentElement;
                    if(parentUl && parentUl.tagName === 'UL' && parentUl.id !== 'adminmenu') {
                        parentUl.style.display = 'block';
                        localStorage.setItem('openMenu_' + parentUl.previousElementSibling.textContent.trim(), 'open');
                        activeLinkFound = true;
                    }
                }
            });

            hasSubmenuLinks.forEach(link => {
                const parent = link.parentElement;
                const ul = parent.querySelector('ul');
                const menuTitle = link.textContent.trim();
                
                if (localStorage.getItem('openMenu_' + menuTitle) === 'open') {
                    ul.style.display = 'block';
                }

                link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    if (this.getAttribute('href') === '#') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        if (ul) {
                            if (ul.style.display === 'none' || ul.style.display === '') {
                                ul.style.display = 'block';
                                localStorage.setItem('openMenu_' + menuTitle, 'open');
                            } else {
                                ul.style.display = 'none';
                                localStorage.setItem('openMenu_' + menuTitle, 'closed');
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        // Para links reais, apenas garante que abra no próximo reload
                        localStorage.setItem('openMenu_' + menuTitle, 'open');
                    }
                });
            });
        });
    </script>

        <svg id="os-notif-bell" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 8A6 6 0 0 0 6 8c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9"></path><path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0"></path></svg>
        <div class="os-notif-badge" id="os-notif-badge">0</div>
    </button>

    <script>
        window.OS = window.OS || {};
        
        window.OS.confirm = function(message, onConfirm) {
            const overlay = document.createElement('div');
            overlay.style = 'position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); z-index: 999999; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s;';
            
            const box = document.createElement('div');
            box.style = 'background: #1e1e2d; border: 1px solid #323248; border-radius: 8px; padding: 25px; max-width: 400px; width: 90%; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transform: scale(0.9); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);';
            
            const text = document.createElement('p');
            text.style = 'color: #fff; font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 25px; line-height: 1.5;';
            text.innerText = message;
            
            const btnGroup = document.createElement('div');
            btnGroup.style = 'display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 15px;';
            
            const btnCancel = document.createElement('button');
            btnCancel.innerText = 'Cancelar';
            btnCancel.style = 'background: transparent; border: 1px solid #4a4a6a; color: #a1a1b5; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold;';
            btnCancel.onclick = function() {
                overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                box.style.transform = 'scale(0.9)';
                setTimeout(() => overlay.remove(), 200);
            };
            
            const btnConfirm = document.createElement('button');
            btnConfirm.innerText = 'Confirmar';
            btnConfirm.style = 'background: #45f3ff; border: none; color: #0b0c10; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold;';
            btnConfirm.onclick = function() {
                overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                box.style.transform = 'scale(0.9)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    overlay.remove();
                    if(onConfirm) onConfirm();
                }, 200);
            };
            
            btnGroup.appendChild(btnCancel);
            btnGroup.appendChild(btnConfirm);
            box.appendChild(text);
            box.appendChild(btnGroup);
            overlay.appendChild(box);
            document.body.appendChild(overlay);
            
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                overlay.style.opacity = '1';
                box.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });
        };
        
        let notifQueue = [];
        let unreadCount = <?= !empty($unreadNotifs) ? count($unreadNotifs) : 0 ?>;
        
        // Exibe a badge no load inicial se houver não lidas e abre o painel
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            if (unreadCount > 0) {
                const b = document.getElementById('os-notif-badge');
                b.innerText = unreadCount;
                b.style.display = 'block';

            }
        });

        // Toggles the flyout panel
        window.OS.toggleHub = function() {
            const panel = document.getElementById('os-notif-panel');
            if (panel.classList.contains('open')) {
                panel.classList.remove('open');
                setTimeout(() => panel.style.display = 'none', 200); // Wait for transition
            } else {
                panel.style.display = 'flex';
                // Reset unread count when opening
                unreadCount = 0;
                document.getElementById('os-notif-badge').style.display = 'none';
                
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    panel.classList.add('open');
                });
            }
        };

        window.OS.clearHub = function() {
            document.getElementById('os-notif-list').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; padding: 20px; color: #64748b;">Nenhuma notificação na fila.</div>';
            notifQueue = [];
            unreadCount = 0;
            document.getElementById('os-notif-badge').style.display = 'none';
            
            // Apaga de verdade no backend
            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('csrf_token', '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>');
            fetch('<?= BASE_URL ?>/api/os/notifications/clear', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-CSRF-TOKEN': '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>' },
                body: fd
            });
        };

        // Adds to hub history
        window.OS.addToHub = function(message, type) {
            const list = document.getElementById('os-notif-list');
            
            // Remove empty state text if present
            if (notifQueue.length === 0) {
                list.innerHTML = '';
            }

            const item = document.createElement('div');
            item.className = 'os-notif-item ' + type;
            item.innerHTML = `<strong>${type.toUpperCase()}</strong><br><span class="os-msg-content"></span><span class="os-notif-time">Agora mesmo</span>`;
            item.querySelector('.os-msg-content').textContent = message;
            
            // Add to top
            list.prepend(item);
            notifQueue.unshift({message, type});
            
            // Limit to 50 items in DOM
            if (list.children.length > 50) {
                list.lastChild.remove();
            }

            // Increment badge se não for carga histórica
            if (!arguments[2]) {
                const panel = document.getElementById('os-notif-panel');
                if (!panel.classList.contains('open')) {
                    unreadCount++;
                    const badge = document.getElementById('os-notif-badge');
                    badge.innerText = unreadCount;
                    badge.style.display = 'block';
                    
                    // Anima o sino!
                    const bell = document.getElementById('os-notif-bell');
                    bell.classList.remove('os-ringing');
                    void bell.offsetWidth; // trigger reflow
                    bell.classList.add('os-ringing');
                }
            }
        };

        window.OS.notify = function(message, type = 'success', skipHub = false) {
            const container = document.getElementById('os-toast-container');
            if (!container) return;
            
            // Add to Notification Hub History
            if (!skipHub) {
                window.OS.addToHub(message, type);
            }

            // Render temporary Toast (Auto-hides)
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            let color = '#3b82f6';
            let icon = 'ℹ️';
            if (type === 'success') { color = '#10b981'; icon = '✅'; }
            if (type === 'error') { color = '#ef4444'; icon = '🚨'; }
            if (type === 'warning') { color = '#f59e0b'; icon = '⚠️'; }
            
            toast.style = `background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); opacity: 0; transform: translateX(50px); transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55); font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 15px; border: 1px solid #334155; border-left: 6px solid ${color}; letter-spacing: 0.3px; max-width: 450px; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer;`;
            
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <span style="font-size: 18px; margin-top: -2px;">${icon}</span> 
                <span class="os-msg-content" style="flex-grow: 1;"></span>
                <button style="background:none; border:none; color:#94a3b8; cursor:pointer; padding:0; font-size:16px; margin-top:-2px;" onclick="this.parentElement.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>this.parentElement.remove(), 300);">✖</button>
            `;
            toast.querySelector('.os-msg-content').textContent = message;
            
            container.appendChild(toast);
            
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                toast.style.opacity = '1';
                toast.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
            });
            
            // Se for erro, fica 15 segundos ou até clicar. Se for sucesso, 5 segundos.
            const delay = (type === 'success') ? 5000 : 15000;
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                if(toast.parentElement) {
                    toast.style.opacity = '0';
                    toast.style.transform = 'translateX(50px)';
                    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 400);
                }
            }, delay);
        };
    </script>
    

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            <?php if (empty($allNotifs)): ?>
                document.getElementById('os-notif-list').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; padding: 20px; color: #64748b;">Nenhuma notificação na fila.</div>';
            <?php else: ?>
                <?php foreach (array_reverse($allNotifs) as $n): ?>
                    // Apenas popula no hub em background
                    window.OS.addToHub(<?= json_encode($n['message']) ?>, <?= json_encode($n['type']) ?>, true);
                <?php endforeach; ?>
            <?php endif; ?>

            // Renderiza Flash Messages legadas como Toasts
            <?php if (isset($_SESSION['flash_message'])): ?>
                setTimeout(() => {
                    OS.notify(<?= json_encode($_SESSION['flash_message']['msg']) ?>, <?= json_encode($_SESSION['flash_message']['type']) ?>);
                }, 100);
            <?php unset($_SESSION['flash_message']); endif; ?>

            // Dispara toast de destaque APENAS para Sucesso ou Erro Crítico (Instalação/Quebra)
            <?php foreach (array_reverse($unreadNotifs) as $n): ?>
            <?php if ($n['type'] === 'error' || $n['type'] === 'warning' || $n['type'] === 'success'): ?>
            setTimeout(() => {
                OS.notify(<?= json_encode($n['message']) ?>, <?= json_encode($n['type']) ?>, true);
            }, 500);
            <?php endif; ?>
            <?php endforeach; ?>
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

                        } else {
                            input.type = 'password';
                            svg.innerHTML = '<path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle>';
                        }

<script>
    const ADMIN_CHECKLIST_KEY = 'ds_manual_checklist_state';

    function loadAdminChecklist() {
        try {
            const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ADMIN_CHECKLIST_KEY)) || {};
            const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"][data-test-id]');
            let checked = 0;

            checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
                const id = cb.getAttribute('data-test-id');
                if (saved[id] === true) {
                    cb.checked = true;
                    checked++;
                } else {
                    cb.checked = false;
                }
            });

            updateAdminBar(checked, checkboxes.length);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
        }
    }

    function saveAdminChecklist() {
        try {
            const state = {};
            const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"][data-test-id]');
            let checked = 0;

            checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
                const id = cb.getAttribute('data-test-id');
                state[id] = cb.checked;
                if (cb.checked) checked++;
            });

            localStorage.setItem(ADMIN_CHECKLIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
            updateAdminBar(checked, checkboxes.length);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
        }
    }

    function updateAdminBar(checked, total) {
        if (total === 0) return;
        const pct = Math.round((checked / total) * 100);
        const fill = document.getElementById('adminProgressBar');
        const txt = document.getElementById('adminProgressText');
        if (fill) fill.style.width = pct + '%';
        if (txt) txt.textContent = pct + '% (' + checked + '/' + total + ' itens validados)';
    }

    function resetAdminChecklist() {
        if (confirm('Deseja reiniciar as validações do checklist?')) {
            localStorage.removeItem(ADMIN_CHECKLIST_KEY);
            loadAdminChecklist();
        }
    }

    function copyAiMasterPrompt(btn) {
        const el = document.getElementById('ds-ai-master-prompt');
        if (!el) return;
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.value).then(() => {
            const orig = btn.textContent;
            btn.textContent = '✓ Prompt Mestre Copiado!';
            setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = orig; }, 2200);
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        loadAdminChecklist();
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"][data-test-id]').forEach(cb => {
            cb.addEventListener('change', saveAdminChecklist);
        });
    });
</script>

                        <button onclick="copyShortcode('<?= htmlspecialchars($tag) ?>')" class="btn" style="background: rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.1); color: var(--accent-green); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.3); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--accent-green)'; this.style.color='#0b0c10';" onmouseout="this.style.background='rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.1)'; this.style.color='var(--accent-green)';">

                        </button>

'</span><span style="color: var(--text-muted);">="</span><span style="color: var(--accent-orange);">valor</span><span style="color: var(--text-muted);">"</span>'; } ?><span style="color: var(--accent-blue);">&#93;</span>
                            </code>
                        </div>

                </div>
            <?php endforeach; ?>
        <?php endif; ?>

<script>
function copyShortcode(tag) {
    var text = '[' + tag + ']';
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function() {
        if(typeof DS !== 'undefined' && DS.toast) {
            DS.toast.success('Copiado', 'Shortcode ' + text + ' copiado com sucesso!');
        } else {
            alert('Shortcode ' + text + ' copiado para a área de transferência!');
        }
    }, function(err) {
        if(typeof DS !== 'undefined' && DS.toast) {
            DS.toast.error('Erro', 'Não foi possível copiar o shortcode.');
        } else {
            alert('Erro ao copiar shortcode.');
        }
    });
}
</script>

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tools/build-release.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Script CLI oficial para geração do pacote de atualização do Domain System (Modelo A).
 *
 * Uso:
 *   php tools/build-release.php
 */

$rootDir = dirname(__DIR__);
$autoload = $rootDir . '/vendor/autoload.php';

if (!is_file($autoload)) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "Erro: vendor/autoload.php não encontrado. Execute composer install antes de gerar a Release.\n");
    exit(1);
}

require_once $autoload;
require_once __DIR__ . '/release/ReleaseBuilder.php';

use DomainSystem\Tools\Release\ReleaseBuilder;

try {
    $builder = new ReleaseBuilder($rootDir);
    $result = $builder->build();

    echo sprintf("✅ Pacote de Release v%s gerado com sucesso!\n", $result['version']);
    echo sprintf("   Arquivo ZIP : %s\n", $result['zipPath']);
    echo sprintf("   Arquivo Hash: %s\n", $result['sha256Path']);
    echo sprintf("   SHA-256     : %s\n", $result['sha256']);
    echo sprintf("   Arquivos    : %d\n", $result['fileCount']);
    echo sprintf("   Migrations  : %d\n", $result['migrationCount']);
    exit(0);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "❌ Falha ao gerar Release: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n");
    exit(1);
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tools/release/ReleaseBuilder.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tools\Release;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\CoreProtectedPaths;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use RuntimeException;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * Empacotador determinístico de Releases oficiais do Domain System (Modelo A).
 *
 * Gera `dist/domain-system-X.Y.Z.zip` (com `manifest.json` assinado por SHA-256)
 * e `dist/domain-system-X.Y.Z.zip.sha256`.
 */
final class ReleaseBuilder
{
    private string $rootDir;
    private CoreProtectedPaths $protectedPaths;

    public function __construct(string $rootDir, ?CoreProtectedPaths $protectedPaths = null)
    {
        $this->rootDir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootDir), '/');
        $this->protectedPaths = $protectedPaths ?? new CoreProtectedPaths();
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $removedPaths Lista opcional de caminhos obsoletos a declarar em `removed`.
     * @return array{
     *   version: string,
     *   zipPath: string,
     *   sha256Path: string,
     *   sha256: string,
     *   fileCount: int,
     *   migrationCount: int,
     *   manifest: array<string, mixed>
     * }
     */
    public function build(?string $outputDir = null, array $removedPaths = []): array
    {
        $autoloadPath = $this->rootDir . '/vendor/autoload.php';
        if (!is_file($autoloadPath)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                'vendor/autoload.php não encontrado. Execute "composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader" antes de empacotar a Release.'
            );
        }

        $version = $this->extractConstantFromBootstrap('DS_VERSION');
        $osVersion = $this->extractConstantFromBootstrap('DS_OS_VERSION', '2.3');
        $excludePatterns = $this->loadExcludePatterns();

        $candidateFiles = $this->collectCandidateFiles($excludePatterns);
        $filesManifest = [];
        $seenLower = [];

        foreach ($candidateFiles as $relPath) {
            $lower = strtolower($relPath);
            if (isset($seenLower[$lower])) {
                continue;
            }

            $mode = (str_starts_with($relPath, 'config/') && str_ends_with($relPath, '.json'))
                ? 'default_if_missing'
                : 'replace';

            if (!$this->protectedPaths->isAllowedPath(UpdateKind::Core, 'core', $relPath, $mode)) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($mode === 'replace' && $this->protectedPaths->isProtectedPath(UpdateKind::Core, 'core', $relPath)) {
                continue;
            }

            $absPath = $this->rootDir . '/' . $relPath;
            if (!is_file($absPath) || is_link($absPath)) {
                continue;
            }

            $size = filesize($absPath);
            $sha256 = hash_file('sha256', $absPath);
            if ($size === false || $sha256 === false) {
                throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Não foi possível calcular tamanho/hash de "%s".', $relPath));
            }

            $seenLower[$lower] = true;
            $filesManifest[] = [
                'path'   => $relPath,
                'sha256' => strtolower($sha256),
                'size'   => $size,
                'mode'   => $mode,
            ];
        }

        if ($filesManifest === []) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Nenhum arquivo elegível encontrado para empacotamento da Release.');
        }

        $migrationsManifest = $this->collectMigrations($seenLower);
        $expects = $this->loadSchemaExpects();

        $manifestData = [
            'protocol'           => 1,
            'minUpdaterProtocol' => 1,
            'kind'               => 'core',
            'slug'               => 'core',
            'version'            => $version,
            'requires'           => [
                'php'        => '8.1',
                'extensions' => ['pdo', 'zip', 'mbstring', 'openssl', 'json', 'curl'],
                'osVersion'  => $osVersion,
            ],
            'files'              => $filesManifest,
            'removed'            => array_values($removedPaths),
            'migrations'         => $migrationsManifest,
            'expects'            => $expects,
        ];

        $distDir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $outputDir ?? ($this->rootDir . '/dist')), '/');
        if (!is_dir($distDir) && !@mkdir($distDir, 0775, true) && !is_dir($distDir)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório de saída "%s".', $distDir));
        }

        $zipFilename = sprintf('domain-system-%s.zip', $version);
        $zipPath = $distDir . '/' . $zipFilename;
        if (is_file($zipPath)) {
            @unlink($zipPath);
        }

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Falha ao criar arquivo ZIP "%s".', $zipPath));
        }

        foreach ($filesManifest as $fileEntry) {
            $rel = $fileEntry['path'];
            $abs = $this->rootDir . '/' . $rel;
            if (!$zip->addFile($abs, $rel)) {
                $zip->close();
                throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Falha ao adicionar "%s" ao pacote ZIP.', $rel));
            }
        }

        $manifestJson = json_encode($manifestData, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if ($manifestJson === false || !$zip->addFromString('manifest.json', $manifestJson . "\n")) {
            $zip->close();
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao gravar manifest.json dentro do pacote ZIP.');
        }

        if (!$zip->close()) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao finalizar arquivo ZIP da Release.');
        }

        $zipSha256 = hash_file('sha256', $zipPath);
        if ($zipSha256 === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Não foi possível calcular SHA-256 do pacote ZIP gerado.');
        }
        $zipSha256 = strtolower($zipSha256);

        $sha256Path = $zipPath . '.sha256';
        file_put_contents($sha256Path, sprintf("%s  %s\n", $zipSha256, $zipFilename));

        return [
            'version'        => $version,
            'zipPath'        => $zipPath,
            'sha256Path'     => $sha256Path,
            'sha256'         => $zipSha256,
            'fileCount'      => count($filesManifest),
            'migrationCount' => count($migrationsManifest),
            'manifest'       => $manifestData,
        ];
    }

    private function extractConstantFromBootstrap(string $constantName, ?string $default = null): string
    {
        $bootstrapPath = $this->rootDir . '/bootstrap.php';
        if (!is_file($bootstrapPath)) {
            if ($default !== null) {
                return $default;
            }
            throw new RuntimeException('Arquivo bootstrap.php não encontrado na raiz informada.');
        }

        $contents = (string)file_get_contents($bootstrapPath);
        $pattern = sprintf("/define\(\s*'%s'\s*,\s*'([^']+)'\s*\)/", preg_quote($constantName, '/'));
        if (preg_match($pattern, $contents, $matches) === 1) {
            return trim($matches[1]);
        }

        if ($default !== null) {
            return $default;
        }

        throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Constante %s não encontrada em bootstrap.php.', $constantName));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function loadExcludePatterns(): array
    {
        $excludeFile = $this->rootDir . '/release/exclude.txt';
        if (!is_file($excludeFile)) {
            return [
                '.git*',
                '.github/',
                'tests/',
                'docs/',
                'wiki/',
                'auditoria/',
                'scratch/',
                'token/',
                'storage/',
                'temp/',
                'dist/',
                '*.phar',
                '*.zip',
                '.env',
                'database.sqlite',
            ];
        }

        $lines = file($excludeFile, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES) ?: [];
        $patterns = [];
        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            $trimmed = trim($line);
            if ($trimmed === '' || str_starts_with($trimmed, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $patterns[] = $trimmed;
        }

        return $patterns;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $excludePatterns
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function collectCandidateFiles(array $excludePatterns): array
    {
        $all = $this->scanDirectoryRecursive($this->rootDir, $excludePatterns);
        sort($all, SORT_STRING);
        return array_values(array_unique($all));
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $excludePatterns
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function scanDirectoryRecursive(string $baseDir, array $excludePatterns): array
    {
        $results = [];
        $baseLen = strlen($baseDir) + 1;

        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($baseDir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
        );

        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            if ($item->isLink() || !$item->isFile()) {
                continue;
            }

            $fullPath = str_replace('\\', '/', $item->getPathname());
            $relPath = substr($fullPath, $baseLen);
            if ($relPath === '' || $this->isExcluded($relPath, $excludePatterns)) {
                continue;
            }

            $results[] = $relPath;
        }

        return $results;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $excludePatterns
     */
    private function isExcluded(string $relPath, array $excludePatterns): bool
    {
        $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relPath), '/');
        $basename = basename($normalized);

        foreach ($excludePatterns as $pattern) {
            $normPattern = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $pattern), '/');
            if ($normPattern === '') {
                continue;
            }

            if (str_ends_with($normPattern, '/')) {
                $prefix = rtrim($normPattern, '/');
                if ($normalized === $prefix || str_starts_with($normalized, $normPattern)) {
                    return true;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if (fnmatch($normPattern, $normalized) || fnmatch($normPattern, $basename)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, bool> $includedFilesLower
     * @return list<array{scope: string, name: string, sha256: string, type: string}>
     */
    private function collectMigrations(array $includedFilesLower): array
    {
        $migrations = [];

        $coreMigDir = $this->rootDir . '/src/Core/Database/migrations';
        if (is_dir($coreMigDir)) {
            $files = glob($coreMigDir . '/*.php') ?: [];
            sort($files, SORT_STRING);
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                $relPath = 'src/Core/Database/migrations/' . basename($file);
                if (!isset($includedFilesLower[strtolower($relPath)])) {
                    continue;
                }
                $hash = hash_file('sha256', $file);
                if ($hash !== false) {
                    $migrations[] = [
                        'scope'  => '__core__',
                        'name'   => basename($file, '.php'),
                        'sha256' => strtolower($hash),
                        'type'   => 'additive',
                    ];
                }
            }
        }

        $pluginMigDirs = glob($this->rootDir . '/src/Plugins/*/migrations') ?: [];
        sort($pluginMigDirs, SORT_STRING);
        foreach ($pluginMigDirs as $migDir) {
            $slug = basename(dirname($migDir));
            $files = glob($migDir . '/*.php') ?: [];
            sort($files, SORT_STRING);
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                $relPath = 'src/Plugins/' . $slug . '/migrations/' . basename($file);
                if (!isset($includedFilesLower[strtolower($relPath)])) {
                    continue;
                }
                $hash = hash_file('sha256', $file);
                if ($hash !== false) {
                    $migrations[] = [
                        'scope'  => $slug,
                        'name'   => basename($file, '.php'),
                        'sha256' => strtolower($hash),
                        'type'   => 'additive',
                    ];
                }
            }
        }

        return $migrations;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function loadSchemaExpects(): array
    {
        $expectsFile = $this->rootDir . '/release/schema-expects.json';
        if (!is_file($expectsFile)) {
            return [];
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($expectsFile), true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('release/schema-expects.json contém JSON inválido.');
        }

        $result = [];
        foreach ($decoded as $table => $columns) {
            if (is_string($table) && is_array($columns)) {
                $result[$table] = array_values(array_map('strval', $columns));
            }
        }

        return $result;
    }
}
